APC.History.doc: Histories are in chronological order. The transition law may depend on all preceding draws, as required by iterative coreset sampling.
APC.History.source:
def History (Ω : Type*) : ℕ → Type _
  | 0 => PUnit
  | n+1 => History Ω n × Ω

instance historyFintype (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] (n : ℕ) : Fintype (History Ω n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype PUnit)
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (History Ω n × Ω))

APC.historyWeight.source:
def historyWeight {Ω : Type*} (q : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → ℝ) :
    (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n+1, h => historyWeight q n h.1 * q n h.1 h.2

APC.historyGood.source:
def historyGood {Ω : Type*} (good : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → Prop) :
    (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | n+1, h => historyGood good n h.1 ∧ good n h.1 h.2

APC.historyWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem historyWeight_nonneg {Ω : Type*}
    (q : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ n h ω, 0 ≤ q n h ω) (n : ℕ) : ∀ h, 0 ≤ historyWeight q n h := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; exact zero_le_one
  | succ n ih => intro h; exact mul_nonneg (ih h.1) (hq n h.1 h.2)

APC.historyWeight_sum.source:
theorem historyWeight_sum {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (q : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hqsum : ∀ n h, ∑ ω, q n h ω = 1) (n : ℕ) : ∑ h, historyWeight q n h = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [History, historyWeight]
  | succ n ih =>
    change (∑ h : History Ω n × Ω, kernelWeight (historyWeight q n) (q n) h) = 1
    exact kernelWeight_sum _ _ ih (hqsum n)

/-- Adaptive union bound. A stage bound is required only on histories where
all preceding preservation events held. No independence across stages is
assumed. The finite outcome alphabet is arbitrary. -/

APC.adaptive_failure_bound.doc: Adaptive union bound. A stage bound is required only on histories where all preceding preservation events held. No independence across stages is assumed. The finite outcome alphabet is arbitrary.
APC.adaptive_failure_bound.source:
theorem adaptive_failure_bound {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (q : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ n h ω, 0 ≤ q n h ω) (hqsum : ∀ n h, ∑ ω, q n h ω = 1)
    (good : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → Prop)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ δ n)
    (hstage : ∀ n h, historyGood good n h →
      eventMass (q n h) (fun ω => ¬good n h ω) ≤ δ n) (n : ℕ) :
    eventMass (historyWeight q n) (fun h => ¬historyGood good n h) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, δ i := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [History, historyGood, eventMass]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hb := kernel_event_bound (historyWeight q n) (q n)
      (historyWeight_nonneg q hq n) (historyWeight_sum q hqsum n)
      (hq n) (hqsum n) (historyGood good n)
      (fun h ω => ¬(historyGood good n h ∧ good n h ω))
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, δ i) (δ n) (hδ n) ih (by
        intro h hh
        simpa only [hh, true_and] using hstage n h hh)
    simpa only [Finset.sum_range_succ] using hb

/-- Any final guarantee implied by all local events inherits the same
adaptive failure bound. This also allows an adaptively computed solver. -/

APC.adaptive_consequence_bound.doc: Any final guarantee implied by all local events inherits the same adaptive failure bound. This also allows an adaptively computed solver.
APC.adaptive_consequence_bound.source:
theorem adaptive_consequence_bound {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (q : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ n h ω, 0 ≤ q n h ω) (hqsum : ∀ n h, ∑ ω, q n h ω = 1)
    (good : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → Prop)
    (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ δ n)
    (hstage : ∀ n h, historyGood good n h →
      eventMass (q n h) (fun ω => ¬good n h ω) ≤ δ n)
    (n : ℕ) (result : History Ω n → Prop)
    (hresult : ∀ h, historyGood good n h → result h) :
    eventMass (historyWeight q n) (fun h => ¬result h) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, δ i := by
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (historyWeight_nonneg q hq n) _ _ ?_)
    (adaptive_failure_bound q hq hqsum good δ hδ hstage n)
  intro h hh hg
  exact hh (hresult h hg)

end APC

APC.Adaptive.History.doc: A finite history of adaptive draws. Each stage may have a different finite outcome type and a law depending on its complete preceding history.
APC.Adaptive.History.source:
def History (Ω : ℕ → Type*) : ℕ → Type _
  | 0 => PUnit
  | n+1 => History Ω n × Ω n

instance historyFintype (Ω : ℕ → Type*) [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)] (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype (History Ω n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype PUnit)
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (History Ω n × Ω n))

APC.Adaptive.historyWeight.source:
def historyWeight {Ω : ℕ → Type*} (q : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → ℝ) :
    (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n+1, h => kernelWeight (historyWeight q n) (q n) h

APC.Adaptive.historyGood.source:
def historyGood {Ω : ℕ → Type*} (good : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → Prop) :
    (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | n+1, h => historyGood good n h.1 ∧ good n h.1 h.2

APC.Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem historyWeight_nonneg {Ω : ℕ → Type*}
    (q : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i h z, 0 ≤ q i h z)
    (n : ℕ) : ∀ h, 0 ≤ historyWeight q n h := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; exact zero_le_one
  | succ n ih => exact kernelWeight_nonneg _ _ ih (hq n)

APC.Adaptive.historyWeight_sum.source:
theorem historyWeight_sum {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (q : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i h, ∑ z, q i h z = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ h, historyWeight q n h = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [History, historyWeight]
  | succ n ih => exact kernelWeight_sum _ _ ih (hq n)

/-- Adaptive union bound. The step bound is needed only after good
histories; no unconditional independence of stages is assumed. -/

APC.Adaptive.adaptive_failure_bound.doc: Adaptive union bound. The step bound is needed only after good histories; no unconditional independence of stages is assumed.
APC.Adaptive.adaptive_failure_bound.source:
theorem adaptive_failure_bound {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (q : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i h z, 0 ≤ q i h z) (hqsum : ∀ i h, ∑ z, q i h z = 1)
    (good : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → Prop) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hstep : ∀ i h, historyGood good i h →
      eventMass (q i h) (fun z => ¬good i h z) ≤ δ i) (n : ℕ) :
    eventMass (historyWeight q n) (fun h => ¬historyGood good n h) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, δ i := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [History, historyGood, eventMass]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hb := kernel_event_bound (historyWeight q n) (q n)
      (historyWeight_nonneg q hq n) (historyWeight_sum q hqsum n)
      (hq n) (hqsum n) (historyGood good n)
      (fun h z => ¬(historyGood good n h ∧ good n h z))
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, δ i) (δ n) (hδ n) ih
      (by intro h hh; simpa only [hh, true_and] using hstep n h hh)
    simpa only [historyWeight, historyGood, Finset.sum_range_succ] using hb

/-- Any output guarantee established on all-good histories inherits the
adaptive failure budget. -/

APC.Adaptive.adaptive_output_bound.doc: Any output guarantee established on all-good histories inherits the adaptive failure budget.
APC.Adaptive.adaptive_output_bound.source:
theorem adaptive_output_bound {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Ω i)]
    (q : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i h z, 0 ≤ q i h z) (hqsum : ∀ i h, ∑ z, q i h z = 1)
    (good : (i : ℕ) → History Ω i → Ω i → Prop) (δ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hstep : ∀ i h, historyGood good i h →
      eventMass (q i h) (fun z => ¬good i h z) ≤ δ i)
    (n : ℕ) (result : History Ω n → Prop)
    (hresult : ∀ h, historyGood good n h → result h) :
    eventMass (historyWeight q n) (fun h => ¬result h) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, δ i := by
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (historyWeight_nonneg q hq n) _ _ ?_)
    (adaptive_failure_bound q hq hqsum good δ hδ hstep n)
  intro h hbad hgood
  exact hbad (hresult h hgood)

end APC.Adaptive

APC.aggregateWeights.source:
def aggregateWeights {I : Type*} (w p : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) (i : I) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j,if drawIndex m sample j=i then sampledWeights w p m sample j else 0

APC.aggregateWeights_nonneg.source:
theorem aggregateWeights_nonneg {I : Type*} (w p : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    ∀ i,0≤aggregateWeights w p m sample i := by
  intro i
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  split_ifs
  · exact sampledWeights_nonneg w p hw hp m sample j
  · exact le_rfl

APC.aggregate_evaluate.source:
theorem aggregate_evaluate {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w p f : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    (∑ i,aggregateWeights w p m sample i*f i)=importanceEstimate p (fun i=>w i*f i) m sample := by
  unfold aggregateWeights
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul,ite_mul,zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,if_true]
  unfold importanceEstimate
  rw [drawSum_eq_sum,Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  dsimp [sampledWeights]
  ring

APC.aggregate_cost.source:
theorem aggregate_cost {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w p : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) (s : K → X) :
    cost x (aggregateWeights w p m sample) s=
      cost (sampledPoints x m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) s := by
  rw [sampled_cost_eq]
  exact aggregate_evaluate w p (fun i=>pointCost s (x i)) m sample

APC.aggregate_groupMass.source:
theorem aggregate_groupMass {I K : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (j : K) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    groupMass (aggregateWeights w p m sample) a j=importanceEstimate p (fiberWeight w a j) m sample := by
  have h := aggregate_evaluate w p (fun i=>if a i=j then 1 else 0) m sample
  simpa only [groupMass,fiberWeight,mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero] using h

APC.aggregate_groupCost.source:
theorem aggregate_groupCost {I K : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w p c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (j : K) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    groupMass (fun i=>aggregateWeights w p m sample i*c i) a j=
      importanceEstimate p (fiberWeight (fun i=>w i*c i) a j) m sample := by
  have h := aggregate_evaluate w p (fun i=>if a i=j then c i else 0) m sample
  simpa only [groupMass,fiberWeight,mul_ite,mul_zero] using h

APC.importanceEstimate_div.source:
theorem importanceEstimate_div {I : Type*} (p f : I → ℝ) (z : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    importanceEstimate p (fun i=>f i/z) m sample=importanceEstimate p f m sample/z := by
  have h := importanceEstimate_smul p f z⁻¹ m sample
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using h

APC.normalized_residual_error.source:
theorem normalized_residual_error {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w p r : I → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    importanceEstimate p (fun i=>w i*r i/C) m sample-(∑ i,w i*r i/C)=
      (∑ i,(aggregateWeights w p m sample i-w i)*r i)/C := by
  rw [importanceEstimate_div,← Finset.sum_div,← sub_div,← aggregate_evaluate w p r m sample]
  congr 1
  simp [sub_mul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

end APC

APC.eventMass_nonneg.source:
theorem eventMass_nonneg {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (e : Ω → Prop) : 0 ≤ eventMass p e := by
  classical
  unfold eventMass
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)

APC.eventMass_mono.source:
theorem eventMass_mono {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (e f : Ω → Prop) (hef : ∀ ω, e ω → f ω) :
    eventMass p e ≤ eventMass p f := by
  classical
  unfold eventMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro ω _
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

APC.eventMass_complement.source:
theorem eventMass_complement {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∑ ω, p ω = 1) (e : Ω → Prop) :
    eventMass p (fun ω => ¬e ω) = 1 - eventMass p e := by
  classical
  have h : eventMass p (fun ω => ¬e ω) + eventMass p e = ∑ ω, p ω := by
    unfold eventMass
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ω _
    by_cases he : e ω <;> simp [he]
  linarith

APC.finite_union_bound.source:
theorem finite_union_bound {Ω K : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype K]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (bad : K → Ω → Prop) :
    eventMass p (fun ω => ∃ j, bad j ω) ≤ ∑ j, eventMass p (bad j) := by
  classical
  unfold eventMass
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro ω _
  by_cases h : ∃ j, bad j ω
  · rw [if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun k => if bad k ω then p ω else 0)
      (fun k _ => by dsimp; split_ifs <;> simp_all) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simpa [hj] using hle
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all)

APC.allDraws.source:
def allDraws {Ω : Type*} (bad : Ω → Prop) : (t : ℕ) → Draws Ω t → Prop
  | 0, _ => True
  | t+1, (ω, rest) => bad ω ∧ allDraws bad t rest

/-- Exact independent-repetition failure probability. Independence is
encoded by the product distribution, rather than left as an assumption. -/

APC.allDraws_mass.doc: Exact independent-repetition failure probability. Independence is encoded by the product distribution, rather than left as an assumption.
APC.allDraws_mass.source:
theorem allDraws_mass {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ)
    (bad : Ω → Prop) (t : ℕ) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p t) (allDraws bad t) = (eventMass p bad)^t := by
  classical
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [eventMass, Draws, drawWeight, allDraws]
  | succ t ih =>
    unfold eventMass
    change (∑ a : Ω × Draws Ω t,
      if allDraws bad (t+1) a then drawWeight p (t+1) a else 0) = _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [drawWeight, allDraws]
    have he : ∀ ω, (∑ tail : Draws Ω t,
        if bad ω ∧ allDraws bad t tail then p ω * drawWeight p t tail else 0) =
        (if bad ω then p ω else 0) * eventMass (drawWeight p t) (allDraws bad t) := by
      intro ω
      unfold eventMass
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro tail _
      by_cases h : bad ω <;> by_cases ht : allDraws bad t tail <;> simp [h, ht]
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ih, pow_succ]
    change eventMass p bad * eventMass p bad ^ t = _
    unfold eventMass
    ring

/-- Union over clusters does not require independence between clusters. -/

APC.amplified_cluster_failure.doc: Union over clusters does not require independence between clusters.
APC.amplified_cluster_failure.source:
theorem amplified_cluster_failure {Ω K : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype K]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (bad : K → Ω → Prop)
    (t : ℕ) (hbad : ∀ j, eventMass p (bad j) ≤ (1/3:ℝ)^t)
    (ht : (Fintype.card K : ℝ) * (1/3:ℝ)^t ≤ 1/3) :
    eventMass p (fun ω => ∃ j, bad j ω) ≤ 1/3 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j, eventMass p (bad j) := finite_union_bound p hp bad
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : K, (1/3:ℝ)^t := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hbad j)
    _ = (Fintype.card K : ℝ) * (1/3:ℝ)^t := by simp
    _ ≤ 1/3 := ht

end APC

APC.exp_le_quadratic.doc: Local exponential estimate used to prove the moment-generating bound.
APC.exp_le_quadratic.source:
theorem exp_le_quadratic (z : ℝ) (hz : |z| ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp z ≤ 1 + z + z^2 := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp (Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le hz)).2
  linarith

APC.finite_centered_mgf.source:
theorem finite_centered_mgf {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hzero : ∑ i, p i * f i = 0) (θ V : ℝ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, |θ * f i| ≤ 1)
    (hvar : ∑ i, p i * (f i)^2 ≤ V) :
    (∑ i, p i * Real.exp (θ * f i)) ≤ Real.exp (θ^2 * V) := by
  have h₁ : (∑ i, p i * Real.exp (θ * f i)) ≤
      ∑ i, p i * (1 + θ * f i + (θ * f i)^2) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (exp_le_quadratic _ (hsmall i)) (hp i))
  have he : (∑ i, p i * (1 + θ * f i + (θ * f i)^2)) =
      1 + θ^2 * ∑ i, p i * (f i)^2 := by
    simp_rw [mul_add, mul_one, mul_pow]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, h1]
    have ha : (∑ i, p i * (θ * f i)) = θ * ∑ i, p i * f i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    have hb : (∑ i, p i * (θ^2 * f i^2)) = θ^2 * ∑ i, p i * f i^2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    rw [ha, hb, hzero]
    ring
  rw [he] at h₁
  calc
    _ ≤ 1 + θ^2 * V := h₁.trans (add_le_add_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvar (sq_nonneg θ)) 1)
    _ ≤ Real.exp (θ^2 * V) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (θ^2 * V)]

/-- Exact factorization of the exponential moment for independent draws. -/

APC.draw_exp_moment.doc: Exact factorization of the exponential moment for independent draws.
APC.draw_exp_moment.source:
theorem draw_exp_moment {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ a, drawWeight p m a * Real.exp (θ * drawSum f m a)) =
      (∑ i, p i * Real.exp (θ * f i))^m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Draws, drawWeight, drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    change (∑ a : I × Draws I m,
      (p a.1 * drawWeight p m a.2) * Real.exp (θ * (f a.1 + drawSum f m a.2))) = _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [mul_add, Real.exp_add]
    have he : ∀ i, (∑ tail : Draws I m,
        (p i * drawWeight p m tail) *
          (Real.exp (θ*f i) * Real.exp (θ*drawSum f m tail))) =
        (p i * Real.exp (θ*f i)) *
          ∑ tail, drawWeight p m tail * Real.exp (θ*drawSum f m tail) := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro tail _
      ring
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ih, pow_succ]
    ring

/-- Chernoff bound on a finite probability space. -/

APC.finite_chernoff.doc: Chernoff bound on a finite probability space.
APC.finite_chernoff.source:
theorem finite_chernoff {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (p f : Ω → ℝ) (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (θ t : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    eventMass p (fun ω => t < f ω) ≤
      Real.exp (-θ*t) * ∑ ω, p ω * Real.exp (θ*f ω) := by
  have he : eventMass p (fun ω => t < f ω) ≤
      eventMass p (fun ω => Real.exp (θ*t) < Real.exp (θ*f ω)) := by
    apply eventMass_mono p hp
    intro ω h
    exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hθ)
  have hm := finite_markov p (fun ω => Real.exp (θ*f ω)) hp
    (fun ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le) (Real.exp (θ*t))
  have hb : eventMass p (fun ω => t < f ω) ≤
      (∑ ω, p ω * Real.exp (θ*f ω)) / Real.exp (θ*t) :=
    he.trans ((le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).2 (by nlinarith only [hm]))
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hb
    _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_mul]; ring

/-- One-sided Bernstein estimate in parameter form. The variance, rather
than the squared range, controls the quadratic exponential term. -/

APC.draw_upper_tail_mgf.doc: One-sided Bernstein estimate in parameter form. The variance, rather than the squared range, controls the quadratic exponential term.
APC.draw_upper_tail_mgf.source:
theorem draw_upper_tail_mgf {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hzero : ∑ i, p i * f i = 0) (θ V t : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, |θ*f i| ≤ 1)
    (hvar : ∑ i, p i * (f i)^2 ≤ V) (m : ℕ) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun a => t < drawSum f m a) ≤
      Real.exp (-θ*t + (m:ℝ)*θ^2*V) := by
  have hb := finite_chernoff (drawWeight p m) (drawSum f m)
    (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) θ t hθ
  rw [draw_exp_moment] at hb
  have hpows := pow_le_pow_left₀
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hp i) (Real.exp_pos _).le))
    (finite_centered_mgf p f hp h1 hzero θ V hsmall hvar) m
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ*t) * (Real.exp (θ^2*V))^m :=
      hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpows (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

APC.eventMass_or_le.source:
theorem eventMass_or_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (e f : Ω → Prop) :
    eventMass p (fun ω => e ω ∨ f ω) ≤ eventMass p e + eventMass p f := by
  classical
  unfold eventMass
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro ω _
  by_cases he : e ω <;> by_cases hf : f ω <;> simp [he, hf, hp]

APC.drawSum_neg.source:
theorem drawSum_neg {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) :
    drawSum (fun i => -f i) m a = -drawSum f m a := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases a with ⟨i, tail⟩
    simp [drawSum, ih, add_comm]

APC.draw_two_sided_tail_mgf.source:
theorem draw_two_sided_tail_mgf {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hzero : ∑ i, p i * f i = 0) (θ V t : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, |θ*f i| ≤ 1)
    (hvar : ∑ i, p i * (f i)^2 ≤ V) (m : ℕ) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun a => t < |drawSum f m a|) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-θ*t + (m:ℝ)*θ^2*V) := by
  have hupper := draw_upper_tail_mgf p f hp h1 hzero θ V t hθ hsmall hvar m
  have hzneg : (∑ i, p i * (-f i)) = 0 := by simp [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, hzero]
  have hneg := draw_upper_tail_mgf p (fun i => -f i) hp h1 hzneg θ V t hθ
    (fun i => by simpa using hsmall i) (by simpa using hvar) m
  simp_rw [drawSum_neg] at hneg
  have hu := eventMass_or_le (drawWeight p m) (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m)
    (fun a => t < drawSum f m a) (fun a => t < -drawSum f m a)
  have he : eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun a => t < |drawSum f m a|) =
      eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun a => t < drawSum f m a ∨ t < -drawSum f m a) := by
    congr 1
    funext a
    exact propext lt_abs
  rw [he]
  linarith

/-- A Bernstein inequality for the average of independent finite draws.
Its constants differ from the textbook formula but yield the same rate:
2 exp(-m r² / (4(V+Mr))). No tail estimate is taken as an assumption. -/

APC.finite_bernstein.doc: A Bernstein inequality for the average of independent finite draws. Its constants differ from the textbook formula but yield the same rate: 2 exp(-m r² / (4(V+Mr))). No tail estimate is taken as an assumption.
APC.finite_bernstein.source:
theorem finite_bernstein {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hzero : ∑ i, p i * f i = 0) (M V r : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hV : 0 < V) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hbound : ∀ i, |f i| ≤ M)
    (hvar : ∑ i, p i * (f i)^2 ≤ V) (m : ℕ) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun a => (m:ℝ)*r < |drawSum f m a|) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*r^2 / (4*(V+M*r))) := by
  let D := V + M*r
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  let θ := r / (2*D)
  have hθ : 0 < θ := div_pos hr (by positivity)
  have hθM : θ*M ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [θ]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*D)).2
    dsimp [D]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hM hr.le]
  have hsmall : ∀ i, |θ*f i| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hθ]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound i) hθ.le).trans hθM
  have hscalar : -θ*r + θ^2*V ≤ -r^2/(4*D) := by
    have he : -θ*r + θ^2*V = -r^2/(4*D) - (M*r)*r^2/(4*D^2) := by
      dsimp [θ, D]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [he]
    exact sub_le_self _ (by positivity)
  have hrate : -θ*((m:ℝ)*r) + (m:ℝ)*θ^2*V ≤ -(m:ℝ)*r^2/(4*D) := by
    convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscalar (Nat.cast_nonneg m) using 1 <;> ring
  exact (draw_two_sided_tail_mgf p f hp h1 hzero θ V ((m:ℝ)*r) hθ hsmall hvar m).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hrate) (by norm_num))

end APC

APC.MeanTrials.source: abbrev MeanTrials (I : Type*) (m r : ℕ) := Draws (Draws I m) r

APC.meanDrawLaw.source:
def meanDrawLaw {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] (v : I → ℝ) (i : I) : ℝ :=
  if mass v=0 then (if i=Classical.arbitrary I then 1 else 0) else v i/mass v

APC.meanDrawLaw_nonneg.source:
theorem meanDrawLaw_nonneg {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i,0≤v i) (i : I) : 0≤meanDrawLaw v i := by
  unfold meanDrawLaw
  split_ifs
  · norm_num
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact div_nonneg (hv i) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _=>hv j))

APC.meanDrawLaw_sum.source:
theorem meanDrawLaw_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → ℝ) : ∑ i,meanDrawLaw v i=1 := by
  by_cases hz : mass v=0
  · simp [meanDrawLaw,hz]
  · simp only [meanDrawLaw,if_neg hz,← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hz

APC.meanTrialsWeight.source:
def meanTrialsWeight {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → ℝ) (m r : ℕ) : MeanTrials I m r → ℝ :=
  drawWeight (drawWeight (meanDrawLaw v) m) r

APC.meanTrialsWeight_sum.source:
theorem meanTrialsWeight_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → ℝ) (m r : ℕ) : ∑ trials,meanTrialsWeight v m r trials=1 :=
  drawWeight_sum _ (drawWeight_sum _ (meanDrawLaw_sum v) m) r

APC.meanTrialsWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem meanTrialsWeight_nonneg {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (v : I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i,0≤v i) (m r : ℕ) (trials : MeanTrials I m r) :
    0≤meanTrialsWeight v m r trials :=
  drawWeight_nonneg _ (drawWeight_nonneg _ (meanDrawLaw_nonneg v hv) m) r trials

APC.bestTrialIndex.source:
def bestTrialIndex {I E : Type*} [Fintype I] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (v : I → ℝ) (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (trials : MeanTrials I m r) : Fin r :=
  nearest (fun j : Fin r=>drawMean x m (drawIndex r trials j)) (mean x v)

APC.bestTrial.source:
def bestTrial {I E : Type*} [Fintype I] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (v : I → ℝ) (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (trials : MeanTrials I m r) : Draws I m :=
  drawIndex r trials (bestTrialIndex x v m r trials)

APC.bestMean.source:
def bestMean {I E : Type*} [Fintype I] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (v : I → ℝ) (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (trials : MeanTrials I m r) : E :=
  drawMean x m (bestTrial x v m r trials)

/-- The selected sampled mean has no larger cluster cost than any trial.
The selection criterion is distance to the cluster's weighted centroid. -/

APC.bestMean_cost_le_trial.doc: The selected sampled mean has no larger cluster cost than any trial. The selection criterion is distance to the cluster's weighted centroid.
APC.bestMean_cost_le_trial.source:
theorem bestMean_cost_le_trial {I E : Type*} [Fintype I]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (v : I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i,0≤v i)
    (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (trials : MeanTrials I m r) (j : Fin r) :
    oneCost x v (bestMean x v m r trials)≤oneCost x v (drawMean x m (drawIndex r trials j)) := by
  by_cases hz : mass v=0
  · simp [oneCost_zero_mass x v hv hz]
  · apply closest_mean_cost x v hv hz
    have hn := nearest_le (fun j : Fin r=>drawMean x m (drawIndex r trials j)) (mean x v) j
    have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg hn 2
    simpa only [bestMean,bestTrial,bestTrialIndex,dist_eq_norm_sub] using hs

APC.allDraws_iff_indices.source:
theorem allDraws_iff_indices {Ω : Type*} (bad : Ω → Prop) (r : ℕ) (trials : Draws Ω r) :
    allDraws bad r trials ↔ ∀ j : Fin r,bad (drawIndex r trials j) := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [allDraws]
  | succ r ih =>
    rcases trials with ⟨ω,tail⟩
    simp [allDraws,drawIndex,Fin.forall_fin_succ,ih]

/-- Amplified weighted mean-estimation guarantee for the actual selected
trial, including zero-mass and zero-variance clusters. -/

APC.bestMean_failure.doc: Amplified weighted mean-estimation guarantee for the actual selected trial, including zero-mass and zero-variance clusters.
APC.bestMean_failure.source:
theorem bestMean_failure {I E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (v : I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i,0≤v i)
    (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (hm : 0<m) (ε : ℝ) (hmε : 3≤(m:ℝ)*ε) :
    eventMass (meanTrialsWeight v m r)
      (fun trials=>(1+ε)*oneCost x v (mean x v)<oneCost x v (bestMean x v m r trials))≤(1/3:ℝ)^r := by
  by_cases hz : mass v=0
  · simp only [oneCost_zero_mass x v hv hz,mul_zero,lt_self_iff_false,eventMass,if_false,Finset.sum_const_zero]
    positivity
  · have hmass : 0<mass v := lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _=>hv i)) (Ne.symm hz)
    let bad := fun trial : Draws I m=>(1+ε)*oneCost x v (mean x v)<oneCost x v (drawMean x m trial)
    have hsingle : eventMass (drawWeight (meanDrawLaw v) m) bad≤1/3 := by
      have he : meanDrawLaw v=(fun i=>v i/mass v) := by funext i;exact if_neg hz
      rw [he]
      exact random_mean_failure_le_third x v hv hmass m hm ε hmε
    have hb : eventMass (meanTrialsWeight v m r)
        (fun trials=>(1+ε)*oneCost x v (mean x v)<oneCost x v (bestMean x v m r trials))≤
        eventMass (meanTrialsWeight v m r) (allDraws bad r) := by
      apply eventMass_mono _ (meanTrialsWeight_nonneg v hv m r)
      intro trials ht
      apply (allDraws_iff_indices bad r trials).2
      intro j
      exact ht.trans_le (bestMean_cost_le_trial x v hv m r trials j)
    have he : eventMass (meanTrialsWeight v m r) (allDraws bad r)=
        (eventMass (drawWeight (meanDrawLaw v) m) bad)^r := allDraws_mass _ bad r
    rw [he] at hb
    exact hb.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (eventMass_nonneg _
      (drawWeight_nonneg _ (meanDrawLaw_nonneg v hv) m) bad) hsingle r)

APC.drawSum_eq_fin_sum.source:
theorem drawSum_eq_fin_sum {I E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E]
    (x : I → E) (m : ℕ) (trial : Draws I m) :
    drawSum x m trial=∑ j,x (drawIndex m trial j) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases trial with ⟨i,tail⟩
    simp [drawSum,drawIndex,Fin.sum_univ_succ,ih]

APC.drawMean_eq_tupleMean.source:
theorem drawMean_eq_tupleMean {I E : Type*} [Fintype I]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (m : ℕ) (trial : Draws I m) :
    drawMean x m trial=tupleMean x m (drawIndex m trial) := by
  simp only [drawMean,tupleMean,drawSum_eq_fin_sum]

end APC

APC.metricStageSampleCount_ge_centers.doc: The verified structural budget always leaves at least k draw slots. This permits exact-size subset search, including when k exceeds input size.
APC.metricStageSampleCount_ge_centers.source:
theorem metricStageSampleCount_ge_centers (k B : ℕ) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    k≤metricStageSampleCount k B a ε δ := by
  have hkr : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hx : (2:ℝ)≤8*(k:ℝ)/δ := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hxp : 0<8*(k:ℝ)/δ := by positivity
  have hi : (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)⁻¹≤(1:ℝ)/2 := by
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) hx
  have hlog : (1:ℝ)/2≤Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ) := by
    linarith [Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hxp]
  have hD : 1≤23+22*a := by linarith
  have hz : 0≤ε/(23+22*a) := by positivity
  have hz1 : ε/(23+22*a)≤1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
  have hz2 : (ε/(23+22*a))^2≤1 := by nlinarith
  have hb := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(k:ℝ)*Real.log B))
    (ε/(23+22*a)) (by positivity)
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity : 0≤48*(k:ℝ))
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz2
    (Nat.cast_nonneg (metricStageSampleCount k B a ε δ) : (0:ℝ)≤metricStageSampleCount k B a ε δ)
  have hfinal : (k:ℝ)≤metricStageSampleCount k B a ε δ := by
    have hbs := hb.2.1
    change _≤(metricStageSampleCount k B a ε δ:ℝ)*(ε/(23+22*a))^2 at hbs
    nlinarith only [hbs,hs,hm,hkr]
  exact_mod_cast hfinal

/-- An elementary exponential-series argument removes the factorial from
the binomial bound; no Stirling asymptotic is assumed. -/

APC.choose_le_exp_ratio_pow.doc: An elementary exponential-series argument removes the factorial from the binomial bound; no Stirling asymptotic is assumed.
APC.choose_le_exp_ratio_pow.source:
theorem choose_le_exp_ratio_pow (m k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k) :
    (m.choose k:ℝ)≤(Real.exp 1*(m:ℝ)/(k:ℝ))^k := by
  have hkp : (0:ℝ)<k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk
  have hfact : (0:ℝ)<k.factorial := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos k)
  have hf := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (k:ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg k) k
  have hf' := (div_le_iff₀ hfact).mp hf
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf' (show 0≤(m:ℝ)^k/(k:ℝ)^k by positivity)
  have he : Real.exp (k:ℝ)=(Real.exp 1)^k := by simpa only [mul_one] using Real.exp_nat_mul 1 k
  calc
    (m.choose k:ℝ)≤(m:ℝ)^k/(k.factorial:ℝ) := Nat.choose_le_pow_div k m
    _≤_ := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hfact).2
      calc
        (m:ℝ)^k=((m:ℝ)^k/(k:ℝ)^k)*(k:ℝ)^k := by field_simp
        _≤_ := hmul
        _=(Real.exp 1*(m:ℝ)/(k:ℝ))^k*(k.factorial:ℝ) := by
          rw [he,div_pow,mul_pow]
          ring

end APC
namespace APC.MetricIteration

APC.MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_le_.source:
theorem scheduledFailure_le_one (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : ℕ) : scheduledFailure N i≤1 := by
  have hN : (1:ℝ)≤N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)
  unfold scheduledFailure metricStageFailure metricCountFailure
  split_ifs
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<4*N)).2
    linarith
  · have hc : (1:ℝ)≤metricIterationCount 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 (i-1) := by
      exact_mod_cast metricIterationCount_pos 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (i-1)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<4*(metricIterationCount 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 (i-1):ℝ))).2
    linarith

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_size_ge_cen.source:
theorem terminal_size_ge_centers (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hk : 0<k)
    (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    k≤size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N) (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) := by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt (logStop_pos (N:ℝ) 14400))
  rw [hn,size]
  exact metricStageSampleCount_ge_centers _ _ _ _ _ hk ha
    (scheduledError_pos N ε hε n) (scheduledError_le_one N ε hε1 n)
    (scheduledFailure_pos N n) (scheduledFailure_le_one N n)

/-- Exact binomial bound for the same terminal draw count used by the
adaptive sampler, now with the factorial cancellation made explicit. -/

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_binomial_co.doc: Exact binomial bound for the same terminal draw count used by the adaptive sampler, now with the factorial cancellation made explicit.
APC.MetricIteration.terminal_binomial_co.source:
theorem terminal_binomial_count_bound (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hk : 0<k)
    (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    ((size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)).choose k:ℝ)≤
      (Real.exp 1*metricSizeGamma k a ε*14400^2/(k:ℝ))^k := by
  have hs := terminal_size_bound N k hk a ε ha hε hε1
  refine (choose_le_exp_ratio_pow _ k hk).trans ?_
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
  have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (Real.exp_pos 1).le) (Nat.cast_nonneg k)
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

/-- A parameter-only FPT candidate bound: the linear k factor in summary
size cancels against the factorial in subset enumeration. -/

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_binomial_pa.doc: A parameter-only FPT candidate bound: the linear k factor in summary size cancels against the factorial in subset enumeration.
APC.MetricIteration.terminal_binomial_pa.source:
theorem terminal_binomial_parameter_bound (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hk : 0<k)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    ((size N k 1 (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)).choose k:ℝ)≤
      (Real.exp 17*1265625*14400^2*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k 1 ε))/ε^2)^k := by
  have hkR : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkp : (0:ℝ)<k := by linarith
  have hT : 0≤1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k 1 ε) := by
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg (metricSizeBase_bounds k 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1).1]
  have hH : metricSizeBase k 1 ε/(k:ℝ)≤1265625/ε^2 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hkp (sq_pos_of_pos hε)).2
    rw [metricSizeBase_one]
    have hid : (2025*(289+336*(k:ℝ))/ε^2)*ε^2=2025*(289+336*(k:ℝ)) := by field_simp
    rw [hid]
    nlinarith only [hkR]
  have hHpos := (metricSizeBase_bounds k 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1).1
  have hΓ : 0≤metricSizeGamma k 1 ε := by unfold metricSizeGamma;positivity
  have hb := terminal_binomial_count_bound N k hk 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1
  refine hb.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ k)
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hH
    (show 0≤Real.exp 17*14400^2*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k 1 ε)) by positivity)
  have he : Real.exp (17:ℝ)=Real.exp 1*Real.exp 16 := by rw [←Real.exp_add];norm_num
  dsimp only [metricSizeGamma]
  rw [he] at hh ⊢
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

end APC.MetricIteration

APC.nearest.doc: Ordered center tuples permit repeated centers; the induced objective is the usual nearest-center k-means cost.

APC.nearest_le.source:
theorem nearest_le (s : K → X) (x : X) (j : K) :
    dist x (s (nearest s x)) ≤ dist x (s j) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (fun j => dist x (s j)) Finset.univ_nonempty)).2 j (Finset.mem_univ j)

APC.pointCost.source: def pointCost (s : K → X) (x : X) : ℝ := dist x (s (nearest s x))^2

APC.cost.source:
def cost (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (s : K → X) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, w i * pointCost s (x i)

APC.pointCost_le.source:
theorem pointCost_le (s : K → X) (x : X) (j : K) :
    pointCost s x ≤ dist x (s j)^2 := by
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg (nearest_le s x j) 2

APC.cost_nonneg.source:
theorem cost_nonneg (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (s : K → X) :
    0 ≤ cost x w s :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (sq_nonneg _))

APC.cost_le_assigned.source:
theorem cost_le_assigned (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (s : K → X) (a : I → K) :
    cost x w s ≤ ∑ i, w i * dist (x i) (s (a i))^2 := by
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pointCost_le s (x i) (a i)) (hw i))

/-- Rounding each center to its nearest summary point costs at most 4.
The premise is exactly the property computed by nearest-point rounding. -/

APC.metric_rounding.doc: Rounding each center to its nearest summary point costs at most 4. The premise is exactly the property computed by nearest-point rounding.
APC.metric_rounding.source:
theorem metric_rounding (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (s out : K → X)
    (hround : ∀ j i, dist (s j) (out j) ≤ dist (s j) (x i)) :
    cost x w out ≤ 4 * cost x w s := by
  unfold cost
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  have hdist : dist (x i) (out (nearest s (x i))) ≤
      2 * dist (x i) (s (nearest s (x i))) := by
    have htri := dist_triangle (x i) (s (nearest s (x i))) (out (nearest s (x i)))
    have hr := hround (nearest s (x i)) i
    rw [dist_comm (s (nearest s (x i))) (x i)] at hr
    linarith
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg hdist 2
  have hp := (pointCost_le out (x i) (nearest s (x i))).trans hs
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (hw i)
  dsimp [pointCost] at hh ⊢
  nlinarith [hh]

end APC

APC.centerDist.source: def centerDist (s : K → X) (x : X) : ℝ := dist x (s (nearest s x))

APC.centerDist_nonneg.source: theorem centerDist_nonneg (s : K → X) (x : X) : 0 ≤ centerDist s x := dist_nonneg

APC.centerDist_triangle.source:
theorem centerDist_triangle (s : K → X) (x y : X) :
    centerDist s x ≤ dist x y + centerDist s y := by
  exact (nearest_le s x (nearest s y)).trans (dist_triangle x y _)

APC.centerDist_lipschitz.source:
theorem centerDist_lipschitz (s : K → X) (x y : X) :
    |centerDist s x - centerDist s y| ≤ dist x y := by
  apply abs_le.mpr
  have h₁ := centerDist_triangle s x y
  have h₂ := centerDist_triangle s y x
  rw [dist_comm y x] at h₂
  constructor <;> linarith

/-- Explicit form of Claim A.9(i), avoiding asymptotic notation. -/

APC.pointCost_difference.doc: Explicit form of Claim A.9(i), avoiding asymptotic notation.
APC.pointCost_difference.source:
theorem pointCost_difference (s : K → X) (x a : X) :
    |pointCost s x - pointCost s a| ≤
      2 * centerDist s x * dist x a + (dist x a)^2 := by
  have h₁ := centerDist_lipschitz s x a
  have h₂ := centerDist_triangle s a x
  rw [dist_comm a x] at h₂
  have hx := centerDist_nonneg s x
  have ha := centerDist_nonneg s a
  have hd : 0 ≤ dist x a := dist_nonneg
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ (add_nonneg hx ha)
  have he : |pointCost s x - pointCost s a| =
      (centerDist s x + centerDist s a) * |centerDist s x - centerDist s a| := by
    dsimp [pointCost, centerDist]
    rw [← abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg dist_nonneg dist_nonneg), ← abs_mul]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  nlinarith only [hm, h₂, mul_nonneg hd (sub_nonneg.mpr h₂)]

/-- Squared residual bound needed for Claim A.10's variance estimate. -/

APC.pointCost_difference_sq.doc: Squared residual bound needed for Claim A.10's variance estimate.
APC.pointCost_difference_sq.source:
theorem pointCost_difference_sq (s : K → X) (x a : X) :
    (pointCost s x - pointCost s a)^2 ≤
      8 * pointCost s x * (dist x a)^2 + 2 * (dist x a)^4 := by
  have h := pointCost_difference s x a
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h 2
  rw [sq_abs] at hs
  have hc : (centerDist s x)^2 = pointCost s x := rfl
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * centerDist s x * dist x a - (dist x a)^2)]

/-- Claim A.9(ii), with an explicit constant and no division by ε.
The hypothesis is precisely the definition of a close cluster. -/

APC.close_pointCost_difference.doc: Claim A.9(ii), with an explicit constant and no division by ε. The hypothesis is precisely the definition of a close cluster.
APC.close_pointCost_difference.source:
theorem close_pointCost_difference (s : K → X) (x a : X) (ε Δ : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hΔ : 0 ≤ Δ)
    (hclose : ε^2 * pointCost s a ≤ Δ) :
    ε * |pointCost s x - pointCost s a| ≤ 2 * (Δ + (dist x a)^2) := by
  have hb := pointCost_difference s a x
  rw [dist_comm a x, abs_sub_comm] at hb
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hε
  have hy := sq_nonneg (ε * centerDist s a - dist x a)
  have ht := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1) (sq_nonneg (dist x a))
  change ε^2 * (centerDist s a)^2 ≤ Δ at hclose
  nlinarith only [hm, hy, ht, hclose, hΔ]

/-- Claim A.3 before applying the approximation factor of the proxy A. -/

APC.representative_cost_bound.doc: Claim A.3 before applying the approximation factor of the proxy A.
APC.representative_cost_bound.source:
theorem representative_cost_bound {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (a s : K → X) :
    (∑ i, w i * pointCost s (a (nearest a (x i)))) ≤
      2 * (cost x w a + cost x w s) := by
  have hpoint : ∀ i, pointCost s (a (nearest a (x i))) ≤
      2 * (pointCost a (x i) + pointCost s (x i)) := by
    intro i
    have ht := centerDist_triangle s (a (nearest a (x i))) (x i)
    rw [dist_comm] at ht
    have hn := centerDist_nonneg s (a (nearest a (x i)))
    have hd : 0 ≤ dist (x i) (a (nearest a (x i))) := dist_nonneg
    have hs := centerDist_nonneg s (x i)
    change (centerDist s (a (nearest a (x i))))^2 ≤
      2 * ((centerDist a (x i))^2 + (centerDist s (x i))^2)
    change centerDist s (a (nearest a (x i))) ≤ centerDist a (x i) + centerDist s (x i) at ht
    have hd2 := centerDist_nonneg a (x i)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (centerDist a (x i) - centerDist s (x i))]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, w i * (2*(pointCost a (x i) + pointCost s (x i))) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpoint i) (hw i))
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [mul_add, cost]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro i _ <;> ring

end APC

APC.dependentKernelWeight.doc: Conditional finite randomness whose outcome type may depend on the first outcome, as for a random coreset with a varying number of points.

APC.dependentKernelWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem dependentKernelWeight_nonneg {Ω : Type*} {Λ : Ω → Type*}
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : (ω : Ω) → Λ ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω,0≤p ω) (hq : ∀ ω z,0≤q ω z) :
    ∀ sample,0≤dependentKernelWeight p q sample :=
  fun sample => mul_nonneg (hp sample.1) (hq sample.1 sample.2)

APC.dependentKernelWeight_sum.source:
theorem dependentKernelWeight_sum {Ω : Type*} {Λ : Ω → Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [∀ ω,Fintype (Λ ω)]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : (ω : Ω) → Λ ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∑ ω,p ω=1) (hq : ∀ ω,∑ z,q ω z=1) :
    ∑ sample,dependentKernelWeight p q sample=1 := by
  unfold dependentKernelWeight
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  simp_rw [←Finset.mul_sum,hq,mul_one]
  exact hp

APC.dependentKernel_event_identity.source:
theorem dependentKernel_event_identity {Ω : Type*} {Λ : Ω → Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [∀ ω,Fintype (Λ ω)]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : (ω : Ω) → Λ ω → ℝ)
    (bad : (ω : Ω) → Λ ω → Prop) :
    eventMass (dependentKernelWeight p q) (fun sample => bad sample.1 sample.2)=
      ∑ ω,p ω*eventMass (q ω) (bad ω) := by
  unfold eventMass dependentKernelWeight
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- Failure composition with no fixed-size or unconditional-independence
assumption on the later finite random experiment. -/

APC.dependentKernel_event_bound.doc: Failure composition with no fixed-size or unconditional-independence assumption on the later finite random experiment.
APC.dependentKernel_event_bound.source:
theorem dependentKernel_event_bound {Ω : Type*} {Λ : Ω → Type*}
    [Fintype Ω] [∀ ω,Fintype (Λ ω)]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : (ω : Ω) → Λ ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω,0≤p ω) (hpsum : ∑ ω,p ω=1)
    (hq : ∀ ω z,0≤q ω z) (hqsum : ∀ ω,∑ z,q ω z=1)
    (good : Ω → Prop) (bad : (ω : Ω) → Λ ω → Prop) (δ η : ℝ)
    (hη : 0≤η) (hfirst : eventMass p (fun ω=>¬good ω)≤δ)
    (hsecond : ∀ ω,good ω→eventMass (q ω) (bad ω)≤η) :
    eventMass (dependentKernelWeight p q) (fun sample=>bad sample.1 sample.2)≤δ+η := by
  rw [dependentKernel_event_identity]
  have hle : ∀ ω,eventMass (q ω) (bad ω)≤(if good ω then η else 1) := by
    intro ω
    by_cases hg : good ω
    · simpa [hg] using hsecond ω hg
    · rw [if_neg hg]
      have hh := eventMass_mono (q ω) (hq ω) (bad ω) (fun _=>True) (fun _ _=>True.intro)
      simpa [eventMass,hqsum ω] using hh
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ ω,p ω*(if good ω then η else 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _=>mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle ω) (hp ω))
    _ ≤ eventMass p (fun ω=>¬good ω)+η*(∑ ω,p ω) := by
      unfold eventMass
      rw [Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro ω _
      by_cases hg : good ω <;> simp [hg] <;> nlinarith only [mul_nonneg hη (hp ω)]
    _ ≤ δ+η := by rw [hpsum,mul_one]; linarith only [hfirst]

end APC

APC.EuclideanIteration.SummaryAPC.doc: This fixed lift uses only the final summary and the input solution.
APC.EuclideanIteration.SummaryAPC.source:
def SummaryAPC {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] {N : ℕ}
    (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E) (c : Cloud I E) (hwc : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i)
    (ε : ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0<t) : Prop :=
  APCWithLift (cost (K:=K) initial.points initial.weights) (cost (K:=K) c.points c.weights) (1+ε)
    (geometricLift (K:=K) c.points c.weights hwc t ht)

APC.EuclideanIteration.liftingWitnessCou.source:
theorem liftingWitnessCount_valid (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    0<liftingSampleCount (ε/10) ∧ ((liftingSampleCount (ε/10):ℕ):ℝ)⁻¹≤ε/10 := by
  have hm := liftingSampleCount_valid (ε/10) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨hm.1,?_⟩
  rw [inv_eq_one_div]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm.1)).2
  nlinarith only [hm.2]

variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {a : ℝ} {e δ : ℕ → ℝ} {t : ℕ}

APC.EuclideanIteration.final_witness_pre.source:
theorem final_witness_preservation (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=E) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → E) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (hh : Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h) :
    ∀ u,u∈witnessFamily (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points t ∨ u=opt →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights u)
        (cost (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points
          (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights u) (ε/10) := by
  have hp := chain_preserves initial hw proxy opt he n (by linarith) h hh
  intro u hu
  exact preserves_mono (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) u) (by linarith) (hp u hu)

APC.EuclideanIteration.summary_apc_of_go.source:
theorem summary_apc_of_good (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=E) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → E) (hoptimal : Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) 1 opt)
    (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (ht : 0<t) (htε : (t:ℝ)⁻¹≤ε/10)
    (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (hh : Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h) :
    SummaryAPC (K:=K) initial (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h)
      (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) ε t ht := by
  let c := cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h
  have hp := final_witness_preservation initial hw proxy opt he ε hε.le hε1 n hbudget h hh
  exact euclidean_apc_fixed_lift c.points c.weights (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le)
    (cost initial.points initial.weights) opt (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) opt)
    (fun u=>by simpa only [one_mul] using hoptimal u) ε hε hε1 t ht htε
    (fun u hu=>hp u (Or.inl hu)) (hp opt (Or.inr rfl))

APC.EuclideanIteration.compression.source:
theorem compression (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=E) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → E) (hoptimal : Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) 1 opt)
    (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n) (hδ1 : ∀ n,δ n≤1)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c,(∀ j,0<c.weights j)→Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (ht : 0<t) (htε : (t:ℝ)⁻¹≤ε/10)
    (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h=>
      ¬SummaryAPC (K:=K) initial (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h)
        (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) ε t ht)≤errorBudget δ n := by
  have hb := all_stages_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hδ1 ht hproxy n
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad hgood
  exact hbad (summary_apc_of_good initial hw proxy opt hoptimal (fun i=>(he i).le)
    ε hε hε1 ht htε n hbudget h hgood)

end

/-- A concrete factor-four proxy obtained by finite support search. Its
correctness is verified; its preprocessing cost is not near-linear. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.searchProxy.doc: A concrete factor-four proxy obtained by finite support search. Its correctness is verified; its preprocessing cost is not near-linear.
APC.EuclideanIteration.searchProxy.source:
def searchProxy {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=E) N 4 e δ t :=
  fun n c=>MetricIteration.supportCenters c

APC.EuclideanIteration.searchProxy_spec.source:
theorem searchProxy_spec {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ n c,(∀ j,0<c.weights j)→Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) 4
      (searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t n c) := by
  intro n c hw
  exact MetricIteration.supportSearch_approximate c (fun i=>(hw i).le)

/-- Unconditional Euclidean approximation and size theorem, for arbitrary
k and unrestricted real inner-product spaces. It uses an alternative
iterative construction, not the paper's unverified strong-coreset primitive.
The lift is fixed independently of the approximation factor and solution. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.unconditional_euc.doc: Unconditional Euclidean approximation and size theorem, for arbitrary k and unrestricted real inner-product spaces. It uses an alternative iterative construction, not the paper's unverified strong-coreset primitive. The lift is fixed independently of the approximation factor and solution.
APC.EuclideanIteration.unconditional_euc.source:
theorem unconditional_euclidean_apc
    {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
    let ht := (liftingWitnessCount_valid ε hε).1
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
    let n := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    (size N (t*Fintype.card K) 4 e δ n:ℝ)≤metricSizeGamma (t*Fintype.card K) 4 ε*14400^2 ∧
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h=>
      ¬SummaryAPC (K:=K) initial (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h)
        (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) ε t ht)≤1/2 := by
  dsimp only
  let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
  let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
  let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
  let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
  have ht := liftingWitnessCount_valid ε hε
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  refine ⟨MetricIteration.terminal_size_bound N (t*Fintype.card K) (Nat.mul_pos ht.1 Fintype.card_pos)
    4 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1,?_⟩
  exact (compression initial hw proxy (euclideanOptimal initial.points initial.weights)
    (euclideanOptimal_spec initial.points initial.weights (fun i=>(hw i).le)) (by norm_num)
    (MetricIteration.scheduledError_pos N ε hε) (MetricIteration.scheduledError_le_one N ε hε1)
    (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_pos N) (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_le_one N)
    (searchProxy_spec N e δ t) ε hε hε1 ht.1 ht.2 (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le)).trans (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_budget N)

end APC.EuclideanIteration

APC.euclidean_compression.doc: Probabilistic Euclidean APC compression of a supplied strong coreset. All second-stage sampling and lifting guarantees are proved. The supplied strong-coreset guarantee is an explicit premise, corresponding to the paper's separate Theorem 2.1 primitive.
APC.euclidean_compression.source:
theorem euclidean_compression
    {B K E : Type*} [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ s,0≤original s)
    (opt proxy : K → E) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hstrong : ∀ s,Preserves (original s) (cost b w s) (ε/100))
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost b w) a proxy)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 0<t) (htε : (t:ℝ)⁻¹≤ε/10)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m)
    (hstructSize : (48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (m:ℝ)*((ε/100)/(23+22*a))^2)
    (hresidualSize : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+
      (t*Fintype.card K:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B))≤
      (m:ℝ)*((ε/100)/(23+22*a))^2) :
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun sample=>∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → E),0≤α ∧
      Approximate (cost (sampledPoints b m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample)) α s ∧
      ¬∃ out : K → E,out∈witnessFamily b t ∧ original out≤α*(1+ε)*original opt)≤δ := by
  classical
  let F : Finset (K → E) := insert opt (witnessFamily b t)
  let Query := {s : K → E // s∈F}
  have hcard : Fintype.card Query=F.card := Fintype.card_coe F
  have hN : 0<F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨opt,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  have hB : 0<Fintype.card B := Fintype.card_pos
  have hNQ : 0<Fintype.card Query := by rw [hcard];exact hN
  have hcount : F.card≤Fintype.card B^(t*Fintype.card K)+1 := card_witnessFamily_with_opt b t opt
  have hlog := log_solution_count F.card (Fintype.card B) (t*Fintype.card K) hN hB hcount (δ/2) (by positivity)
  have hbudget : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*Real.log (4*(Fintype.card Query:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (m:ℝ)*((ε/100)/(23+22*a))^2 := by
    rw [hcard]
    have harg₁ : 2*(F.card:ℝ)/(δ/2)=4*(F.card:ℝ)/δ := by ring
    have harg₂ : (4:ℝ)/(δ/2)=8/δ := by ring
    rw [harg₁,harg₂] at hlog
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity)).trans hresidualSize
  have hb := finite_family_coreset b w hw proxy (fun q : Query=>q.val) a (ε/100) δ ha
    (by positivity) (by linarith) hδ hNQ (fun q=>hproxy q.val) m hm hstructSize hbudget
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i=>(sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i).le
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono (drawWeight p m) (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro sample hs
  obtain ⟨α,s,hα,happrox,hno⟩ := hs
  by_contra hgood
  have hsecond : ∀ c∈witnessFamily (K:=K) b t,
      Preserves (cost b w c) (cost (sampledPoints b m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) c) (ε/100) := by
    intro c hc
    exact of_not_not (fun hh=>hgood ⟨⟨c,Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hc⟩,hh⟩)
  have hopt : Preserves (cost b w opt)
      (cost (sampledPoints b m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) opt) (ε/100) :=
    of_not_not (fun hh=>hgood ⟨⟨opt,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩,hh⟩)
  letI : NeZero m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hm⟩
  have hout := euclidean_two_stage (sampledPoints b m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample)
    (sampledWeights_nonneg w p (fun i=>(hw i).le) hp m sample) b (drawIndex m sample) (fun _=>rfl)
    original (cost b w) hnonneg opt s α ε hα hε hε1 happrox t ht htε hstrong hsecond hopt
  exact hno hout

end APC

APC.euclideanCubicBase.doc: Explicit inverse-cubic envelope, with conservative absolute constants.

APC.euclideanCubicSize.source:
def euclideanCubicSize (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp 16*euclideanCubicBase k ε*(1+Real.log (euclideanCubicBase k ε))*14400^2

/-- The only extra center-count factor is the lifting witness length,
which is at most 32/ε. Hence the actual envelope is inverse-cubic. -/

APC.euclideanCubicBase_dominates.doc: The only extra center-count factor is the lifting witness length, which is at most 32/ε. Hence the actual envelope is inverse-cubic.
APC.euclideanCubicBase_dominates.source:
theorem euclideanCubicBase_dominates (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    metricSizeBase (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*k) 4 ε≤euclideanCubicBase k ε := by
  let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
  have ht := liftingSampleCount_scaled_upper ε hε hε1
  have htε : (t:ℝ)*ε≤32 := (le_div_iff₀ hε).mp ht
  have hkR : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htε (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0:ℝ)≤k)
  have hεk : ε≤(k:ℝ) := by linarith
  have he : metricSizeBase (t*k) 4 ε*ε^3=
      12321*(1537*ε+1584*(t:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)*ε) := by
    unfold metricSizeBase
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  unfold euclideanCubicBase
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hε 3)).2
  change metricSizeBase (t*k) 4 ε*ε^3≤_
  nlinarith only [he,hprod,hεk]

APC.euclideanCubicSize_dominates.source:
theorem euclideanCubicSize_dominates (k : ℕ) (hk : 0<k)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    metricSizeGamma (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*k) 4 ε*14400^2≤euclideanCubicSize k ε := by
  let H := metricSizeBase (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*k) 4 ε
  let J := euclideanCubicBase k ε
  have hH : 1≤H := (metricSizeBase_bounds _ 4 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1).1
  have hHp : 0<H := by linarith
  have hHJ : H≤J := euclideanCubicBase_dominates k hk ε hε hε1
  have hJ : 0≤J := by linarith
  have hlog : 1+Real.log H≤1+Real.log J := add_le_add_left (Real.log_le_log hHp hHJ) 1
  have hT : 0≤1+Real.log H := by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hH]
  have hh := mul_le_mul hHJ hlog hT hJ
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (Real.exp_pos 16).le) (sq_nonneg (14400:ℝ))
  simpa only [metricSizeGamma,euclideanCubicSize,H,J,mul_assoc] using hm

end APC
namespace APC.EuclideanIteration
local instance (T : Type*) : DecidableEq T := Classical.decEq T
open MetricIteration (Cloud size outcomes)

/-- Final unconditional approximation-and-size theorem. The finite input
is compressed to a positive weighted sample of its own points, with a fixed
summary-only lift valid for all approximation factors and solutions. No
strong-coreset, concentration, geometry, or proxy theorem is assumed. This
alternative iterative algorithm does not verify the paper's fast two-stage
preprocessing implementation. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.euclidean_approxi.doc: Final unconditional approximation-and-size theorem. The finite input is compressed to a positive weighted sample of its own points, with a fixed summary-only lift valid for all approximation factors and solutions. No strong-coreset, concentration, geometry, or proxy theorem is assumed. This alternative iterative algorithm does not verify the paper's fast two-stage preprocessing implementation.
APC.EuclideanIteration.euclidean_approxi.source:
theorem euclidean_approximation_preserving_coreset
    {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
    let ht := (liftingWitnessCount_valid ε hε).1
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
    let n := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    (size N (t*Fintype.card K) 4 e δ n:ℝ)≤euclideanCubicSize (Fintype.card K) ε ∧
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h=>
      ¬SummaryAPC (K:=K) initial (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h)
        (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) ε t ht)≤1/2 := by
  have hb := unconditional_euclidean_apc (K:=K) N initial hw ε hε hε1
  exact ⟨hb.1.trans (euclideanCubicSize_dominates (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos ε hε hε1),hb.2⟩

/-- Actual returned centers with the same explicit inverse-cubic size bound. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.euclidean_randomi.doc: Actual returned centers with the same explicit inverse-cubic size bound.
APC.EuclideanIteration.euclidean_randomi.source:
theorem euclidean_randomized_apc
    {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (α ε : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (solve : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*Fintype.card K) 4
      (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N))
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ h,
      let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
      let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
      let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
      let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
      let c := cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) h
      Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α (solve h)) :
    let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
    let n := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
    let liftLaw := fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h).points
      (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (solve h) t r
    (size N (t*Fintype.card K) 4 e δ n:ℝ)≤euclideanCubicSize (Fintype.card K) ε ∧
    eventMass (kernelWeight (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) liftLaw)
      (fun sample=>¬Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) (α*(1+ε))
        (randomLift (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n sample.1).points
          (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n sample.1).weights (solve sample.1) t r sample.2))≤2/3 := by
  have hb := unconditional_randomized_euclidean_apc N initial hw α ε hα hε hε1 solve hsolve
  exact ⟨hb.1.trans (euclideanCubicSize_dominates (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos ε hε hε1),hb.2⟩

end APC.EuclideanIteration

APC.EuclideanIteration.sample_pos.source:
theorem sample_pos {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (c : Cloud I X) (hc : ∀ i,0<c.weights i) (proxy : K → X)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) (z : Draws I m) : ∀ j,0<(sample c proxy m z).weights j := by
  exact sampledWeights_pos c.weights (probability c proxy) hc
    (sensitivityProbability_pos _ _ _ hc (fun i => sq_nonneg _)) m hm z

variable (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ)

APC.EuclideanIteration.Proxy.source: abbrev Proxy := (n : ℕ) → Cloud (Fin (size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ n)) X → K → X

APC.EuclideanIteration.cloud.source:
def cloud (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t) :
    (n : ℕ) → Adaptive.History (outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ) n →
      Cloud (Fin (size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ n)) X
  | 0, _ => initial
  | n+1, h => sample (cloud initial proxy n h.1) (proxy n (cloud initial proxy n h.1))
      (size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ (n+1)) h.2

variable {N a e δ t}

APC.EuclideanIteration.cloud_pos.source:
theorem cloud_pos [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ h j,0<(cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights j := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; exact hw
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    exact sample_pos _ (ih h.1) _ _ (size_pos _ _ _ _ _ _) h.2

/-- Every retained point comes from the original input, on every history. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.cloud_support_sub.doc: Every retained point comes from the original input, on every history.
APC.EuclideanIteration.cloud_support_sub.source:
theorem cloud_support_subset [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ h,Set.range (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points⊆Set.range initial.points := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h;exact Set.Subset.refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    exact (sampledPoints_range_subset (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h.1).points _ h.2).trans (ih h.1)

APC.EuclideanIteration.transition.source:
def transition (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t)
    (n : ℕ) (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ) n) :
    outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ n → ℝ :=
  drawWeight (probability (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h)
    (proxy n (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h))) (size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ (n+1))

APC.EuclideanIteration.transition_nonneg.source:
theorem transition_nonneg [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t) :
    ∀ n h z,0≤transition initial proxy n h z := by
  intro n h z
  exact drawWeight_nonneg _
    (fun i => (sensitivityProbability_pos _ _ _ (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h)
      (fun i => sq_nonneg _) i).le) _ z

APC.EuclideanIteration.transition_sum.source:
theorem transition_sum [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t) :
    ∀ n h,∑ z,transition initial proxy n h z=1 := by
  intro n h
  exact drawWeight_sum _ (sensitivityProbability_sum _ _ _ (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h)) _

APC.EuclideanIteration.good.source:
def good (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → X) (n : ℕ) (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (z : outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ n) : Prop :=
  let c := cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h
  let c' := sample c (proxy n c) (size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ (n+1)) z
  EuclideanStep c.points c.weights c'.points c'.weights opt t (e n)

/-- Every conditional stage bound follows from sensitivity sampling with
the prescribed integer count, after an arbitrary previous history. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.good_failure.doc: Every conditional stage bound follows from sensitivity sampling with the prescribed integer count, after an arbitrary previous history.
APC.EuclideanIteration.good_failure.source:
theorem good_failure [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n) (hδ1 : ∀ n,δ n≤1) (ht : 0<t)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) → Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c)) :
    ∀ n h,eventMass (transition initial proxy n h) (fun z => ¬good initial proxy opt n h z) ≤ δ n := by
  intro n h
  let c := cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h
  have hc := cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h
  have hb := euclidean_step_kernel c.points c.weights hc (proxy n c) opt t ht a
    (e n) (δ n) ha (he n) (he1 n) (hδ n) (hδ1 n) (hproxy n c hc)
  dsimp only at hb
  have hI : Fintype.card (Fin (size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ n))=size N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ n := Fintype.card_fin _
  rw [hI] at hb
  exact hb

APC.EuclideanIteration.all_stages_failur.source:
theorem all_stages_failure [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n) (hδ1 : ∀ n,δ n≤1) (ht : 0<t)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) → Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (n : ℕ) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n)
      (fun h => ¬Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h) ≤ errorBudget δ n := by
  exact Adaptive.adaptive_failure_bound _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy)
    (transition_sum initial hw proxy) _ δ (fun n => (hδ n).le)
    (fun n h _ => good_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hδ1 ht hproxy n h) n

/-- Deterministic bounds for every query supported by the final summary,
or equal to the original optimum, on a good adaptive history. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.chain_bounds.doc: Deterministic bounds for every query supported by the final summary, or equal to the original optimum, on a good adaptive history.
APC.EuclideanIteration.chain_bounds.source:
theorem chain_bounds [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤1/2) :
    ∀ h,Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h → ∀ s,
      (s∈witnessFamily (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points t ∨ s=opt) →
      let q := cost (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights s
      (1-errorBudget e n)*cost initial.points initial.weights s≤q ∧
        (1-errorBudget e n)*q≤cost initial.points initial.weights s := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h hh s hs; simp [cloud,errorBudget]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h hh s hs
    have hrec : errorBudget e (n+1)=errorBudget e n+e n := Finset.sum_range_succ e n
    have hS := errorBudget_nonneg e he n
    have hbn : errorBudget e n≤1/2 := by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith [he n]
    have hen : e n≤1/2 := by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith
    change Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h.1 ∧ good initial proxy opt n h.1 h.2 at hh
    let c := cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h.1
    have hs' : s∈witnessFamily c.points t ∨ s=opt := by
      rcases hs with hs | hs
      · exact Or.inl (witnessFamily_mono (sampledPoints c.points _ h.2) c.points
          (drawIndex _ h.2) (fun _=>rfl) t s hs)
      · exact Or.inr hs
    obtain ⟨hlo,hup⟩ := ih hbn h.1 hh.1 s hs'
    obtain ⟨hnextlo,hnexthi⟩ := hh.2 s hs'
    have hc0 := cost_nonneg initial.points initial.weights (fun i => (hw i).le) s
    have hcn := cost_nonneg c.points c.weights (fun i => (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h.1 i).le) s
    change (1-errorBudget e (n+1))*cost initial.points initial.weights s ≤
        cost (sample c (proxy n c) _ h.2).points (sample c (proxy n c) _ h.2).weights s ∧ _
    rw [hrec]
    constructor
    · have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo (by linarith : 0≤1-e n)
      have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (he n) hS) hc0
      nlinarith only [hm,hnextlo,hx]
    · have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnexthi
        (by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith : 0≤1-(errorBudget e n+e n))
      have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (he n) (add_nonneg hS (he n))) hcn
      dsimp only [c, cloud] at hm hup hx ⊢
      nlinarith only [hm,hup,hx]

APC.EuclideanIteration.chain_preserves.source:
theorem chain_preserves [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤1/2) :
    ∀ h,Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h → ∀ s,
      (s∈witnessFamily (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points t ∨ s=opt) →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights s)
        (cost (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights s)
        (2*errorBudget e n) := by
  intro h hh s hs
  obtain ⟨hlo,hup⟩ := chain_bounds initial hw proxy opt he n hbudget h hh s hs
  have hc0 := cost_nonneg initial.points initial.weights (fun i => (hw i).le) s
  have hcn := cost_nonneg (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points
    (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (fun i => (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) s
  have hS := errorBudget_nonneg e he n
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hS hc0]
  · have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hup (by positivity : 0≤1+2*errorBudget e n)
    have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS (by linarith : 0≤1-2*errorBudget e n)) hcn
    nlinarith only [hm,hx]


end
end APC.EuclideanIteration

APC.assignmentCenters.source:
def assignmentCenters (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) : K → E :=
  fun j=>mean x (clusterWeight w a j)

/-- Exact centroids of the nearest-center clusters improve every tuple,
including empty clusters, so an optimum exists without compactness. -/

APC.assignmentCenters_improve.doc: Exact centroids of the nearest-center clusters improve every tuple, including empty clusters, so an optimum exists without compactness.
APC.assignmentCenters_improve.source:
theorem assignmentCenters_improve (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (s : K → E) :
    cost x w (assignmentCenters x w (fun i=>nearest s (x i)))≤cost x w s := by
  let a := fun i=>nearest s (x i)
  have hc : ∀ j,oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (assignmentCenters x w a j)≤
      oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (s j) := by
    intro j
    have hv := clusterWeight_nonneg w a hw j
    by_cases hz : mass (clusterWeight w a j)=0
    · rw [oneCost_zero_mass x _ hv hz,oneCost_zero_mass x _ hv hz]
    · exact mean_minimizes x _ hv hz (s j)
  calc
    _≤∑ i,w i*dist (x i) (assignmentCenters x w a (a i))^2 := cost_le_assigned x w hw _ a
    _=∑ j,oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (assignmentCenters x w a j) := (cluster_cost_sum _ _ _ _).symm
    _≤∑ j,oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (s j) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=>hc j)
    _=cost x w s := by rw [cluster_cost_sum];rfl

APC.euclideanOptimal_spec.source:
theorem euclideanOptimal_spec (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) :
    Approximate (cost x w) 1 (euclideanOptimal (K:=K) x w) := by
  intro s
  have hh := (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (fun a : I → K=>cost x w (assignmentCenters x w a)) Finset.univ_nonempty)).2
      (fun i=>nearest s (x i)) (Finset.mem_univ _)
  exact (by simpa only [one_mul] using hh.trans (assignmentCenters_improve x w hw s))

end APC

APC.EuclideanIteration.randomized_compre.doc: Actual randomized lifting after the iterative Euclidean sampler. The solver and lifting law may depend on the entire sampling history.
APC.EuclideanIteration.randomized_compre.source:
theorem randomized_compression (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=E) N a e δ t)
    (opt : K → E) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n) (hδ1 : ∀ n,δ n≤1)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c,(∀ j,0<c.weights j)→Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (α ε : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (ht : 0<t)
    (htε : 3≤(t:ℝ)*(ε/10)) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (solve : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (t*Fintype.card K) a e δ) n → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ h,Approximate
      (cost (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights) α (solve h)) :
    let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
    let liftLaw := fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points
      (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (solve h) t r
    eventMass (kernelWeight (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) liftLaw)
      (fun sample=>α*(1+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt<cost initial.points initial.weights
        (randomLift (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n sample.1).points
          (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n sample.1).weights (solve sample.1) t r sample.2))≤
      1/3+(1-1/3)*errorBudget δ n := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
  let liftLaw := fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points
    (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (solve h) t r
  have hfirst := all_stages_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hδ1 ht hproxy n
  apply kernel_event_bound_sharp _ liftLaw
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n)
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_sum _ (transition_sum initial hw proxy) n)
    (fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) _ t r)
    (fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw_sum _ _ _ t r)
    (Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n)
    (fun h z=>α*(1+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt<cost initial.points initial.weights
      (randomLift (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).points
        (cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (solve h) t r z)) (errorBudget δ n) (1/3)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hfirst
  intro h hh
  let c := cloud N a e δ t initial proxy n h
  have hp := final_witness_preservation initial hw proxy opt (fun i=>(he i).le)
    ε hε.le hε1 n hbudget h hh
  exact (randomized_apc_failure c.points c.weights (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le)
    (cost initial.points initial.weights) opt (solve h) α ε hα hε hε1
    (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) opt) (hsolve h) t r ht htε
    (fun u hu=>hp u (Or.inl hu)) (hp opt (Or.inr rfl))).trans (liftingRepetitions_bound _)

end

/-- Unconditional returned-center guarantee for arbitrary-k Euclidean APCs,
using the alternative iterative sampler. No strong-coreset or proxy oracle
is assumed. The only solver premise is its stated approximation guarantee
on the final summary. The size is independent of input cardinality and
ambient dimension, and the actual returned-center success is at least 1/3. -/

APC.EuclideanIteration.unconditional_ran.doc: Unconditional returned-center guarantee for arbitrary-k Euclidean APCs, using the alternative iterative sampler. No strong-coreset or proxy oracle is assumed. The only solver premise is its stated approximation guarantee on the final summary. The size is independent of input cardinality and ambient dimension, and the actual returned-center success is at least 1/3.
APC.EuclideanIteration.unconditional_ran.source:
theorem unconditional_randomized_euclidean_apc
    {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) E)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (α ε : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (solve : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*Fintype.card K) 4
      (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N))
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ h,
      let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
      let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
      let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
      let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
      let c := cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) h
      Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α (solve h)) :
