    let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
    let n := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
    let liftLaw := fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h).points
      (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (solve h) t r
    (size N (t*Fintype.card K) 4 e δ n:ℝ)≤metricSizeGamma (t*Fintype.card K) 4 ε*14400^2 ∧
    eventMass (kernelWeight (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) liftLaw)
      (fun sample=>¬Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) (α*(1+ε))
        (randomLift (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n sample.1).points
          (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n sample.1).weights (solve sample.1) t r sample.2))≤2/3 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let t := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
  let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
  let δ := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N
  let proxy := searchProxy (K:=K) (E:=E) N e δ t
  let n := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
  let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
  let liftLaw := fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h).points
    (cloud N 4 e δ t initial proxy n h).weights (solve h) t r
  let opt := euclideanOptimal (K:=K) initial.points initial.weights
  have ho := euclideanOptimal_spec (K:=K) initial.points initial.weights (fun i=>(hw i).le)
  have ht := liftingSampleCount_valid (ε/10) (by positivity)
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  have hb := randomized_compression initial hw proxy opt (by norm_num)
    (MetricIteration.scheduledError_pos N ε hε) (MetricIteration.scheduledError_le_one N ε hε1)
    (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_pos N) (MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_le_one N)
    (searchProxy_spec N e δ t) α ε hα hε hε1 ht.1 ht.2 n
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le) solve hsolve
  have hfail : 1/3+(1-1/3)*errorBudget δ n≤(2:ℝ)/3 := by
    have hh := MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_budget N
    change errorBudget δ n≤1/2 at hh
    linarith
  refine ⟨MetricIteration.terminal_size_bound N (t*Fintype.card K)
    (Nat.mul_pos ht.1 Fintype.card_pos) 4 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1,?_⟩
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (kernelWeight_nonneg _ liftLaw
      (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n)
      (fun h=>liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) _ t r)) _ _ ?_)
    (hb.trans hfail)
  intro sample hbad
  by_contra hn
  apply hbad
  intro u
  have hopt : cost initial.points initial.weights opt≤cost initial.points initial.weights u := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using ho u
  exact (le_of_not_gt hn).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hopt (by positivity))

end APC.EuclideanIteration

APC.polynomialLogBudget.doc: Logarithmic budget for a first-stage cardinality at most C k^p (1/ε)^q. It is independent of the original input cardinality.
APC.polynomialLogBudget.source:
def polynomialLogBudget (k : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1+Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)+Real.log C+(p:ℝ)*Real.log k+(q:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε)

APC.witnessCompressionCount.source:
def witnessCompressionCount (k B t : ℕ) (a ε δ : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  budgetSampleCount ((48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(t*k:ℕ)*Real.log B))
    ((ε/100)/(23+22*a))

APC.log_polynomial_cardinality.source:
theorem log_polynomial_cardinality (k B : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 1≤C) (hε : 0<ε)
    (hsize : (B:ℝ)≤C*(k:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q) :
    Real.log (B:ℝ) ≤ Real.log C+(p:ℝ)*Real.log k+(q:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) := by
  have hkp : (0:ℝ)<k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk
  have hCp : 0<C := by linarith
  have hep : 0<1/ε := by positivity
  have h := Real.log_le_log (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hB) hsize
  rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hCp (pow_pos hkp _)))
    (ne_of_gt (pow_pos hep _)),Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hCp)
    (ne_of_gt (pow_pos hkp _)),Real.log_pow,Real.log_pow] at h
  exact h

APC.polynomialLogBudget_bounds.source:
theorem polynomialLogBudget_bounds (k B : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hB : 0<B) (hC : 1≤C) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) (hsize : (B:ℝ)≤C*(k:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q) :
    1≤polynomialLogBudget k C p q ε δ ∧
    Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)≤polynomialLogBudget k C p q ε δ ∧
    Real.log (8/δ)≤polynomialLogBudget k C p q ε δ ∧
    Real.log (B:ℝ)≤polynomialLogBudget k C p q ε δ := by
  have hkr : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hlogk : 0≤Real.log (k:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hkr
  have hlogC : 0≤Real.log C := Real.log_nonneg hC
  have hloge : 0≤Real.log (1/ε) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by linarith))
  have hlogd : 0≤Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith))
  have hpoly := log_polynomial_cardinality k B C p q ε hk hB hC hε hsize
  have hlog8 : Real.log (8/δ)≤Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hδ.le
  unfold polynomialLogBudget
  have hp : 0≤(p:ℝ)*Real.log k := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hlogk
  have hq : 0≤(q:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hloge
  exact ⟨by linarith,by linarith,by linarith,by linarith⟩

/-- Exact inverse-cubic bound after substituting a supplied polynomial
first-stage size. This proves no first-stage construction. -/

APC.witnessCompressionCount_polynomial_b.doc: Exact inverse-cubic bound after substituting a supplied polynomial first-stage size. This proves no first-stage construction.
APC.witnessCompressionCount_polynomial_b.source:
theorem witnessCompressionCount_polynomial_bound
    (k B t : ℕ) (a c C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hB : 0<B) (ha : 0<a) (hc : 0≤c) (hC : 1≤C)
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1)
    (ht : (t:ℝ)≤c/ε) (hsize : (B:ℝ)≤C*(k:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q) :
    (witnessCompressionCount k B t a ε δ:ℝ) < euclideanSizeEnvelope k a c C p q ε δ := by
  let L := polynomialLogBudget k C p q ε δ
  let R := 4*(64*a+8*a^2)
  let D := 23+22*a
  have hL := polynomialLogBudget_bounds k B C p q ε δ hk hB hC hε hε1 hδ hδ1 hsize
  have hLp : 0≤L := by dsimp [L]; linarith [hL.1]
  have hRp : 0≤R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hkp : (0:ℝ)<k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk
  have hkr : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hratio : 1≤(k:ℝ)/ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by linarith)
  have hlogB : 0≤Real.log (B:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hB)
  have hlog8 : 0≤Real.log (8/δ) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by linarith))
  let S := (48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)
  let Q := R*(Real.log (8/δ)+(t*k:ℕ)*Real.log B)
  have hS : 0≤S := by
    dsimp [S]
    apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    exact Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith [show (1:ℝ)≤k by exact_mod_cast hk]))
  have hQ : 0≤Q := by dsimp [Q]; positivity
  have ht' : (t*k:ℕ)≤c*((k:ℝ)/ε) := by
    push_cast
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht hkp.le
    calc
      (t:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)≤c/ε*(k:ℝ) := hh
      _=c*((k:ℝ)/ε) := by ring
  have htk := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht' hlogB
  have hBL := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL.2.2.2
    (mul_nonneg hc (div_nonneg hkp.le hε.le))
  have h8L := hL.2.2.1
  have hratioL := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio hLp
  have hres : Q≤R*(1+c)*((k:ℝ)/ε)*L := by
    calc
      Q≤R*((1+c)*((k:ℝ)/ε)*L) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by
        change Real.log (8/δ)+(t*k:ℕ)*Real.log B≤_
        nlinarith only [htk,hBL,h8L,hratioL]) hRp
      _=_ := by ring
  have hS0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL.2.1 (by positivity : 0≤48*(k:ℝ))
  have hS1 : (k:ℝ)≤(k:ℝ)/ε := (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hS2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS1 hLp
  have hsum : S+Q≤(48+(1+c)*R)*((k:ℝ)/ε)*L := by
    dsimp [S]
    nlinarith only [hS0,hS2,hres]
  have hz : (ε/100)/D≠0 := ne_of_gt (div_pos (by positivity) (by dsimp [D]; linarith))
  have hb := budgetSampleCount_upper S Q ((ε/100)/D) hS hQ hz
  have hscale : (S+Q)/((ε/100)/D)^2≤
      10000*D^2*(48+(1+c)*R)*(k:ℝ)*L/ε^3 := by
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum (sq_nonneg ((ε/100)/D))
    calc
      _ ≤ ((48+(1+c)*R)*((k:ℝ)/ε)*L)/((ε/100)/D)^2 := hdiv
      _ = _ := by field_simp; ring
  change (budgetSampleCount S Q ((ε/100)/D):ℝ)<_
  change (budgetSampleCount S Q ((ε/100)/D):ℝ)<
    10000*D^2*(48+(1+c)*R)*(k:ℝ)*L/ε^3+2
  linarith only [hb,hscale]

/-- Ceiling rounding for the means actually sampled by randomized lifting. -/

APC.liftingSampleCount_scaled_upper.doc: Ceiling rounding for the means actually sampled by randomized lifting.
APC.liftingSampleCount_scaled_upper.source:
theorem liftingSampleCount_scaled_upper (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    (liftingSampleCount (ε/10):ℝ)≤32/ε := by
  have hh := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity : 0≤3/(ε/10))
  have he : (liftingSampleCount (ε/10):ℝ)=(Nat.ceil (3/(ε/10)):ℝ)+1 := by simp [liftingSampleCount]
  rw [he]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).2
  have h := (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hh hε)
  have hid : (3/(ε/10))*ε=30 := by field_simp; ring
  rw [add_mul,hid] at h
  nlinarith

/-- Deterministic-lifting compression count after a polynomial strong input. -/

APC.compressionSampleCount_polynomial_bo.doc: Deterministic-lifting compression count after a polynomial strong input.
APC.compressionSampleCount_polynomial_bo.source:
theorem compressionSampleCount_polynomial_bound
    (k B : ℕ) (a C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hB : 0<B) (ha : 0<a) (hC : 1≤C)
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1)
    (hsize : (B:ℝ)≤C*(k:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q) :
    (compressionSampleCount k B a ε δ:ℝ)<euclideanSizeEnvelope k a 12 C p q ε δ :=
  witnessCompressionCount_polynomial_bound k B (meanSampleCount ε) a 12 C p q ε δ
    hk hB ha (by norm_num) hC hε hε1 hδ hδ1 (meanSampleCount_upper ε hε hε1) hsize

/-- Randomized-lifting compression count, with the larger actual witness
length and all ceiling roundings accounted for. -/

APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount_pol.doc: Randomized-lifting compression count, with the larger actual witness length and all ceiling roundings accounted for.
APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount_pol.source:
theorem randomizedCompressionSampleCount_polynomial_bound
    (k B : ℕ) (a C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hB : 0<B) (ha : 0<a) (hC : 1≤C)
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1)
    (hsize : (B:ℝ)≤C*(k:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q) :
    (randomizedCompressionSampleCount k B a ε δ:ℝ)<euclideanSizeEnvelope k a 32 C p q ε δ :=
  witnessCompressionCount_polynomial_bound k B (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)) a 32 C p q ε δ
    hk hB ha (by norm_num) hC hε hε1 hδ hδ1 (liftingSampleCount_scaled_upper ε hε hε1) hsize

end APC

APC.EuclideanStep.doc: Preservation is required only for means of t input points and one fixed reference optimum; no strong-coreset premise is used.
APC.EuclideanStep.source:
def EuclideanStep {I J K E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (y : J → E) (v : J → ℝ) (opt : K → E) (t : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s,s∈witnessFamily (K:=K) x t ∨ s=opt → Preserves (cost x w s) (cost y v s) η

/-- Enlarging the structural center-count budget pays for the t-point
witness family. This deliberately oversamples by at most a t factor. -/

APC.euclidean_step_kernel.doc: Enlarging the structural center-count budget pays for the t-point witness family. This deliberately oversamples by at most a t factor.
APC.euclidean_step_kernel.source:
theorem euclidean_step_kernel
    {I K E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (proxy opt : K → E)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 0<t) (a η δ : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hη : 0<η) (hη1 : η≤1)
    (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) (hproxy : Approximate (cost x w) a proxy) :
    let m := metricStageSampleCount (t*Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card I) a η δ
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun z=>¬EuclideanStep x w (sampledPoints x m z)
      (sampledWeights w p m z) opt t η)≤δ := by
  classical
  let F := insert opt (witnessFamily (K:=K) x t)
  let Query := {s : K → E // s∈F}
  have hcard : Fintype.card Query=F.card := Fintype.card_coe F
  have hN : 0<F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨opt,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  have hcount := card_witnessFamily_with_opt x t opt
  have hlog := log_solution_count F.card (Fintype.card I) (t*Fintype.card K)
    hN Fintype.card_pos hcount (δ/2) (by positivity)
  have he₁ : 2*(F.card:ℝ)/(δ/2)=4*(F.card:ℝ)/δ := by ring
  have he₂ : (4:ℝ)/(δ/2)=8/δ := by ring
  rw [he₁,he₂] at hlog
  have hkk : Fintype.card K≤t*Fintype.card K := by nlinarith
  have hkr : (1:ℝ)≤Fintype.card K := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α:=K)
  have hkkR : (Fintype.card K:ℝ)≤(t*Fintype.card K:ℕ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hkk
  have hlogpos : 0≤Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith))
  have hlogmono : Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ)≤
      Real.log (8*((t*Fintype.card K:ℕ):ℝ)/δ) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hδ.le)
  have hstructmono : 48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ)≤
      48*((t*Fintype.card K:ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (8*((t*Fintype.card K:ℕ):ℝ)/δ) :=
    mul_le_mul (by nlinarith) hlogmono hlogpos (by positivity)
  have hb := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*((t*Fintype.card K:ℕ):ℝ))*Real.log (8*((t*Fintype.card K:ℕ):ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+((t*Fintype.card K:ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (Fintype.card I)))
    (η/(23+22*a)) (by positivity)
  have hres := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity : 0≤4*(64*a+8*a^2))).trans hb.2.2
  rw [←hcard] at hres
  have hsample := finite_family_coreset x w hw proxy (fun q : Query=>q.val) a η δ ha hη hη1 hδ
    (by rw [hcard];exact hN) (fun q=>hproxy q.val) _ hb.1 (hstructmono.trans hb.2.1) hres
  let m := metricStageSampleCount (t*Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card I) a η δ
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (drawWeight_nonneg p (fun i=>(sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i).le) m) _ _ ?_) hsample
  intro z hbad
  by_contra hg
  apply hbad
  intro s hs
  have hmem : s∈F := by
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hs
    · exact hs ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  exact of_not_not (fun hn=>hg ⟨⟨s,hmem⟩,hn⟩)

end APC

APC.proxyCost.source: def proxyCost (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (a : X) : ℝ := ∑ i, w i*(dist (x i) a)^2

APC.pointCost_young.source:
theorem pointCost_young (s : K → X) (x a : X) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ε*|pointCost s x-pointCost s a| ≤
      ε^2*pointCost s a + (1+ε)*(dist x a)^2 := by
  have hb := pointCost_difference s a x
  rw [dist_comm a x, abs_sub_comm] at hb
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hε
  have hy := sq_nonneg (ε*centerDist s a-dist x a)
  change _ ≤ ε^2*(centerDist s a)^2 + _
  nlinarith only [hm,hy]

/-- Deterministic cluster deviation bound, obtained by Young's inequality.
It avoids any nonzero-variance or nonempty-cluster requirement. -/

APC.weighted_center_deviation.doc: Deterministic cluster deviation bound, obtained by Young's inequality. It avoids any nonzero-variance or nonempty-cluster requirement.
APC.weighted_center_deviation.source:
theorem weighted_center_deviation (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (s : K → X) (a : X) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ε*|cost x w s-mass w*pointCost s a| ≤
      ε^2*(mass w*pointCost s a)+(1+ε)*proxyCost x w a := by
  have he : cost x w s-mass w*pointCost s a =
      ∑ i, w i*(pointCost s (x i)-pointCost s a) := by
    simp [cost,mass,mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [he]
  have habs := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
    (fun i => w i*(pointCost s (x i)-pointCost s a)) Finset.univ
  calc
    _ ≤ ε*∑ i, |w i*(pointCost s (x i)-pointCost s a)| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs hε
    _ = ∑ i, w i*(ε*|pointCost s (x i)-pointCost s a|) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (hw i)]
      ring
    _ ≤ ∑ i, w i*(ε^2*pointCost s a+(1+ε)*(dist (x i) a)^2) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (pointCost_young s (x i) a ε hε) (hw i))
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib,proxyCost,mass]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      have hfirst : (∑ i, w i*(ε^2*pointCost s a)) =
          ε^2*((∑ i,w i)*pointCost s a) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]; ring
      rw [hfirst]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring

APC.far_center_deviation.source:
theorem far_center_deviation (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (s : K → X) (a : X) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hfar : proxyCost x w a ≤ ε^2*(mass w*pointCost s a)) :
    |cost x w s-mass w*pointCost s a| ≤ 3*ε*(mass w*pointCost s a) := by
  have hb := weighted_center_deviation x w hw s a ε hε.le
  have hf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfar (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+ε)
  have hH : 0 ≤ mass w*pointCost s a := mul_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hh := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1) (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ε) hH)
  nlinarith only [hb,hf,hh,hε]

/-- Claim A.11 with constant 10. Structural weight/proxy-cost guarantees
are visible premises; no probabilistic conclusion is assumed. -/

APC.far_cluster_cost_preservation.doc: Claim A.11 with constant 10. Structural weight/proxy-cost guarantees are visible premises; no probabilistic conclusion is assumed.
APC.far_cluster_cost_preservation.source:
theorem far_cluster_cost_preservation {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (y : J → X) (v : J → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j)
    (s : K → X) (a : X) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hmass : |mass v-mass w| ≤ ε*mass w)
    (hproxy : proxyCost y v a ≤ (1+ε)*proxyCost x w a)
    (hfar : proxyCost x w a ≤ ε^2*(mass w*pointCost s a)) :
    |cost y v s-cost x w s| ≤ 10*ε*(mass w*pointCost s a) := by
  let H := mass w*pointCost s a
  have hH : 0 ≤ H := mul_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hpc : 0 ≤ pointCost s a := sq_nonneg _
  have hmass_up : mass v ≤ 2*mass w := by
    have hm := (abs_le.mp hmass).2
    have hwM : 0 ≤ mass w := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)
    nlinarith only [hm,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε1 hwM]
  have hcenter_up : mass v*pointCost s a ≤ 2*H := by
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass_up hpc).trans_eq (by dsimp [H];ring)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ proxyCost x w a := Finset.sum_nonneg
    (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (sq_nonneg _))
  have hp_up : proxyCost y v a ≤ 2*ε^2*H := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε1 hp0
    have hf := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfar (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)
    nlinarith only [hproxy,hh,hf]
  have hbnew := weighted_center_deviation y v hv s a ε hε.le
  have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcenter_up (sq_nonneg ε)
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_up (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+ε)
  have h₃ := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1) (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ε) hH)
  have hnew : |cost y v s-mass v*pointCost s a| ≤ 6*ε*H := by
    nlinarith only [hbnew,h₁,h₂,h₃,hε]
  have hold := far_center_deviation x w hw s a ε hε hε1 hfar
  have hmiddle : |mass v*pointCost s a-mass w*pointCost s a| ≤ ε*H := by
    rw [← sub_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hpc]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass hpc
    convert hh using 1 <;> dsimp [H] <;> ring
  have ht₁ := abs_sub_le (cost y v s) (mass v*pointCost s a) (cost x w s)
  have ht₂ := abs_sub_le (mass v*pointCost s a) (mass w*pointCost s a) (cost x w s)
  rw [abs_sub_comm (mass w*pointCost s a) (cost x w s)] at ht₂
  change |cost x w s-mass w*pointCost s a| ≤ 3*ε*H at hold
  nlinarith only [ht₁,ht₂,hnew,hold,hmiddle]

end APC

APC.preserves_iff_abs.source:
theorem preserves_iff_abs (u v ε : ℝ) : Preserves u v ε ↔ |v-u|≤ε*u := by
  unfold Preserves
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂⟩
    constructor <;> nlinarith only [h₁,h₂]
  · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂⟩
    constructor <;> nlinarith only [h₁,h₂]

/-- A finite-family strong-coreset guarantee from the fully verified
sensitivity sampler. For fixed proxy factor a, the two budgets have
orders k ε^-2 log(k/δ) and ε^-2 log(N/δ), respectively. -/

APC.finite_family_coreset.doc: A finite-family strong-coreset guarantee from the fully verified sensitivity sampler. For fixed proxy factor a, the two budgets have orders k ε^-2 log(k/δ) and ε^-2 log(N/δ), respectively.
APC.finite_family_coreset.source:
theorem finite_family_coreset
    {I K Q X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype Q] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (proxy : K → X) (solutions : Q → K → X) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hQ : 0<Fintype.card Q)
    (happrox : ∀ q,cost x w proxy≤a*cost x w (solutions q))
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m)
    (hstructSize : (48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (m:ℝ)*(ε/(23+22*a))^2)
    (hresidualSize : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*Real.log (4*(Fintype.card Q:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (m:ℝ)*(ε/(23+22*a))^2) :
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun sample=>∃ q,¬Preserves (cost x w (solutions q))
      (cost (sampledPoints x m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) (solutions q)) ε)≤δ := by
  let D := 23+22*a
  have hD : 0<D := by dsimp [D];linarith
  have hη : 0<ε/D := div_pos hε hD
  have hη1 : ε/D≤1 := (div_le_iff₀ hD).2 (by dsimp [D];linarith)
  have hb := sensitivity_finite_family x w hw proxy solutions a (ε/D) δ ha hη hη1 hδ hQ
    happrox m hm hstructSize hresidualSize
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i=>(sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i).le
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono (drawWeight p m) (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro sample hs
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨q,?_⟩
  rw [preserves_iff_abs] at hq
  have hradius : (23+22*a)*(ε/D)*cost x w (solutions q)=ε*cost x w (solutions q) := by
    change D*(ε/D)*_= _
    field_simp
  rw [hradius]
  exact lt_of_not_ge hq

end APC

APC.finite_metric_strong_sampling.doc: Strong finite-metric coreset: all ambient center tuples are queried, not merely tuples on the current input support.
APC.finite_metric_strong_sampling.source:
theorem finite_metric_strong_sampling
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (proxy : K → X) (a ε δ : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost x w) a proxy) :
    let m := metricStageSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card X) a ε δ
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun z=>∃ s : K → X,¬Preserves (cost x w s)
      (cost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) s) ε)≤δ := by
  classical
  have hb := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*Real.log (Fintype.card X)))
    (ε/(23+22*a)) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hε (by linarith)))
  have hcount : Fintype.card (K → X)≤Fintype.card X^Fintype.card K+1 := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_fun];omega
  have hlog := log_solution_count (Fintype.card (K → X)) (Fintype.card X)
    (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos Fintype.card_pos hcount (δ/2) (by positivity)
  have he₁ : 2*(Fintype.card (K → X):ℝ)/(δ/2)=4*(Fintype.card (K → X):ℝ)/δ := by ring
  have he₂ : (4:ℝ)/(δ/2)=8/δ := by ring
  rw [he₁,he₂] at hlog
  have hres := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity : 0≤4*(64*a+8*a^2))).trans hb.2.2
  exact finite_family_coreset x w hw proxy (fun s : K → X=>s) a ε δ ha hε hε1 hδ
    Fintype.card_pos (fun s=>hproxy s) _ hb.1 hb.2.1 hres

/-- An exact finite-search proxy removes the approximation-oracle premise.
The theorem is mathematical correctness, without an efficient runtime claim. -/

APC.finite_metric_strong_coreset.doc: An exact finite-search proxy removes the approximation-oracle premise. The theorem is mathematical correctness, without an efficient runtime claim.
APC.finite_metric_strong_coreset.source:
theorem finite_metric_strong_coreset
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (ε δ : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    let proxy := MetricIteration.optimalProxy (K:=K) (MetricIteration.Cloud.mk x w)
    let m := metricStageSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card X) 1 ε δ
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun z=>∃ s : K → X,¬Preserves (cost x w s)
      (cost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) s) ε)≤δ :=
  finite_metric_strong_sampling x w hw _ 1 ε δ (by norm_num) hε hε1 hδ
    (MetricIteration.optimalProxy_spec (K:=K) (MetricIteration.Cloud.mk x w))

/-- An explicit sample bound for the exact-proxy finite-metric theorem.
The logarithmic factor includes k explicitly; no asymptotic convention is used. -/

APC.finite_metric_strong_count_bound.doc: An explicit sample bound for the exact-proxy finite-metric theorem. The logarithmic factor includes k explicitly; no asymptotic convention is used.
APC.finite_metric_strong_count_bound.source:
theorem finite_metric_strong_count_bound (k n : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hn : 0<n) (hε : 0<ε) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    (metricStageSampleCount k n 1 ε δ:ℝ)<
      680400*(k:ℝ)*(Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ))/ε^2+2 := by
  let S := (48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)
  let R := (4*(64*(1:ℝ)+8*1^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(k:ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ))
  have hkr : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hlog : 0≤Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith))
  have hnlog : 0≤Real.log (n:ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  have hlog8 : 0≤Real.log (8/δ) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by linarith))
  have hcomp : Real.log (8/δ)≤Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hδ.le)
  have hklog := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkr hlog
  have hs : 0≤S := by dsimp [S];positivity
  have hr : 0≤R := by dsimp [R];positivity
  have hsum : S+R≤336*(k:ℝ)*(Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [S,R]
    nlinarith only [hcomp,hklog,mul_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤k) hnlog]
  have hb := budgetSampleCount_upper S R (ε/(23+22*(1:ℝ))) hs hr (by positivity)
  have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum (sq_nonneg (ε/(23+22*(1:ℝ))))
  have hid : (336*(k:ℝ)*(Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ)))/(ε/(23+22*(1:ℝ)))^2=
      680400*(k:ℝ)*(Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ))/ε^2 := by ring
  rw [hid] at hh
  exact hb.trans_le (add_le_add_right hh 2)

/-- When k≤n, the extra log k is absorbed into the ambient-size term.
This is the exact-constant form of the finite-metric strong bound. -/

APC.finite_metric_strong_count_bound_le_.doc: When k≤n, the extra log k is absorbed into the ambient-size term. This is the exact-constant form of the finite-metric strong bound.
APC.finite_metric_strong_count_bound_le_.source:
theorem finite_metric_strong_count_bound_le_ambient (k n : ℕ) (ε δ : ℝ)
    (hk : 0<k) (hkn : k≤n) (hε : 0<ε) (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ1 : δ≤1) :
    (metricStageSampleCount k n 1 ε δ:ℝ)<
      1360800*(k:ℝ)*(Real.log (8/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ))/ε^2+2 := by
  have hn : 0<n := hk.trans_le hkn
  have hkp : (0:ℝ)<k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hkp (Nat.cast_le.mpr hkn)
  have hlog8 : 0≤Real.log (8/δ) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by linarith))
  have he : Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)=Real.log (8/δ)+Real.log (k:ℝ) := by
    rw [show 8*(k:ℝ)/δ=(8/δ)*(k:ℝ) by ring,
      Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<8/δ)) (ne_of_gt hkp)]
  have hsum : Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ)≤
      2*(Real.log (8/δ)+Real.log (n:ℝ)) := by rw [he];linarith
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (show 0≤680400*(k:ℝ) by positivity)
  have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hs (sq_nonneg ε)
  have hb := finite_metric_strong_count_bound k n ε δ hk hn hε hδ hδ1
  exact hb.trans_le (add_le_add_right (by convert hd using 1 <;> ring) 2)

end APC

APC.Draws.source:
def Draws (I : Type u) : ℕ → Type u
  | 0 => PUnit
  | m+1 => I × Draws I m

instance drawsFintype (I : Type*) [Fintype I] (m : ℕ) : Fintype (Draws I m) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype PUnit)
  | succ m ih =>
    letI := ih
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (I × Draws I m))

APC.drawWeight.source:
def drawWeight {I : Type*} (p : I → ℝ) : (m : ℕ) → Draws I m → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | m+1, (i, tail) => p i * drawWeight p m tail

APC.drawSum.source:
def drawSum {I E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (v : I → E) :
    (m : ℕ) → Draws I m → E
  | 0, _ => 0
  | m+1, (i, tail) => v i + drawSum v m tail

APC.drawWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem drawWeight_nonneg {I : Type*} (p : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (m : ℕ) : ∀ f : Draws I m, 0 ≤ drawWeight p m f := by
  induction m with
  | zero => intro f; exact zero_le_one
  | succ m ih => intro f; exact mul_nonneg (hp f.1) (ih f.2)

APC.drawWeight_sum.source:
theorem drawWeight_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (p : I → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1) (m : ℕ) : ∑ f, drawWeight p m f = 1 := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Draws, drawWeight]
  | succ m ih =>
    change (∑ f : I × Draws I m, p f.1 * drawWeight p m f.2) = 1
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ih, mul_one]
    exact h1

/-- The exact second moment for m independent draws, before dividing by m². -/

APC.draw_second_moment.doc: The exact second moment for m independent draws, before dividing by m².
APC.draw_second_moment.source:
theorem draw_second_moment {I E : Type*} [Fintype I]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (p : I → ℝ) (v : I → E) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hz : ∑ i, p i • v i = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ f, drawWeight p m f * ‖drawSum v m f‖^2) =
      (m:ℝ) * ∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2 := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Draws, drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    change (∑ f : I × Draws I m,
      (p f.1 * drawWeight p m f.2) * ‖v f.1 + drawSum v m f.2‖^2) = _
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    have he : ∀ tail : Draws I m,
        (∑ i, (p i * drawWeight p m tail) * ‖v i + drawSum v m tail‖^2) =
        drawWeight p m tail * (‖drawSum v m tail‖^2 + ∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2) := by
      intro tail
      calc
        _ = drawWeight p m tail * ∑ i, p i * ‖drawSum v m tail + v i‖^2 := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [add_comm (v i)]
          ring
        _ = _ := by rw [centered_step_average p v h1 hz]
    simp_rw [he, mul_add]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ih, ← Finset.sum_mul, drawWeight_sum p h1]
    push_cast
    ring

APC.eventMass.source:
def eventMass {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Ω → ℝ) (event : Ω → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ω, if event ω then p ω else 0

/-- Markov's inequality on a finite probability space, in a division-free form. -/

APC.finite_markov.doc: Markov's inequality on a finite probability space, in a division-free form.
APC.finite_markov.source:
theorem finite_markov {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (c : ℝ) :
    c * eventMass p (fun ω => c < f ω) ≤ ∑ ω, p ω * f ω := by
  classical
  unfold eventMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro ω _
  split_ifs with h
  · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h) (hp ω)]
  · simp only [mul_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (hp ω) (hf ω)

/-- The 2/3-success estimate for the centered sample sum, including zero
variance. It is the probabilistic ingredient of Lemma 3.3. -/

APC.sample_sum_failure_le_third.doc: The 2/3-success estimate for the centered sample sum, including zero variance. It is the probabilistic ingredient of Lemma 3.3.
APC.sample_sum_failure_le_third.source:
theorem sample_sum_failure_le_third {I E : Type*} [Fintype I]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (p : I → ℝ) (v : I → E) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1) (hz : ∑ i, p i • v i = 0)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun f => 3 * (m:ℝ) * (∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2) < ‖drawSum v m f‖^2) ≤ 1/3 := by
  classical
  let V : ℝ := ∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hp i) (sq_nonneg _))
  have hmoment := draw_second_moment p v h1 hz m
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  by_cases hzV : V = 0
  · have he : ∀ f : Draws I m,
        drawWeight p m f * ‖drawSum v m f‖^2 = 0 := by
      intro f
      have hh : drawWeight p m f * ‖drawSum v m f‖^2 ≤
          ∑ g, drawWeight p m g * ‖drawSum v m g‖^2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun g _ => mul_nonneg
          (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m g) (sq_nonneg ‖drawSum v m g‖)) (Finset.mem_univ f)
      have hzero : (∑ g, drawWeight p m g * ‖drawSum v m g‖^2) = 0 := by
        rw [hmoment]; change (m:ℝ) * V = 0; rw [hzV, mul_zero]
      exact le_antisymm (hzero ▸ hh)
        (mul_nonneg (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m f) (sq_nonneg _))
    have hprob : eventMass (drawWeight p m)
        (fun f => 3 * (m:ℝ) * (∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2) < ‖drawSum v m f‖^2) = 0 := by
      unfold eventMass
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro f _
      split_ifs with h
      · change 3 * (m:ℝ) * V < _ at h
        rw [hzV, mul_zero] at h
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (he f)).resolve_right (ne_of_gt h)
      · rfl
    rw [hprob]; norm_num
  · have hpos : 0 < (m:ℝ) * V := mul_pos hmR (lt_of_le_of_ne hV (Ne.symm hzV))
    have hb := finite_markov (drawWeight p m) (fun f => ‖drawSum v m f‖^2)
      (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) (fun f => sq_nonneg _) (3 * (m:ℝ) * V)
    rw [hmoment] at hb
    change (3 * (m:ℝ) * V) * _ ≤ (m:ℝ) * V at hb
    change eventMass _ (fun f => 3 * (m:ℝ) * V < _) ≤ _
    nlinarith

end APC

APC.mass.source: def mass (w : I → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, w i

APC.oneCost.source:
def oneCost (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (c : E) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, w i * ‖x i - c‖^2

APC.mean.source:
def mean (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) : E :=
  (mass w)⁻¹ • ∑ i, w i • x i

APC.oneCost_nonneg.source:
theorem oneCost_nonneg (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (c : E) : 0 ≤ oneCost x w c :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (sq_nonneg _))

APC.centered_sum.source:
theorem centered_sum (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hm : mass w ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, w i • (x i - mean x w) = 0 := by
  simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul]
  change (∑ i, w i • x i) - mass w • ((mass w)⁻¹ • ∑ i, w i • x i) = 0
  rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hm, one_smul, sub_self]

APC.variance_identity.source:
theorem variance_identity (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hm : mass w ≠ 0) (c : E) :
    oneCost x w c = oneCost x w (mean x w) + mass w * ‖mean x w - c‖^2 := by
  have hz : ∑ i, w i * inner ℝ (x i - mean x w) (mean x w - c) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [← real_inner_smul_left]
    rw [← sum_inner, centered_sum x w hm, inner_zero_left]
  unfold oneCost mass
  calc
    (∑ i, w i * ‖x i - c‖^2) =
        ∑ i, (w i * ‖x i - mean x w‖^2 +
          2 * (w i * inner ℝ (x i - mean x w) (mean x w - c)) +
          w i * ‖mean x w - c‖^2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [show x i - c = (x i - mean x w) + (mean x w - c) by abel,
        norm_add_sq_real]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← Finset.mul_sum, hz, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring

APC.mean_minimizes.source:
theorem mean_minimizes (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hm : mass w ≠ 0) (c : E) :
    oneCost x w (mean x w) ≤ oneCost x w c := by
  rw [variance_identity x w hm c]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)) (sq_nonneg _))

/-- Selecting the trial closest to the weighted mean also selects the least
one-center cost, including the zero-variance case. -/

APC.closest_mean_cost.doc: Selecting the trial closest to the weighted mean also selects the least one-center cost, including the zero-variance case.
APC.closest_mean_cost.source:
theorem closest_mean_cost (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hm : mass w ≠ 0) (a b : E)
    (h : ‖mean x w - a‖^2 ≤ ‖mean x w - b‖^2) :
    oneCost x w a ≤ oneCost x w b := by
  rw [variance_identity x w hm a, variance_identity x w hm b]
  exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i))) _

/-- A zero-mass cluster with nonnegative weights contributes zero cost. -/

APC.oneCost_zero_mass.doc: A zero-mass cluster with nonnegative weights contributes zero cost.
APC.oneCost_zero_mass.source:
theorem oneCost_zero_mass (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hm : mass w = 0) (c : E) :
    oneCost x w c = 0 := by
  have hz : ∀ i, w i = 0 := by
    intro i
    have : w i ≤ mass w := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hw j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact le_antisymm (hm ▸ this) (hw i)
  simp [oneCost, hz]

end APC

and the signed close-residual error imply preservation of the whole cost. -/

APC.global_cost_error.doc: Deterministic global assembly of Appendix A. Structural guarantees and the signed close-residual error imply preservation of the whole cost.
APC.global_cost_error.source:
theorem global_cost_error (x : I → X) (w v : I → ℝ) (proxy s : K → X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hv : ∀ i,0≤v i)
    (a ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (happrox : cost x w proxy≤a*cost x w s)
    (hmass : ∀ j,|groupMass v (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j-
      groupMass w (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j|≤ε*groupMass w (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j)
    (hproxy : ∀ j,groupMass (fun i=>v i*pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j≤
      (1+ε)*groupMass (fun i=>w i*pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j)
    (hresidual : |∑ i,(v i-w i)*closeResidual x proxy s ε
      (clusterDelta w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))) i|≤ε*cost x w s) :
    |cost x v s-cost x w s|≤(23+22*a)*ε*cost x w s := by
  let f : I → K := fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)
  let close := closeGroup w x proxy s ε
  let R : K → ℝ := fun j=>pointCost s (proxy j)
  let W : K → ℝ := groupMass w f
  let B := ∑ j,W j*R j
  have hW : ∀ j,0≤W j := groupMass_nonneg w f hw
  have hR : ∀ j,0≤R j := fun j=>sq_nonneg _
  have hres : |∑ i,(v i-w i)*partitionResidual x f proxy s close i|≤ε*cost x w s := by
    simpa only [partitionResidual,closeResidual,closeGroup,clusterDelta,f,close] using hresidual
  have hcenter : |∑ j,if close j then (groupMass v f j-W j)*R j else 0|≤ε*B := by
    calc
      _≤∑ j,|if close j then (groupMass v f j-W j)*R j else 0| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _≤∑ j,ε*(W j*R j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : close j
        · rw [if_pos hj,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (hR j)]
          have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hmass j) (hR j)
          convert hh using 1 <;> ring
        · rw [if_neg hj,abs_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg hε.le (mul_nonneg (hW j) (hR j))
      _=ε*B := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hfar : |∑ j,if close j then 0 else cost x (fiberWeight v f j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w f j) s|≤10*ε*B := by
    calc
      _≤∑ j,|if close j then 0 else cost x (fiberWeight v f j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w f j) s| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _≤∑ j,10*ε*(W j*R j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : close j
        · rw [if_pos hj,abs_zero]
          exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (mul_nonneg (hW j) (hR j))
        · rw [if_neg hj]
          have hfarj : proxyCost x (fiberWeight w f j) (proxy j)≤ε^2*(W j*R j) := by
            rw [fiber_proxy_cost]
            by_cases hz : W j=0
            · have hzero := groupMass_mul_zero w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) f hw j hz
              change _≤ε^2*(W j*R j)
              rw [hzero,hz]
              simp
            · have hWp : 0<W j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hW j) (Ne.symm hz)
              have hnot : groupMass (fun i=>w i*pointCost proxy (x i)) f j/W j<ε^2*R j :=
                lt_of_not_ge hj
              have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hWp).mp hnot
              nlinarith only [hh]
          have hpj : proxyCost x (fiberWeight v f j) (proxy j)≤(1+ε)*proxyCost x (fiberWeight w f j) (proxy j) := by
            rw [fiber_proxy_cost,fiber_proxy_cost]
            exact hproxy j
          exact far_cluster_cost_preservation x (fiberWeight w f j) x (fiberWeight v f j)
            (fiberWeight_nonneg w f hw j) (fiberWeight_nonneg v f hv j) s (proxy j) ε hε hε1
            (hmass j) hpj hfarj
      _=10*ε*B := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hdecomp := global_error_decomposition x w v f proxy s close
  rw [hdecomp]
  have habs : |(∑ i,(v i-w i)*partitionResidual x f proxy s close i)+
      (∑ j,if close j then (groupMass v f j-W j)*R j else 0)+
      (∑ j,if close j then 0 else cost x (fiberWeight v f j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w f j) s)|≤
      ε*cost x w s+11*ε*B := by
    have h₁ := abs_add_le (∑ i,(v i-w i)*partitionResidual x f proxy s close i)
      (∑ j,if close j then (groupMass v f j-W j)*R j else 0)
    have h₂ := abs_add_le ((∑ i,(v i-w i)*partitionResidual x f proxy s close i)+
      (∑ j,if close j then (groupMass v f j-W j)*R j else 0))
      (∑ j,if close j then 0 else cost x (fiberWeight v f j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w f j) s)
    linarith only [h₁,h₂,hres,hcenter,hfar]
  have hB : B≤2*(cost x w proxy+cost x w s) := representative_group_bound x w hw proxy s
  have hB₂ : B≤2*(a+1)*cost x w s := by nlinarith only [hB,happrox]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB₂ (by positivity : 0≤11*ε)
  exact habs.trans (by nlinarith only [hh])

end APC

  ring

APC.expectation_abs_le.source:
theorem expectation_abs_le {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ i, |f i| ≤ R) : |expectation p f| ≤ R := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |p i * f i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i, p i * |f i| := by simp [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg, hp]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, p i * R := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound i) (hp i))
    _ = R := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h1, one_mul]

/-- Bernstein concentration for an uncentered empirical average. -/

APC.empirical_average_concentration.doc: Bernstein concentration for an uncentered empirical average.
APC.empirical_average_concentration.source:
theorem empirical_average_concentration {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (R V r : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hV : 0 < V) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hbound : ∀ i, |f i| ≤ R) (hsecond : ∑ i, p i * (f i)^2 ≤ V)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun a => r < |drawSum f m a / (m:ℝ) - expectation p f|) ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*r^2 / (4*(V+2*R*r))) := by
  have hmean := expectation_abs_le p f hp h1 R hbound
  have hcenter : ∀ i, |f i - expectation p f| ≤ 2*R := by
    intro i
    exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hbound i, hmean])
  have hvariance : (∑ i, p i * (f i - expectation p f)^2) ≤ V := by
    rw [centered_second_moment p f h1]
    nlinarith only [hsecond, sq_nonneg (expectation p f)]
  have hb := finite_bernstein p (fun i => f i - expectation p f) hp h1
    (centered_expectation p f h1) (2*R) V r (by positivity) hV hr hcenter hvariance m
  have hmono : eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun a => r < |drawSum f m a / (m:ℝ) - expectation p f|) ≤
      eventMass (drawWeight p m)
        (fun a => (m:ℝ)*r < |drawSum (fun i => f i - expectation p f) m a|) := by
    apply eventMass_mono _ (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m)
    intro a ha
    have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    have he : drawSum (fun i => f i - expectation p f) m a =
        (m:ℝ) * (drawSum f m a / (m:ℝ) - expectation p f) := by
      rw [drawSum_centered]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [he, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hmR]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ha hmR
  exact hmono.trans hb

/-- An importance-weighted sample average, allowing signed residual losses. -/

APC.importanceEstimate.doc: An importance-weighted sample average, allowing signed residual losses.
APC.importanceEstimate.source:
def importanceEstimate {I : Type*} (p loss : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) : ℝ :=
  drawSum (fun i => loss i / p i) m a / (m:ℝ)

APC.importance_unbiased.source:
theorem importance_unbiased {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p loss : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) :
    expectation p (fun i => loss i / p i) = ∑ i, loss i := by
  unfold expectation
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp i)]

APC.importance_second_moment.source:
theorem importance_second_moment {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p loss : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) :
    (∑ i, p i * (loss i / p i)^2) = ∑ i, (loss i)^2 / p i := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp i)]

APC.importance_sampling_concentration.source:
theorem importance_sampling_concentration {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p loss : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (R V r : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hV : 0 < V) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hbound : ∀ i, |loss i| ≤ R * p i)
    (hsecond : ∑ i, (loss i)^2 / p i ≤ V)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun a => r < |importanceEstimate p loss m a - ∑ i, loss i|) ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*r^2 / (4*(V+2*R*r))) := by
  have hrange : ∀ i, |loss i / p i| ≤ R := by
    intro i
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (hp i)]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ (hp i)).2 (hbound i)
  have hb := empirical_average_concentration p (fun i => loss i / p i)
    (fun i => (hp i).le) h1 R V r hR hV hr hrange
    (by rw [importance_second_moment p loss hp]; exact hsecond) m hm
  simpa only [importance_unbiased p loss hp, importanceEstimate] using hb

end APC

APC.MetricIteration.size.doc: Explicit recursive sample counts. Every stage uses the verified local finite-family sampling budget for the preceding stage's size.
APC.MetricIteration.size.source:
def size (N k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => N
  | n+1 => metricStageSampleCount k (size N k a e δ n) a (e n) (δ n)

APC.MetricIteration.size_pos.source:
theorem size_pos (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    0<size N k a e δ n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)
  | succ n => exact Nat.zero_lt_succ _

instance sizeNeZero (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    NeZero (size N k a e δ n) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (size_pos N k a e δ n)⟩

APC.MetricIteration.Cloud.source:
structure Cloud (I X : Type*) where
  points : I → X
  weights : I → ℝ

APC.MetricIteration.outcomes.source:
def outcomes (N k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Type :=
  Draws (Fin (size N k a e δ n)) (size N k a e δ (n+1))

instance outcomesFintype (N k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype (outcomes N k a e δ n) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Draws _ _))

section
variable {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]

APC.MetricIteration.sample_pos.source:
theorem sample_pos {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (c : Cloud I X) (hc : ∀ i,0<c.weights i) (proxy : K → X)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) (z : Draws I m) : ∀ j,0<(sample c proxy m z).weights j := by
  exact sampledWeights_pos c.weights (probability c proxy) hc
    (sensitivityProbability_pos _ _ _ hc (fun i => sq_nonneg _)) m hm z

variable (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ)

APC.MetricIteration.Proxy.source: abbrev Proxy := (n : ℕ) → Cloud (Fin (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n)) X → K → X

APC.MetricIteration.cloud.source:
def cloud (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ) :
    (n : ℕ) → Adaptive.History (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ) n →
      Cloud (Fin (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n)) X
  | 0, _ => initial
  | n+1, h => sample (cloud initial proxy n h.1) (proxy n (cloud initial proxy n h.1))
      (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ (n+1)) h.2

variable {N a e δ}

APC.MetricIteration.cloud_pos.source:
theorem cloud_pos [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ h j,0<(cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).weights j := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h; exact hw
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h
    exact sample_pos _ (ih h.1) _ _ (size_pos _ _ _ _ _ _) h.2

APC.MetricIteration.transition.source:
def transition (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (n : ℕ) (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ) n) :
    outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n → ℝ :=
  drawWeight (probability (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h)
    (proxy n (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h))) (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ (n+1))

APC.MetricIteration.transition_nonneg.source:
theorem transition_nonneg [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ) :
    ∀ n h z,0≤transition initial proxy n h z := by
  intro n h z
  exact drawWeight_nonneg _
    (fun i => (sensitivityProbability_pos _ _ _ (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h)
      (fun i => sq_nonneg _) i).le) _ z

APC.MetricIteration.transition_sum.source:
theorem transition_sum [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ) :
    ∀ n h,∑ z,transition initial proxy n h z=1 := by
  intro n h
  exact drawWeight_sum _ (sensitivityProbability_sum _ _ _ (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h)) _

APC.MetricIteration.good.source:
def good (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (n : ℕ) (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (z : outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n) : Prop :=
  let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
  let c' := sample c (proxy n c) (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ (n+1)) z
  MetricStep c.points c.weights c'.points c'.weights opt (e n)

/-- Every conditional stage bound follows from sensitivity sampling with
the prescribed integer count, after an arbitrary previous history. -/

APC.MetricIteration.good_failure.doc: Every conditional stage bound follows from sensitivity sampling with the prescribed integer count, after an arbitrary previous history.
APC.MetricIteration.good_failure.source:
theorem good_failure [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) → Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c)) :
    ∀ n h,eventMass (transition initial proxy n h) (fun z => ¬good initial proxy opt n h z) ≤ δ n := by
  intro n h
  let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
  have hc := cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h
  have hb := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ n))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ n)+
      (Fintype.card K:ℝ)*Real.log (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n)))
    (e n/(23+22*a)) (ne_of_gt (div_pos (he n) (by linarith)))
  exact metric_step_kernel_budget c.points c.weights hc (proxy n c) opt a (e n) (δ n)
    ha (he n) (he1 n) (hδ n) (hproxy n c hc) _ hb.1 hb.2.1
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hb.2.2)

APC.MetricIteration.all_stages_failure.source:
theorem all_stages_failure [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) → Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (n : ℕ) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n)
      (fun h => ¬Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h) ≤ errorBudget δ n := by
  exact Adaptive.adaptive_failure_bound _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy)
    (transition_sum initial hw proxy) _ δ (fun n => (hδ n).le)
    (fun n h _ => good_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hproxy n h) n

/-- Deterministic bounds for every query supported by the final summary,
or equal to the original optimum, on a good adaptive history. -/

APC.MetricIteration.chain_bounds.doc: Deterministic bounds for every query supported by the final summary, or equal to the original optimum, on a good adaptive history.
APC.MetricIteration.chain_bounds.source:
theorem chain_bounds [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤1/2) :
    ∀ h,Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h → ∀ s,
      ((∀ j,s j∈Set.range (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).points) ∨ s=opt) →
      let q := cost (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).points (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).weights s
      (1-errorBudget e n)*cost initial.points initial.weights s≤q ∧
        (1-errorBudget e n)*q≤cost initial.points initial.weights s := by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro h hh s hs; simp [cloud,errorBudget]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h hh s hs
    have hrec : errorBudget e (n+1)=errorBudget e n+e n := Finset.sum_range_succ e n
    have hS := errorBudget_nonneg e he n
    have hbn : errorBudget e n≤1/2 := by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith [he n]
    have hen : e n≤1/2 := by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith
    change Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h.1 ∧ good initial proxy opt n h.1 h.2 at hh
    let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h.1
    have hs' : (∀ j,s j∈Set.range c.points) ∨ s=opt := by
      rcases hs with hs | hs
      · exact Or.inl (fun j => sampledPoints_range_subset c.points _ h.2 (hs j))
      · exact Or.inr hs
    obtain ⟨hlo,hup⟩ := ih hbn h.1 hh.1 s hs'
    obtain ⟨hnextlo,hnexthi⟩ := hh.2 s hs'
    have hc0 := cost_nonneg initial.points initial.weights (fun i => (hw i).le) s
    have hcn := cost_nonneg c.points c.weights (fun i => (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h.1 i).le) s
    change (1-errorBudget e (n+1))*cost initial.points initial.weights s ≤
        cost (sample c (proxy n c) _ h.2).points (sample c (proxy n c) _ h.2).weights s ∧ _
    rw [hrec]
    constructor
    · have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo (by linarith : 0≤1-e n)
      have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (he n) hS) hc0
      nlinarith only [hm,hnextlo,hx]
    · have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnexthi
        (by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith : 0≤1-(errorBudget e n+e n))
      have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (he n) (add_nonneg hS (he n))) hcn
      dsimp only [c, cloud] at hm hup hx ⊢
      nlinarith only [hm,hup,hx]

APC.MetricIteration.chain_preserves.source:
theorem chain_preserves [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤1/2) :
    ∀ h,Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h → ∀ s,
      ((∀ j,s j∈Set.range (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).points) ∨ s=opt) →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights s)
        (cost (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).points (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).weights s)
        (2*errorBudget e n) := by
  intro h hh s hs
  obtain ⟨hlo,hup⟩ := chain_bounds initial hw proxy opt he n hbudget h hh s hs
  have hc0 := cost_nonneg initial.points initial.weights (fun i => (hw i).le) s
  have hcn := cost_nonneg (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).points
    (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).weights (fun i => (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le) s
  have hS := errorBudget_nonneg e he n
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hS hc0]
  · have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hup (by positivity : 0≤1+2*errorBudget e n)
    have hx := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS (by linarith : 0≤1-2*errorBudget e n)) hcn
    nlinarith only [hm,hx]

/-- The prescribed adaptive sampling experiment returns an APC, for any
finite horizon whose local errors have total at most ε/40. The only
algorithmic primitive supplied is the approximation proxy at each stage. -/

APC.MetricIteration.compression.doc: The prescribed adaptive sampling experiment returns an APC, for any finite horizon whose local errors have total at most ε/40. The only algorithmic primitive supplied is the approximation proxy at each stage.
APC.MetricIteration.compression.source:
theorem compression [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) → Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        ¬∃ f : K → Fin (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n),
          cost initial.points initial.weights (fun j => c.points (f j)) ≤
            α*(4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt) ≤ errorBudget δ n := by
  have hb := all_stages_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hproxy n
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad hgood
  obtain ⟨α,s,hα,happrox,hno⟩ := hbad
  let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
  have hp := chain_preserves initial hw proxy opt (fun i => (he i).le) n (by linarith) h hgood
  have hpres : ∀ u, (∀ j,u j∈Set.range c.points) ∨ u=opt →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights u) (cost c.points c.weights u) (ε/20) := by
    intro u hu
    exact preserves_mono (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i => (hw i).le) u) (by linarith) (hp u hu)
  apply hno
  exact metric_apc_of_preservation c.points c.weights (fun i => (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le)
    (cost initial.points initial.weights) opt s α ε hα hε hε1
    (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i => (hw i).le) opt) happrox
    (fun f => hpres _ (Or.inl (fun j => ⟨f j,rfl⟩))) (hpres opt (Or.inr rfl))

/-- The actual summary-only nearest-point lifting map. -/

APC.MetricIteration.rounded.doc: The actual summary-only nearest-point lifting map.
APC.MetricIteration.rounded.source:
def rounded {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] (c : Cloud I X) (s : K → X) : K → X :=
  fun j => c.points (nearest c.points (s j))

APC.MetricIteration.rounded_chain_bound.source:
theorem rounded_chain_bound [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (hh : Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h)
    (s : K → X) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α)
    (happrox : Approximate (cost (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).points
      (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h).weights) α s) :
    cost initial.points initial.weights (rounded (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h) s) ≤
      α*(4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := by
  let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
  have hc : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i := fun i => (cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le
  have hp := chain_preserves initial hw proxy opt he n (by linarith) h hh
  have hpres : ∀ u, (∀ j,u j∈Set.range c.points) ∨ u=opt →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights u) (cost c.points c.weights u) (ε/20) := by
    intro u hu
    exact preserves_mono (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i => (hw i).le) u) (by linarith) (hp u hu)
  have hout := hpres (rounded c s) (Or.inl (fun j => ⟨nearest c.points (s j),rfl⟩))
  have hopt := hpres opt (Or.inr rfl)
  have hlift : cost c.points c.weights (rounded c s) ≤ 4*cost c.points c.weights s :=
    metric_rounding c.points c.weights hc s (rounded c s) (fun j i => nearest_le c.points (s j) i)
  have hb := witness_transfer (cost initial.points initial.weights) (cost c.points c.weights)
    s (rounded c s) opt α 4 (ε/20) hα (by norm_num) (by linarith) happrox hlift hout.1 hopt.2
  calc
    _ ≤ α*4*((1+ε/20)/(1-ε/20))*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := hb
    _ = α*(4*((1+ε/20)/(1-ε/20)))*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (metric_factor ε hε hε1) hα)
      (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i => (hw i).le) opt)

/-- Guarantee for the actual returned centers. The event is uniform over
all approximation factors and all input solutions, so a solver may depend
arbitrarily on the entire sampled summary. -/

APC.MetricIteration.rounded_compression.doc: Guarantee for the actual returned centers. The event is uniform over all approximation factors and all input solutions, so a solver may depend arbitrarily on the entire sampled summary.
APC.MetricIteration.rounded_compression.source:
theorem rounded_compression [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) → Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        α*(4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt <
          cost initial.points initial.weights (rounded c s)) ≤ errorBudget δ n := by
  have hb := all_stages_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hproxy n
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad hgood
  obtain ⟨α,s,hα,happrox,ht⟩ := hbad
  exact not_lt_of_ge (rounded_chain_bound initial hw proxy opt (fun i => (he i).le)
    ε hε hε1 n hbudget h hgood s α hα happrox) ht

end
end APC.MetricIteration

APC.errorBudget.doc: The sum of the first n local relative errors.
APC.errorBudget.source: def errorBudget (e : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, e i

APC.errorBudget_nonneg.source:
theorem errorBudget_nonneg (e : ℕ → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ errorBudget e n := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => he i)

APC.errorBudget_mono.source:
theorem errorBudget_mono (e : ℕ → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) :
    Monotone (errorBudget e) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro n
  simp only [errorBudget, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (he n)

/-- Division-free product bounds. Unlike repeated equal-error composition,
these bounds depend only on the sum of the local errors. -/

APC.iteration_product_bounds.doc: Division-free product bounds. Unlike repeated equal-error composition, these bounds depend only on the sum of the local errors.
APC.iteration_product_bounds.source:
theorem iteration_product_bounds (c e : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c 0) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i)
    (hbudget : errorBudget e n ≤ 1/2)
    (hstep : ∀ i, i < n → Preserves (c i) (c (i+1)) (e i)) :
    0 ≤ c n ∧ (1-errorBudget e n)*c 0 ≤ c n ∧
      (1-errorBudget e n)*c n ≤ c 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [errorBudget] using And.intro hc (And.intro (le_refl (c 0)) (le_refl (c 0)))
  | succ n ih =>
    have hS := errorBudget_nonneg e he n
    have hrec : errorBudget e (n+1) = errorBudget e n + e n := by
      simp [errorBudget, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hbn : errorBudget e n ≤ 1/2 := by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith [he n]
    obtain ⟨hcn, hlo, hup⟩ := ih hbn (fun i hi => hstep i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi))
    obtain ⟨hnextlo, hnexthi⟩ := hstep n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    have hen : e n ≤ 1/2 := by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ c (n+1) := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1-e n) hcn]
    rw [hrec]
    refine ⟨hnonneg, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1-e n)
      have hextra := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (he n) hS) hc
      nlinarith only [h, hnextlo, hextra]
    · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnexthi
        (by rw [hrec] at hbudget; linarith : 0 ≤ 1-(errorBudget e n+e n))
      have hcross := mul_nonneg (he n) hS
      have hsq := sq_nonneg (e n)
      have hx := mul_nonneg (by nlinarith : 0 ≤ e n*errorBudget e n+(e n)^2) hcn
      nlinarith only [h, hup, hx]

/-- Standard relative preservation after an arbitrary number of stages. -/

APC.iteration_preserves.doc: Standard relative preservation after an arbitrary number of stages.
APC.iteration_preserves.source:
theorem iteration_preserves (c e : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c 0) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i)
    (hbudget : errorBudget e n ≤ 1/2)
    (hstep : ∀ i, i < n → Preserves (c i) (c (i+1)) (e i)) :
    Preserves (c 0) (c n) (2*errorBudget e n) := by
  obtain ⟨hcn, hlo, hup⟩ := iteration_product_bounds c e n hc he hbudget hstep
  have hS := errorBudget_nonneg e he n
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hS hc]
  · have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hup (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1+2*errorBudget e n)
    have hextra : 0 ≤ (errorBudget e n*(1-2*errorBudget e n))*c n :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS (by linarith)) hcn
    nlinarith only [h, hextra]

/-- A tuple supported by the final summary is supported by every earlier
summary, even when the supports and weights change between stages. -/

APC.final_centers_supported.doc: A tuple supported by the final summary is supported by every earlier summary, even when the supports and weights change between stages.
APC.final_centers_supported.source:
theorem final_centers_supported {K X : Type*} (support : ℕ → Set X)
    (hnest : ∀ i, support (i+1) ⊆ support i) (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n)
    (s : K → X) (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ support n) : ∀ j, s j ∈ support i := by
  have hanti : Antitone support := antitone_nat_of_succ_le hnest
  exact fun j => hanti hi (hs j)

/-- Section 4's deterministic telescoping argument for both final-support
queries and the fixed optimum. Local preservation is needed only on the
preceding support, together with that optimum. -/

APC.metric_iteration_preserves.doc: Section 4's deterministic telescoping argument for both final-support queries and the fixed optimum. Local preservation is needed only on the preceding support, together with that optimum.
APC.metric_iteration_preserves.source:
theorem metric_iteration_preserves {K X : Type*}
    (support : ℕ → Set X) (hnest : ∀ i, support (i+1) ⊆ support i)
    (c : ℕ → (K → X) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ s, 0 ≤ c 0 s)
    (opt : K → X) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) (n : ℕ)
    (hbudget : errorBudget e n ≤ 1/2)
    (hstep : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ s, (∀ j, s j ∈ support i) ∨ s=opt →
      Preserves (c i s) (c (i+1) s) (e i)) :
    ∀ s, (∀ j, s j ∈ support n) ∨ s=opt →
      Preserves (c 0 s) (c n s) (2*errorBudget e n) := by
  intro s hs
  apply iteration_preserves (fun i => c i s) e n (hc s) he hbudget
  intro i hi
  apply hstep i hi s
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · exact Or.inl (final_centers_supported support hnest n i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) s hs)
  · exact Or.inr hs

/-- Final-center guarantee from the complete chain of local events. The
only remaining iteration premises are its local events and summed budget;
there is no assumed final preservation guarantee. -/

APC.metric_apc_of_iteration.doc: Final-center guarantee from the complete chain of local events. The only remaining iteration premises are its local events and summed budget; there is no assumed final preservation guarantee.
APC.metric_apc_of_iteration.source:
theorem metric_apc_of_iteration
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (support : ℕ → Set X) (hnest : ∀ i, support (i+1) ⊆ support i)
    (c : ℕ → (K → X) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ s, 0 ≤ c 0 s)
    (opt s : K → X) (α ε : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (e : ℕ → ℝ) (he : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) (n : ℕ)
    (hbudget : errorBudget e n ≤ ε/40)
    (hfinal : ∀ s, c n s = cost x w s)
    (hsupport : ∀ i, x i ∈ support n)
    (hstep : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ s, (∀ j, s j ∈ support i) ∨ s=opt →
      Preserves (c i s) (c (i+1) s) (e i))
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s) :
    ∃ f : K → I, c 0 (fun j => x (f j)) ≤ α*(4+ε)*c 0 opt := by
  have hchain := metric_iteration_preserves support hnest c hc opt e he n
    (by linarith : errorBudget e n ≤ 1/2) hstep
  have hpres : ∀ u, (∀ j, u j ∈ support n) ∨ u=opt →
      Preserves (c 0 u) (cost x w u) (ε/20) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← hfinal u]
    exact preserves_mono (hc u) (by linarith) (hchain u hu)
  exact metric_apc_of_preservation x w hw (c 0) opt s α ε hα hε hε1 (hc opt)
    happrox (fun f => hpres _ (Or.inl (fun j => hsupport (f j))))
    (hpres opt (Or.inr rfl))

end APC

APC.closeResidual.source:
def closeResidual (x : I → X) (proxy s : K → X) (ε : ℝ) (Δ : I → ℝ) : I → ℝ := by
  classical
  exact fun i => if ε^2*pointCost s (proxy (nearest proxy (x i))) ≤ Δ i
    then pointCost s (x i)-pointCost s (proxy (nearest proxy (x i))) else 0

APC.closeResidual_square.source:
theorem closeResidual_square (x : I → X) (proxy s : K → X) (ε : ℝ) (Δ : I → ℝ) :
    ∀ i, (closeResidual x proxy s ε Δ i)^2 ≤
      8*pointCost s (x i)*pointCost proxy (x i)+2*(pointCost proxy (x i))^2 := by
  classical
  intro i
  unfold closeResidual
  split_ifs
  · simpa only [pointCost,pow_mul,← pow_mul] using
      pointCost_difference_sq s (x i) (proxy (nearest proxy (x i)))
  · have h₁ : 0≤pointCost s (x i) := sq_nonneg _
    have h₂ : 0≤pointCost proxy (x i) := sq_nonneg _
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg h₁ h₂,sq_nonneg (pointCost proxy (x i))]

APC.closeResidual_range.source:
theorem closeResidual_range (x : I → X) (proxy s : K → X) (ε : ℝ) (Δ : I → ℝ)
    (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hΔ : ∀ i,0≤Δ i) :
    ∀ i, ε*|closeResidual x proxy s ε Δ i|≤2*(Δ i+pointCost proxy (x i)) := by
  classical
  intro i
  unfold closeResidual
  split_ifs with h
  · exact close_pointCost_difference s (x i) (proxy (nearest proxy (x i))) ε (Δ i)
      hε hε1 (hΔ i) h
  · have hc : 0≤pointCost proxy (x i) := sq_nonneg _
    simp only [abs_zero,mul_zero]
    linarith [hΔ i]

/-- Concrete k-means instantiation of Claim A.7. The residual is defined
from the actual near/far predicate and nearest-center objective. -/

APC.kmeans_close_residual_concentration.doc: Concrete k-means instantiation of Claim A.7. The residual is defined from the actual near/far predicate and nearest-center objective.
APC.kmeans_close_residual_concentration.source:
theorem kmeans_close_residual_concentration (x : I → X) (w p Δ : I → ℝ) (proxy s : K → X) (a ε : ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hp : ∀ i,0

ε< |importanceEstimate p (normalizedResidual w (closeResidual x proxy s ε Δ) (cost x w s)) m sample- ∑ i,normalizedResidual w (closeResidual x proxy s ε Δ) (cost x w s) i|)≤ 2*Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2/(4*(64*a+8*a^2))) := by exact close_residual_concentration w (closeResidual x proxy s ε Δ) (fun i=>pointCost s (x i)) (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) Δ p (cost x w s) (cost x w proxy) a ε hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) hp h1 hC (cost_nonneg x w hw proxy) ha hε rfl rfl happrox hsensC hsensΔ (closeResidual_square x proxy s ε Δ) (closeResidual_range x proxy s ε Δ hε.le hε1 hΔ) m hm /-- A zero-cost solution is preserved exactly by inverse-probability sampling, so the positive-cost concentration branch loses no cases. -/

APC.sampled_zero_cost.doc: A zero-cost solution is preserved exactly by inverse-probability sampling, so the positive-cost concentration branch loses no cases.
APC.sampled_zero_cost.source:
theorem sampled_zero_cost (x : I → X) (w p : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (s : K → X) (hz : cost x w s=0) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    cost (sampledPoints x m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) s=0 := by
  have hzero : ∀ i,w i*pointCost s (x i)=0 := by
    intro i
    have hle : w i*pointCost s (x i)≤cost x w s :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _=>mul_nonneg (hw j)
        (show 0≤pointCost s (x j) from sq_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact le_antisymm (hz ▸ hle) (mul_nonneg (hw i) (sq_nonneg _))
  rw [sampled_cost_eq]
  simp [importanceEstimate,drawSum_eq_sum,hzero]

end APC

APC.clusterWeight.source:
def clusterWeight (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (j : K) (i : I) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if a i = j then w i else 0

APC.clusterWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem clusterWeight_nonneg (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (j : K) : ∀ i, 0 ≤ clusterWeight w a j i := by
  classical
  intro i
  simp only [clusterWeight]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

APC.cluster_cost_sum.source:
theorem cluster_cost_sum (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (s : K → E) :
    (∑ j, oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (s j)) =
      ∑ i, w i * dist (x i) (s (a i))^2 := by
  classical
  simp only [oneCost, clusterWeight, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp [dist_eq_norm_sub]

/-- Full geometric lifting statement: from any center tuple, construct a
tuple of means of exactly m summary points with cost increase ≤1+1/m.
This is an existence theorem, not a runtime claim. -/

APC.exists_structured_lift.doc: Full geometric lifting statement: from any center tuple, construct a tuple of means of exactly m summary points with cost increase ≤1+1/m. This is an existence theorem, not a runtime claim.
APC.exists_structured_lift.source:
theorem exists_structured_lift (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (s : K → E) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ out : K → E, out ∈ witnessFamily x m ∧
      cost x w out ≤ (1 + (m:ℝ)⁻¹) * cost x w s := by
  classical
  let a : I → K := fun i => nearest s (x i)
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ f : Fin m → I,
      oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (tupleMean x m f) ≤
        (1 + (m:ℝ)⁻¹) * oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (s j) := by
    intro j
    let v := clusterWeight w a j
    have hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i := clusterWeight_nonneg w a hw j
    have hmass : 0 ≤ mass v := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hv i)
    by_cases hz : mass v = 0
    · refine ⟨fun _ => Classical.arbitrary I, ?_⟩
      rw [oneCost_zero_mass x v hv hz, oneCost_zero_mass x v hv hz, mul_zero]
    · obtain ⟨f, _, hf⟩ := exists_small_mean x v hv (lt_of_le_of_ne hmass (Ne.symm hz)) m hm
      refine ⟨f, hf.trans ?_⟩
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mean_minimizes x v hv hz (s j))
        (by positivity)
  choose f hf using hc
  let out : K → E := fun j => tupleMean x m (f j)
  refine ⟨out, mem_witnessFamily x m f, ?_⟩
  calc
    cost x w out ≤ ∑ i, w i * dist (x i) (out (a i))^2 := cost_le_assigned x w hw out a
    _ = ∑ j, oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (out j) := (cluster_cost_sum x w a out).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (1 + (m:ℝ)⁻¹) * oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (s j) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hf j)
    _ = (1 + (m:ℝ)⁻¹) * cost x w s := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, cluster_cost_sum]
      rfl

/-- End-to-end Euclidean approximation guarantee, conditional only on
cost preservation for the finite witness family and the original optimum.
No mean-estimation or lifting hypothesis remains. -/

APC.euclidean_apc_of_preservation.doc: End-to-end Euclidean approximation guarantee, conditional only on cost preservation for the finite witness family and the original optimum. No mean-estimation or lifting hypothesis remains.
APC.euclidean_apc_of_preservation.source:
theorem euclidean_apc_of_preservation
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (opt s : K → E) (α ε : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hopt_nonneg : 0 ≤ original opt)
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmε : (m:ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ ε/10)
    (hpres : ∀ c ∈ witnessFamily (K := K) x m,
      Preserves (original c) (cost x w c) (ε/10))
    (hopt : Preserves (original opt) (cost x w opt) (ε/10)) :
    ∃ out : K → E, out ∈ witnessFamily x m ∧
      original out ≤ α * (1 + ε) * original opt := by
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hcost⟩ := exists_structured_lift x w hw s m hm
  refine ⟨out, hout, ?_⟩
  apply euclidean_transfer_rescaled original (cost x w) s out opt α ε hα hε.le hε1
    hopt_nonneg happrox ?_ (hpres out hout) hopt
  exact hcost.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (cost_nonneg x w hw s))

end APC

APC.liftingRepetitions.source:
def liftingRepetitions (k : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.clog 3 (3*k)+1

instance liftingRepetitions_neZero (k : ℕ) : NeZero (liftingRepetitions k) :=
  ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero _⟩

APC.liftingSampleCount_valid.source:
theorem liftingSampleCount_valid (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    0<liftingSampleCount ε ∧ 3≤(liftingSampleCount ε:ℝ)*ε := by
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (3/ε)
  have hm : (Nat.ceil (3/ε):ℝ)≤liftingSampleCount ε := by simp [liftingSampleCount]
  exact ⟨Nat.zero_lt_succ _,(div_le_iff₀ hε).mp (hc.trans hm)⟩

APC.liftingRepetitions_bound.source:
theorem liftingRepetitions_bound (k : ℕ) :
    (k:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^(liftingRepetitions k)≤1/3 := by
  have hN : 3*k≤3^(liftingRepetitions k) :=
    (Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1<3) (3*k)).trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0<3) (Nat.le_succ _))
  have hR : 3*(k:ℝ)≤(3:ℝ)^(liftingRepetitions k) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have he : (k:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^(liftingRepetitions k)=
      (k:ℝ)/(3:ℝ)^(liftingRepetitions k) := by rw [div_pow,one_pow];ring
  rw [he]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<3) _)).2
  nlinarith only [hR]

/-- Algorithm 3 with explicit sample/repetition counts has failure
probability at most 1/3 for every fixed input center tuple. -/

APC.randomized_lifting_explicit.doc: Algorithm 3 with explicit sample/repetition counts has failure probability at most 1/3 for every fixed input center tuple.
APC.randomized_lifting_explicit.source:
theorem randomized_lifting_explicit
    {I K E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (s : K → E) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    let m := liftingSampleCount ε
    let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
    eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r)
      (fun sample=>(1+ε)*cost x w s<cost x w (randomLift x w s m r sample))≤1/3 := by
  have hm := liftingSampleCount_valid ε hε
  exact (randomized_lifting_failure x w hw s (liftingSampleCount ε)
    (liftingRepetitions _) hm.1 ε hε.le hm.2).trans (liftingRepetitions_bound _)

end APC

APC.iteratedLog.source:
def iteratedLog (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => x
  | n+1 => Real.log (iteratedLog x n)

APC.logLevel.source:
def logLevel (x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := max (iteratedLog x (i+1)) B

/-- The stopping set in Algorithm 4 is nonempty. The crude ceiling bound is
used only to prove termination, not as an estimate of the log-star runtime. -/

APC.iteratedLog_stops.doc: The stopping set in Algorithm 4 is nonempty. The crude ceiling bound is used only to prove termination, not as an estimate of the log-star runtime.
APC.iteratedLog_stops.source:
theorem iteratedLog_stops (x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 1≤B) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, iteratedLog x (i+1) ≤ B := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hb : ∀ i, iteratedLog x i ≤ x-(i:ℝ) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => simp [iteratedLog]
    | succ i ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < iteratedLog x i := by
        cases i with
        | zero => exact hx
        | succ j => exact lt_trans (by linarith : 0<B) (h j)
      have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
      change Real.log (iteratedLog x i) ≤ x-((i+1:ℕ):ℝ)
      push_cast
      linarith
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil x
  have hh := hb (Nat.ceil x+1)
  have hn := h (Nat.ceil x)
  push_cast at hh
  linarith

/-- Least positive stopping index, with a total definition for all inputs. -/
