APC.logStop.doc: Least positive stopping index, with a total definition for all inputs.
APC.logStop.source:
def logStop (x B : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ i : ℕ, iteratedLog x (i+1) ≤ B then Nat.find h+1 else 1

APC.logStop_pos.source:
theorem logStop_pos (x B : ℝ) : 0<logStop x B := by
  unfold logStop
  split_ifs <;> omega

APC.logStop_spec.source:
theorem logStop_spec (x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 1≤B) :
    iteratedLog x (logStop x B) ≤ B := by
  have h := iteratedLog_stops x B hx hB
  simpa only [logStop, dif_pos h] using Nat.find_spec h

APC.logStop_minimal.source:
theorem logStop_minimal (x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 1≤B)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hit : i < logStop x B) : B < iteratedLog x i := by
  have h := iteratedLog_stops x B hx hB
  simp only [logStop, dif_pos h] at hit
  obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hi)
  exact lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min h (by omega))

APC.logLevel_lower.source: theorem logLevel_lower (x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : B≤logLevel x B i := le_max_right _ _

APC.logLevel_terminal.source:
theorem logLevel_terminal (x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 1≤B) :
    logLevel x B (logStop x B-1)=B := by
  unfold logLevel
  have ht := logStop_pos x B
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel ht]
  exact max_eq_right (logStop_spec x B hx hB)

/-- Before the last pair, levels grow at least fourfold when read backwards.
The last transition is excluded because the terminal level is clamped to B. -/

APC.logLevel_backward_growth.doc: Before the last pair, levels grow at least fourfold when read backwards. The last transition is excluded because the terminal level is clamped to B.
APC.logLevel_backward_growth.source:
theorem logLevel_backward_growth (x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 8≤B)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i+2<logStop x B) :
    4*logLevel x B (i+1) ≤ logLevel x B i := by
  have hprev := logStop_minimal x B hx (by linarith) (i+1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hnext := logStop_minimal x B hx (by linarith) (i+2) (by omega) hi
  have hprevpos : 0 < iteratedLog x (i+1) := by linarith
  have hexp := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0≤ iteratedLog x (i+2))
  have hid : Real.exp (iteratedLog x (i+2))=iteratedLog x (i+1) := by
    change Real.exp (Real.log (iteratedLog x (i+1)))=_
    exact Real.exp_log hprevpos
  rw [hid] at hexp
  have hquad := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0≤ iteratedLog x (i+2))
    (by linarith : 0≤ iteratedLog x (i+2)-8)
  simp only [logLevel, show i+1+1=i+2 by omega,
    max_eq_left hprev.le, max_eq_left hnext.le]
  nlinarith

/-- A reverse geometric series, without converting to a logarithmic index. -/

APC.reverse_geometric_sum.doc: A reverse geometric series, without converting to a logarithmic index.
APC.reverse_geometric_sum.source:
theorem reverse_geometric_sum (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i,0≤f i) (n : ℕ)
    (hcontract : ∀ i,i<n → 2*f i≤f (i+1)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1),f i)≤2*f n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using (by linarith [hf 0] : f 0≤2*f 0)
  | succ n ih =>
    have hsum := ih (fun i hi=>hcontract i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi))
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    linarith [hcontract n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

/-- At most one terminal transition need fail the geometric contraction. -/

APC.terminal_geometric_sum.doc: At most one terminal transition need fail the geometric contraction.
APC.terminal_geometric_sum.source:
theorem terminal_geometric_sum (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i,0≤f i)
    (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0≤c) (hbound : ∀ i,i<n → f i≤c)
    (hcontract : ∀ i,i+2<n → 2*f i≤f (i+1)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,f i)≤3*c := by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp; positivity
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simpa using (by linarith [hbound 0 (by omega)] : f 0≤3*c)
    | succ n =>
      have hsum := reverse_geometric_sum f hf n (fun i hi => hcontract i (by omega))
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hlast := hbound (n+1) (by omega)
      have hpenult := hbound n (by omega)
      linarith

APC.inverse_sqrt_contraction.source:
theorem inverse_sqrt_contraction (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0<u) (hv : 0<v)
    (hgrowth : 4*v≤u) : 2/(Real.sqrt u)≤1/(Real.sqrt v) := by
  have hsu := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hu
  have hsv := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hv
  have hu2 := Real.sq_sqrt hu.le
  have hv2 := Real.sq_sqrt hv.le
  have hs : 2*Real.sqrt v≤Real.sqrt u := by nlinarith
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hsu hsv).2
  simpa using hs

/-- The actual inverse-square-root schedule has bounded total error,
independently of the input size and number of iterations. -/

APC.logSchedule_sum.doc: The actual inverse-square-root schedule has bounded total error, independently of the input size and number of iterations.
APC.logSchedule_sum.source:
theorem logSchedule_sum (x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 8≤B) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (logStop x B),1/Real.sqrt (logLevel x B i))≤3/Real.sqrt B := by
  have hBpos : 0<B := by linarith
  have hlevel : ∀ i,0<logLevel x B i := fun i=>lt_of_lt_of_le hBpos (logLevel_lower x B i)
  have hb := terminal_geometric_sum (fun i=>1/Real.sqrt (logLevel x B i))
    (fun i=>by positivity) (logStop x B) (1/Real.sqrt B) (by positivity)
    (fun i _ => one_div_le_one_div_of_le (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hBpos)
      (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (logLevel_lower x B i))) (by
      intro i hi
      simpa only [mul_one_div] using inverse_sqrt_contraction
        (logLevel x B i) (logLevel x B (i+1)) (hlevel i) (hlevel (i+1))
        (logLevel_backward_growth x B hx hB i hi))
  simpa only [mul_one_div] using hb

APC.logStageError.source: def logStageError (x B ε : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := ε/Real.sqrt (logLevel x B i)

APC.logStageError_nonneg.source:
theorem logStageError_nonneg (x B ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (i : ℕ) :
    0≤logStageError x B ε i := div_nonneg hε (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

APC.logStageError_budget.source:
theorem logStageError_budget (x B ε : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 8≤B) (hε : 0≤ε) :
    errorBudget (logStageError x B ε) (logStop x B) ≤ 3*ε/Real.sqrt B := by
  calc
    _ = ε*(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (logStop x B),1/Real.sqrt (logLevel x B i)) := by
      simp [errorBudget,logStageError,Finset.mul_sum,div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ ε*(3/Real.sqrt B) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (logSchedule_sum x B hx hB) hε
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- A concrete rescaling sufficient for the final (4+ε) transfer.
B=14400 is deliberately conservative and is not an optimized constant. -/

APC.logStageError_rescaled_budget.doc: A concrete rescaling sufficient for the final (4+ε) transfer. B=14400 is deliberately conservative and is not an optimized constant.
APC.logStageError_rescaled_budget.source:
theorem logStageError_rescaled_budget (x ε : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hε : 0≤ε) :
    errorBudget (logStageError x 14400 ε) (logStop x 14400) ≤ ε/40 := by
  have h := logStageError_budget x 14400 ε hx (by norm_num) hε
  have hs : Real.sqrt (14400:ℝ)=120 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : 0≤(14400:ℝ)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (14400:ℝ)]
  rw [hs] at h
  linarith

end APC

APC.metric_factor.source:
theorem metric_factor (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    4 * ((1 + ε/20) / (1 - ε/20)) ≤ 4 + ε := by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - ε/20 := by linarith
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1)]

/-- General-metric APC reduction after cost preservation has been proved.
The iterative sampling construction that supplies hpres is not assumed as
an axiom and is not proved in this file. -/

APC.metric_apc_of_preservation.doc: General-metric APC reduction after cost preservation has been proved. The iterative sampling construction that supplies hpres is not assumed as an axiom and is not proved in this file.
APC.metric_apc_of_preservation.source:
theorem metric_apc_of_preservation
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (original : (K → X) → ℝ) (opt s : K → X) (α ε : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hopt_nonneg : 0 ≤ original opt)
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s)
    (hpres : ∀ f : K → I,
      Preserves (original (fun j => x (f j))) (cost x w (fun j => x (f j))) (ε/20))
    (hopt : Preserves (original opt) (cost x w opt) (ε/20)) :
    ∃ f : K → I,
      original (fun j => x (f j)) ≤ α * (4 + ε) * original opt := by
  let f : K → I := fun j => nearest x (s j)
  let out : K → X := fun j => x (f j)
  have hlift : cost x w out ≤ 4 * cost x w s := by
    apply metric_rounding x w hw s out
    intro j i
    exact nearest_le x (s j) i
  have hb := witness_transfer original (cost x w) s out opt α 4 (ε/20)
    hα (by norm_num) (by linarith) happrox hlift (hpres f).1 hopt.2
  refine ⟨f, hb.trans ?_⟩
  calc
    α * 4 * ((1+ε/20)/(1-ε/20)) * original opt =
        α * (4 * ((1+ε/20)/(1-ε/20))) * original opt := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (metric_factor ε hε hε1) hα) hopt_nonneg

end APC

APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch.doc: Exhaustive summary-only search. Ordered tuples allow repeated centers; no center outside the summary is inspected by this final search.

APC.MetricIteration.supportCenters.source: def supportCenters (c : Cloud I X) : K → X := fun j=>c.points (supportSearch c j)

APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_spec.source:
theorem supportSearch_spec (c : Cloud I X) (f : K → I) :
    cost c.points c.weights (supportCenters (K:=K) c)≤
      cost c.points c.weights (fun j=>c.points (f j)) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (fun f : K → I=>cost c.points c.weights (fun j=>c.points (f j))) Finset.univ_nonempty)).2 f
      (Finset.mem_univ f)

APC.MetricIteration.supportCenters_suppo.source:
theorem supportCenters_supported (c : Cloud I X) :
    ∀ j,supportCenters (K:=K) c j∈Set.range c.points := fun j=>⟨supportSearch c j,rfl⟩

/-- Support search is a factor-four solution even when comparison centers
are allowed anywhere in the ambient metric. -/

APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_le_fou.doc: Support search is a factor-four solution even when comparison centers are allowed anywhere in the ambient metric.
APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_le_fou.source:
theorem supportSearch_le_four (c : Cloud I X) (hw : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i) (s : K → X) :
    cost c.points c.weights (supportCenters (K:=K) c)≤4*cost c.points c.weights s := by
  calc
    _≤cost c.points c.weights (rounded c s) := supportSearch_spec c (fun j=>nearest c.points (s j))
    _≤_ := metric_rounding c.points c.weights hw s (rounded c s) (fun j i=>nearest_le c.points (s j) i)

APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_approx.source:
theorem supportSearch_approximate (c : Cloud I X) (hw : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i) :
    Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) 4 (supportCenters (K:=K) c) :=
  supportSearch_le_four c hw

/-- Exact candidate count for this tuple-based final search, before
identifying permutations, repeated centers or duplicate summary points. -/

APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_candid.doc: Exact candidate count for this tuple-based final search, before identifying permutations, repeated centers or duplicate summary points.
APC.MetricIteration.supportSearch_candid.source:
theorem supportSearch_candidate_count :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (K → I)).card=Fintype.card I^Fintype.card K := by
  simp

end Search

section Compression
variable {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {a : ℝ} {e δ : ℕ → ℝ}

/-- On a good chain, directly returning the best summary-supported tuple
avoids applying the rounding factor a second time. -/

APC.MetricIteration.enumeration_chain_bo.doc: On a good chain, directly returning the best summary-supported tuple avoids applying the rounding factor a second time.
APC.MetricIteration.enumeration_chain_bo.source:
theorem enumeration_chain_bound (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (hh : Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h) :
    cost initial.points initial.weights (supportCenters (K:=K) (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h))≤
      (4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := by
  let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
  have hc : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i := fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le
  have hp := chain_preserves initial hw proxy opt he n (by linarith) h hh
  have hpres : ∀ u,(∀ j,u j∈Set.range c.points) ∨ u=opt →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights u) (cost c.points c.weights u) (ε/20) := by
    intro u hu
    exact preserves_mono (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) u) (by linarith) (hp u hu)
  have hs := hpres (supportCenters (K:=K) c) (Or.inl (supportCenters_supported c))
  have ho := hpres opt (Or.inr rfl)
  have hb := witness_transfer (cost initial.points initial.weights) (cost c.points c.weights)
    (supportCenters (K:=K) c) (supportCenters (K:=K) c) opt 4 1 (ε/20) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by linarith) (supportSearch_approximate c hc) (by simp) hs.1 ho.2
  calc
    _≤4*((1+ε/20)/(1-ε/20))*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := by simpa using hb
    _≤_ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (metric_factor ε hε hε1)
      (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) opt)

/-- Actual repeated sensitivity sampling followed by exhaustive final
support search, with failure bounded by the sum of stage failure budgets. -/

APC.MetricIteration.enumeration_compress.doc: Actual repeated sensitivity sampling followed by exhaustive final support search, with failure bounded by the sum of stage failure budgets.
APC.MetricIteration.enumeration_compress.source:
theorem enumeration_compression (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c,(∀ j,0<c.weights j)→Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h=>
      (4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt<
        cost initial.points initial.weights (supportCenters (K:=K) (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h)))≤errorBudget δ n := by
  have hb := all_stages_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hproxy n
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad hgood
  exact not_lt_of_ge (enumeration_chain_bound initial hw proxy opt (fun i=>(he i).le)
    ε hε hε1 n hbudget h hgood) hbad

end Compression

/-- The finite-metric construction with the final support solver specified.
Size and approximation refer to the same sampler and returned center tuple.
Exhaustive proxies ensure correctness, but their efficient construction and
full runtime are not asserted here. -/

APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_enumer.doc: The finite-metric construction with the final support solver specified. Size and approximation refer to the same sampler and returned center tuple. Exhaustive proxies ensure correctness, but their efficient construction and full runtime are not asserted here.
APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_enumer.source:
theorem finite_metric_enumeration_correctness
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    (size N (Fintype.card K) 1 e δ t:ℝ)≤metricSizeGamma (Fintype.card K) 1 ε*14400^2 ∧
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h=>
      ¬Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) (4+ε)
        (supportCenters (K:=K) (cloud N 1 e δ initial proxy t h)))≤1/2 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
  let δ := scheduledFailure N
  let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
  let opt := optimalProxy (K:=K) initial
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  have hb := (enumeration_compression initial hw proxy opt (by norm_num)
    (scheduledError_pos N ε hε) (scheduledError_le_one N ε hε1) (scheduledFailure_pos N)
    (fun n c _=>optimalProxy_spec c) ε hε.le hε1 (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le)).trans (scheduledFailure_budget N)
  refine ⟨terminal_size_bound N (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1,?_⟩
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) _) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad
  by_contra hn
  apply hbad
  intro u
  have ho : cost initial.points initial.weights opt≤cost initial.points initial.weights u := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using optimalProxy_spec initial u
  exact (le_of_not_gt hn).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ho (by linarith))

/-- An explicit input-size-independent bound on the number of ordered
candidate tuples examined by the final solver. This is not a full runtime
bound nor the sharper binomial enumeration bound in the paper. -/

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_enumeration.doc: An explicit input-size-independent bound on the number of ordered candidate tuples examined by the final solver. This is not a full runtime bound nor the sharper binomial enumeration bound in the paper.
APC.MetricIteration.terminal_enumeration.source:
theorem terminal_enumeration_count_bound (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hk : 0<k)
    (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    ((size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400):ℝ)^k)≤(metricSizeGamma k a ε*14400^2)^k :=
  pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (terminal_size_bound N k hk a ε ha hε hε1) k

end APC.MetricIteration

APC.geometricStageFailure.doc: A fully specified summable failure schedule for the recursive-count implementation. It deliberately differs from Algorithm 4's size-based schedule, whose sample-size domination remains separate.

APC.geometricStageFailure_pos.source:
theorem geometricStageFailure_pos (i : ℕ) : 0<geometricStageFailure i := by
  unfold geometricStageFailure
  positivity

APC.geometricStageFailure_sum.source:
theorem geometricStageFailure_sum (n : ℕ) :
    errorBudget geometricStageFailure n = (1/2)*(1-(1/2:ℝ)^n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [errorBudget]
  | succ n ih =>
    change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), geometricStageFailure i)=_
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    change errorBudget geometricStageFailure n + geometricStageFailure n = _
    rw [ih]
    simp only [geometricStageFailure,pow_succ]
    ring

APC.geometricStageFailure_budget.source:
theorem geometricStageFailure_budget (n : ℕ) : errorBudget geometricStageFailure n≤1/2 := by
  rw [geometricStageFailure_sum]
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/2) n]

APC.logStageError_pos.source:
theorem logStageError_pos (x B ε : ℝ) (hB : 0<B) (hε : 0<ε) (i : ℕ) :
    0<logStageError x B ε i :=
  div_pos hε (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hB (logLevel_lower x B i)))

APC.logStageError_le_one.source:
theorem logStageError_le_one (x B ε : ℝ) (hB : 1≤B) (hε1 : ε≤1) (i : ℕ) :
    logStageError x B ε i≤1 := by
  have hL := logLevel_lower x B i
  have hroot : (1:ℝ)≤Real.sqrt (logLevel x B i) := by
    have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_trans hB hL)
    simpa using hs
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0<Real.sqrt (logLevel x B i))).2
  linarith

end APC

namespace APC.MetricIteration

/-- A complete finite random experiment for iterated metric compression:
use the verified exact recursive sample counts, stop at the first clamped
iterated logarithm, and round each supplied solution to the final support.
The probability that any supplied α-solution lacks a (4+ε)α lift is ≤1/2.
The near-linear, input-size-independent bound for these recursive counts
is not asserted by this theorem. -/

APC.MetricIteration.log_schedule_compres.doc: A complete finite random experiment for iterated metric compression: use the verified exact recursive sample counts, stop at the first clamped iterated logarithm, and round each supplied solution to the final support. The probability that any supplied α-solution lacks a (4+ε)α lift is ≤1/2. The near-linear, input-size-independent bound for these recursive counts is not asserted by this theorem.
APC.MetricIteration.log_schedule_compres.source:
theorem log_schedule_compression
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (a ε : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a
      (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) geometricStageFailure)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) →
      Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c)) (opt : K → X) :
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := geometricStageFailure
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy t h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        ¬∃ f : K → Fin (size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ t),
          cost initial.points initial.weights (fun j => c.points (f j)) ≤
            α*(4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  exact (compression initial hw proxy opt ha
    (logStageError_pos (N:ℝ) 14400 ε (by norm_num) hε)
    (logStageError_le_one (N:ℝ) 14400 ε (by norm_num) hε1)
    geometricStageFailure_pos hproxy ε hε.le hε1 (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le)).trans
      (geometricStageFailure_budget _)

/-- The same bound for the explicitly defined nearest-point lifting output,
uniformly over every solver solution and approximation factor. -/

APC.MetricIteration.log_schedule_rounded.doc: The same bound for the explicitly defined nearest-point lifting output, uniformly over every solver solution and approximation factor.
APC.MetricIteration.log_schedule_rounded.source:
theorem log_schedule_rounded_compression
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < initial.weights i) (a ε : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a
      (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) geometricStageFailure)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) →
      Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c)) (opt : K → X) :
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := geometricStageFailure
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy t h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        α*(4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt <
          cost initial.points initial.weights (rounded c s)) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  exact (rounded_compression initial hw proxy opt ha
    (logStageError_pos (N:ℝ) 14400 ε (by norm_num) hε)
    (logStageError_le_one (N:ℝ) 14400 ε (by norm_num) hε1)
    geometricStageFailure_pos hproxy ε hε.le hε1 (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le)).trans
      (geometricStageFailure_budget _)

end APC.MetricIteration

APC.MetricIteration.scheduledFailure.doc: A level-based failure schedule. Unlike a geometrically decreasing schedule in the forward iteration index, its terminal budgets do not shrink as the log-star stopping index increases.
APC.MetricIteration.scheduledFailure.source: def scheduledFailure (N : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ := metricStageFailure 1 (N:ℝ) 14400

APC.MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_pos.source:
theorem scheduledFailure_pos (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : ℕ) :
    0<scheduledFailure N i := by
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  unfold scheduledFailure metricStageFailure
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · unfold metricCountFailure
    have hp := metricIterationCount_pos 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (i-1)
    exact one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hp))

APC.MetricIteration.scheduledFailure_bud.source:
theorem scheduledFailure_budget (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    errorBudget (scheduledFailure N) (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hN : (1:ℝ)≤N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)
  exact metricStageFailure_half 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 hN (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

APC.MetricIteration.scheduledError_pos.source:
theorem scheduledError_pos (N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (i : ℕ) :
    0<logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε i := by
  have hp : 0<logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (logLevel_lower _ _ _)
  exact div_pos hε (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp)

APC.MetricIteration.scheduledError_le_on.source:
theorem scheduledError_le_one (N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε≤1) (i : ℕ) :
    logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε i≤1 := by
  have hl := logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 i
  have hr : (1:ℝ)≤Real.sqrt (logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i) := by
    have hh := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith : (1:ℝ)≤logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i)
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using hh
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0<Real.sqrt (logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i))).2
  linarith

/-- Concrete stopping rule, concrete counts and concrete failure schedule,
with a bound on the actual rounded output, uniformly over input solutions.
The near-linear, input-size-independent size bound is still separate. -/

APC.MetricIteration.scheduled_rounded_co.doc: Concrete stopping rule, concrete counts and concrete failure schedule, with a bound on the actual rounded output, uniformly over input solutions. The near-linear, input-size-independent size bound is still separate.
APC.MetricIteration.scheduled_rounded_co.source:
theorem scheduled_rounded_compression
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (a ε : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a
      (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N))
    (hproxy : ∀ n c, (∀ j,0<c.weights j) →
      Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c)) (opt : K → X) :
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := scheduledFailure N
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy t h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        α*(4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt <
          cost initial.points initial.weights (rounded c s)) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  exact (rounded_compression initial hw proxy opt ha (scheduledError_pos N ε hε)
    (scheduledError_le_one N ε hε1) (scheduledFailure_pos N) hproxy ε hε.le hε1
    (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le)).trans
    (scheduledFailure_budget N)

section FiniteAmbient
variable {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
  [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]

/-- An exact finite search proxy removes the approximation-oracle premise.
This definition asserts mathematical correctness, with no runtime claim. -/

APC.MetricIteration.optimalProxy.doc: An exact finite search proxy removes the approximation-oracle premise. This definition asserts mathematical correctness, with no runtime claim.
APC.MetricIteration.optimalProxy.source:
def optimalProxy (c : Cloud I X) : K → X := by
  classical
  exact Classical.choose (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ (cost c.points c.weights)
    Finset.univ_nonempty)

APC.MetricIteration.optimalProxy_spec.source:
theorem optimalProxy_spec (c : Cloud I X) :
    Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) 1 (optimalProxy (K:=K) c) := by
  classical
  intro s
  have hh := (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (cost c.points c.weights) Finset.univ_nonempty)).2 s (Finset.mem_univ s)
  simpa only [one_mul] using hh

end FiniteAmbient

APC.MetricIteration.exactProxy.source:
def exactProxy {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) (e δ : ℕ → ℝ) : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N 1 e δ := fun _ c => optimalProxy c

/-- Finite-metric construction with no supplied proxy or cost-preservation
premise. Exhaustive finite proxies and the actual repeated sensitivity
sampling produce a uniformly valid summary-only rounding guarantee with
failure at most 1/2. The size asymptotics and runtime are not asserted. -/

APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_correc.doc: Finite-metric construction with no supplied proxy or cost-preservation premise. Exhaustive finite proxies and the actual repeated sensitivity sampling produce a uniformly valid summary-only rounding guarantee with failure at most 1/2. The size asymptotics and runtime are not asserted.
APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_correc.source:
theorem finite_metric_correctness
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N 1 e δ initial proxy t h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        ¬Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) (α*(4+ε)) (rounded c s)) ≤ 1/2 := by
  classical
  let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
  let δ := scheduledFailure N
  let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
  let opt := optimalProxy (K:=K) initial
  have hb := scheduled_rounded_compression N initial hw 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1 proxy
    (fun _ c _ => optimalProxy_spec c) opt
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) _) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad
  obtain ⟨α,s,hα,happrox,hno⟩ := hbad
  refine ⟨α,s,hα,happrox,?_⟩
  by_contra hn
  apply hno
  intro u
  have hbest : cost initial.points initial.weights opt ≤ cost initial.points initial.weights u := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using optimalProxy_spec initial u
  exact (le_of_not_gt hn).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbest (by positivity))

end APC.MetricIteration

APC.pointWitnessFamily.source:
def pointWitnessFamily {B K X : Type*} [Fintype B] [Fintype K]
    (x : B → X) : Finset (K → X) :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun f : K → B => fun j => x (f j))

APC.mem_pointWitnessFamily.source:
theorem mem_pointWitnessFamily {B K X : Type*} [Fintype B] [Fintype K]
    (x : B → X) (s : K → X) : s ∈ pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x ↔ ∃ f : K → B, s=fun j=>x (f j) := by
  simp only [pointWitnessFamily, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact exists_congr (fun f => eq_comm)

APC.card_pointWitnessFamily.source:
theorem card_pointWitnessFamily {B K X : Type*} [Fintype B] [Fintype K]
    (x : B → X) : (pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x).card ≤ Fintype.card B^Fintype.card K := by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)

APC.card_pointWitnessFamily_with_opt.source:
theorem card_pointWitnessFamily_with_opt {B K X : Type*} [Fintype B] [Fintype K]
    (x : B → X) (opt : K → X) :
    (insert opt (pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x)).card ≤ Fintype.card B^Fintype.card K+1 :=
  (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (card_pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x) 1)

/-- One metric compression stage: preserve all tuples on the preceding
support, plus the fixed original optimum. Counts include repeated centers. -/

APC.metric_sampling_stage.doc: One metric compression stage: preserve all tuples on the preceding support, plus the fixed original optimum. Counts include repeated centers.
APC.metric_sampling_stage.source:
theorem metric_sampling_stage
    {B K X : Type*} [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : B → X) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (opt proxy : K → X) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost x w) a proxy)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m)
    (hstruct : (48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (m:ℝ)*(ε/(23+22*a))^2)
    (hresidual : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+
      (Fintype.card K:ℝ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B))≤
      (m:ℝ)*(ε/(23+22*a))^2) :
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun sample => ∃ s,
      (s ∈ pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x ∨ s=opt) ∧
      ¬Preserves (cost x w s)
        (cost (sampledPoints x m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) s) ε) ≤ δ := by
  classical
  let F := insert opt (pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x)
  let Query := {s : K → X // s∈F}
  have hcard : Fintype.card Query=F.card := Fintype.card_coe F
  have hN : 0<F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨opt,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  have hNQ : 0<Fintype.card Query := by rw [hcard];exact hN
  have hcount : F.card≤Fintype.card B^Fintype.card K+1 := card_pointWitnessFamily_with_opt x opt
  have hlog := log_solution_count F.card (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card K)
    hN Fintype.card_pos hcount (δ/2) (by positivity)
  have hb : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*Real.log (4*(Fintype.card Query:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (m:ℝ)*(ε/(23+22*a))^2 := by
    rw [hcard]
    have he₁ : 2*(F.card:ℝ)/(δ/2)=4*(F.card:ℝ)/δ := by ring
    have he₂ : (4:ℝ)/(δ/2)=8/δ := by ring
    rw [he₁,he₂] at hlog
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity)).trans hresidual
  have h := finite_family_coreset x w hw proxy (fun q : Query=>q.val) a ε δ ha hε hε1 hδ
    hNQ (fun q=>hproxy q.val) m hm hstruct hb
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i=>(sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i).le
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) _ _ ?_) h
  intro sample hs
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hbad⟩ := hs
  have hsF : s∈F := by
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hs
    · exact hs ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  exact ⟨⟨s,hsF⟩,hbad⟩

APC.metricStageSampleCount.source:
def metricStageSampleCount (k B : ℕ) (a ε δ : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  budgetSampleCount ((48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(k:ℝ)*Real.log B)) (ε/(23+22*a))

/-- The local sampler with a prescribed positive integer count. No
cost-preservation or concentration event is assumed here. -/

APC.metric_sampling_stage_explicit.doc: The local sampler with a prescribed positive integer count. No cost-preservation or concentration event is assumed here.
APC.metric_sampling_stage_explicit.source:
theorem metric_sampling_stage_explicit
    {B K X : Type*} [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : B → X) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (opt proxy : K → X) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost x w) a proxy) :
    let m := metricStageSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun sample => ∃ s,
      (s ∈ pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x ∨ s=opt) ∧
      ¬Preserves (cost x w s)
        (cost (sampledPoints x m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample) s) ε) ≤ δ := by
  have hm := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B)))
    (ε/(23+22*a)) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hε (by linarith)))
  exact metric_sampling_stage x w hw opt proxy a ε δ ha hε hε1 hδ hproxy
    (metricStageSampleCount _ _ a ε δ) hm.1 hm.2.1 hm.2.2

end APC

APC.metricIterationCount.doc: Integer rounding of Algorithm 4's Γ L_i² count.
APC.metricIterationCount.source: def metricIterationCount (Γ x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.ceil (Γ*(logLevel x B i)^2)

APC.metricIterationCount_lower.source:
theorem metricIterationCount_lower (Γ x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    Γ*(logLevel x B i)^2 ≤ (metricIterationCount Γ x B i:ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _

APC.metricIterationCount_upper.source:
theorem metricIterationCount_upper (Γ x B : ℝ) (hΓ : 0≤Γ) (i : ℕ) :
    (metricIterationCount Γ x B i:ℝ) < Γ*(logLevel x B i)^2+1 :=
  Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg hΓ (sq_nonneg _))

APC.metricIterationCount_pos.source:
theorem metricIterationCount_pos (Γ x B : ℝ) (hΓ : 0<Γ) (hB : 0<B) (i : ℕ) :
    0<metricIterationCount Γ x B i := by
  apply Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
  exact mul_pos hΓ (sq_pos_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hB (logLevel_lower x B i)))

APC.metricIterationCount_terminal.source:
theorem metricIterationCount_terminal (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 1≤B) :
    metricIterationCount Γ x B (logStop x B-1) = Nat.ceil (Γ*B^2) := by
  simp only [metricIterationCount,logLevel_terminal x B hx hB]

/-- The final support cardinality is independent of x, given the sampler's
cardinality bound. This is an exact ceiling statement, not an asymptotic. -/

APC.metric_terminal_support_bound.doc: The final support cardinality is independent of x, given the sampler's cardinality bound. This is an exact ceiling statement, not an asymptotic.
APC.metric_terminal_support_bound.source:
theorem metric_terminal_support_bound {X : Type*} (support : Finset X)
    (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x) (hB : 1≤B)
    (hsize : support.card≤metricIterationCount Γ x B (logStop x B-1)) :
    support.card≤Nat.ceil (Γ*B^2) := by
  rwa [metricIterationCount_terminal Γ x B hx hB] at hsize

/-- Ceiling rounding retains more than the factor-two decrease needed by
our probability budget. -/

APC.metricIterationCount_backward.doc: Ceiling rounding retains more than the factor-two decrease needed by our probability budget.
APC.metricIterationCount_backward.source:
theorem metricIterationCount_backward (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x)
    (hB : 8≤B) (hΓ : 0<Γ) (hbase : 1≤Γ*B^2)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i+2<logStop x B) :
    2*(metricIterationCount Γ x B (i+1):ℝ) ≤ metricIterationCount Γ x B i := by
  have hL := logLevel_lower x B (i+1)
  have hU := logLevel_lower x B i
  have hg := logLevel_backward_growth x B hx hB i hi
  have hsq : 16*(logLevel x B (i+1))^2 ≤ (logLevel x B i)^2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0≤logLevel x B i-4*logLevel x B (i+1))
      (by linarith : 0≤logLevel x B i+4*logLevel x B (i+1))]
  have hmin : B^2≤(logLevel x B (i+1))^2 := by nlinarith
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin hΓ.le
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hΓ.le
  have hlow := metricIterationCount_lower Γ x B i
  have hupp := metricIterationCount_upper Γ x B hΓ.le (i+1)
  nlinarith only [hm,hs,hlow,hupp,hbase]

APC.metricCountFailure.source:
def metricCountFailure (Γ x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1/(4*(metricIterationCount Γ x B i:ℝ))

APC.metricCountFailure_nonneg.source:
theorem metricCountFailure_nonneg (Γ x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    0≤metricCountFailure Γ x B i := by unfold metricCountFailure; positivity

APC.metricCountFailure_sum.source:
theorem metricCountFailure_sum (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x)
    (hB : 8≤B) (hΓ : 0<Γ) (hbase : 1≤Γ*B^2) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (logStop x B),metricCountFailure Γ x B i) ≤ 3/(4*Γ*B^2) := by
  have hBpos : 0<B := by linarith
  have hpos : ∀ i,(0:ℝ)<metricIterationCount Γ x B i :=
    fun i=>Nat.cast_pos.mpr (metricIterationCount_pos Γ x B hΓ hBpos i)
  have hb := terminal_geometric_sum (metricCountFailure Γ x B)
    (metricCountFailure_nonneg Γ x B) (logStop x B) (1/(4*Γ*B^2)) (by positivity) (by
      intro i _
      have hL := logLevel_lower x B i
      have hsq : B^2≤(logLevel x B i)^2 := by nlinarith
      have hm := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hΓ.le).trans (metricIterationCount_lower Γ x B i)
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity : 0<4*Γ*B^2) (by nlinarith)) (by
      intro i hi
      have h := metricIterationCount_backward Γ x B hx hB hΓ hbase i hi
      unfold metricCountFailure
      rw [mul_one_div]
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hpos i))
        (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hpos (i+1)))).2
      nlinarith)
  simpa only [mul_one_div] using hb

/-- δ_0 uses the original input size; every later δ_i uses the preceding
rounded sample count. This matches the indexing in Lemma 4.2. -/

APC.metricStageFailure.doc: δ_0 uses the original input size; every later δ_i uses the preceding rounded sample count. This matches the indexing in Lemma 4.2.
APC.metricStageFailure.source:
def metricStageFailure (Γ x B : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if i=0 then 1/(4*x) else metricCountFailure Γ x B (i-1)

APC.metricStageFailure_nonneg.source:
theorem metricStageFailure_nonneg (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 0≤x) (i : ℕ) :
    0≤metricStageFailure Γ x B i := by
  unfold metricStageFailure
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · exact metricCountFailure_nonneg Γ x B _

APC.metricStageFailure_sum.source:
theorem metricStageFailure_sum (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 0<x)
    (hB : 8≤B) (hΓ : 0<Γ) (hbase : 1≤Γ*B^2) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (logStop x B),metricStageFailure Γ x B i) ≤
      1/(4*x)+3/(4*Γ*B^2) := by
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt (logStop_pos x B))
  have he : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (t+1),metricStageFailure Γ x B i) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range t,metricCountFailure Γ x B i)+1/(4*x) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp [metricStageFailure]
  rw [ht,he]
  have hsub : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range t,metricCountFailure Γ x B i) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (logStop x B),metricCountFailure Γ x B i :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
      (fun i _ _ => metricCountFailure_nonneg Γ x B i)
  have hb := metricCountFailure_sum Γ x B hx hB hΓ hbase
  linarith

APC.metricStageFailure_half.source:
theorem metricStageFailure_half (Γ x B : ℝ) (hx : 1≤x)
    (hB : 8≤B) (hΓ : 0<Γ) (hbase : 3≤Γ*B^2) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (logStop x B),metricStageFailure Γ x B i) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hb := metricStageFailure_sum Γ x B (by linarith) hB hΓ (by linarith)
  have hxbound : 1/(4*x)≤(1:ℝ)/4 :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<4*x)).2 (by linarith)
  have htail : 3/(4*Γ*B^2)≤(1:ℝ)/4 :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (by nlinarith : 0<4*Γ*B^2)).2 (by nlinarith)
  linarith

/-- The real iterated-log schedule supplies the complete deterministic
error budget. Local preservation events are the remaining hypotheses. -/

APC.metric_apc_log_schedule.doc: The real iterated-log schedule supplies the complete deterministic error budget. Local preservation events are the remaining hypotheses.
APC.metric_apc_log_schedule.source:
theorem metric_apc_log_schedule
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (N : ℝ) (hN : 0<N)
    (support : ℕ → Set X) (hnest : ∀ i,support (i+1)⊆support i)
    (c : ℕ → (K → X) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ s,0≤c 0 s)
    (opt s : K → X) (α ε : ℝ) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (hfinal : ∀ s,c (logStop N 14400) s=cost x w s)
    (hsupport : ∀ i,x i∈support (logStop N 14400))
    (hstep : ∀ i,i<logStop N 14400 → ∀ s,(∀ j,s j∈support i) ∨ s=opt →
      Preserves (c i s) (c (i+1) s) (logStageError N 14400 ε i))
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s) :
    ∃ f : K → I,c 0 (fun j=>x (f j))≤α*(4+ε)*c 0 opt := by
  exact metric_apc_of_iteration x w hw support hnest c hc opt s α ε hα hε hε1
    (logStageError N 14400 ε) (logStageError_nonneg N 14400 ε hε) (logStop N 14400)
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget N ε hN hε) hfinal hsupport hstep happrox

/-- A constant overall failure bound for fully adaptive sampling, provided
its conditional stage failures satisfy Algorithm 4's prescribed budgets. -/

APC.metric_adaptive_failure_half.doc: A constant overall failure bound for fully adaptive sampling, provided its conditional stage failures satisfy Algorithm 4's prescribed budgets.
APC.metric_adaptive_failure_half.source:
theorem metric_adaptive_failure_half {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (q : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ n h ω,0≤q n h ω) (hqsum : ∀ n h,∑ ω,q n h ω=1)
    (good : (n : ℕ) → History Ω n → Ω → Prop)
    (Γ N B : ℝ) (hN : 1≤N) (hB : 8≤B) (hΓ : 0<Γ) (hbase : 3≤Γ*B^2)
    (hstage : ∀ n h,historyGood good n h →
      eventMass (q n h) (fun ω=>¬good n h ω)≤metricStageFailure Γ N B n) :
    eventMass (historyWeight q (logStop N B))
      (fun h=>¬historyGood good (logStop N B) h)≤1/2 :=
  (adaptive_failure_bound q hq hqsum good (metricStageFailure Γ N B)
    (metricStageFailure_nonneg Γ N B (by linarith)) hstage (logStop N B)).trans
      (metricStageFailure_half Γ N B hN hB hΓ hbase)

end APC

APC.metricSizeGamma.source:
def metricSizeGamma (k : ℕ) (a ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp 16 * metricSizeBase k a ε * (1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε))

APC.metricSizeBase_bounds.source:
theorem metricSizeBase_bounds (k : ℕ) (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a)
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    1≤metricSizeBase k a ε ∧ (k:ℝ)≤metricSizeBase k a ε := by
  have hD : 1≤(23+22*a)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hE : ε^2≤1 := by nlinarith
  have hR : 0≤4*(64*a+8*a^2) := by positivity
  have hk : (0:ℝ)≤k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
  have hC : 1+(k:ℝ)≤1+48*(k:ℝ)+(4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(1+(k:ℝ)) := by nlinarith
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD
    (show 0≤1+48*(k:ℝ)+(4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(1+(k:ℝ)) by positivity)
  unfold metricSizeBase
  constructor <;> apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hε)).2 <;> nlinarith

APC.metricSizeGamma_bounds.source:
theorem metricSizeGamma_bounds (k : ℕ) (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a)
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    58*metricSizeBase k a ε*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε)) ≤ metricSizeGamma k a ε ∧
    Real.log (metricSizeGamma k a ε) ≤ 18*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε)) := by
  let H := metricSizeBase k a ε
  have hH : 1≤H := (metricSizeBase_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1).1
  have hHp : 0<H := by linarith
  have hl : 0≤Real.log H := Real.log_nonneg hH
  have hT : 0<1+Real.log H := by positivity
  have hexp := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤16)
  constructor
  · change 58*H*(1+Real.log H) ≤ Real.exp 16*H*(1+Real.log H)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num at hexp ⊢; linarith) hHp.le) hT.le
  · change Real.log (Real.exp 16*H*(1+Real.log H)) ≤ 18*(1+Real.log H)
    rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hHp)) (ne_of_gt hT),
      Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _)) (ne_of_gt hHp), Real.log_exp]
    have ht := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hT
    linarith

APC.log_logLevel_le.source:
theorem log_logLevel_le (x B : ℝ) (hB : 1≤B) (i : ℕ) :
    Real.log (logLevel x B i) ≤ logLevel x B (i+1) := by
  unfold logLevel
  by_cases h : iteratedLog x (i+1)≤B
  · rw [max_eq_right h]
    exact (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith)).trans
      (by linarith [le_max_right (iteratedLog x (i+1+1)) B])
  · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge h)]
    exact le_max_left _ _

/-- A one-stage envelope for the actual prescribed count. -/

APC.metricStageSampleCount_envelope.doc: A one-stage envelope for the actual prescribed count.
APC.metricStageSampleCount_envelope.source:
theorem metricStageSampleCount_envelope
    (k n : ℕ) (a ε L v : ℝ) (hk : 0<k) (hn : 0<n)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hL : 1≤L) (hv : 1≤v)
    (hlogn : Real.log (n:ℝ) ≤ 18*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε))+2*L)
    (hlogv : Real.log v≤3*L) :
    (metricStageSampleCount k n a (ε/Real.sqrt L) (1/(4*v)):ℝ) ≤
      metricSizeGamma k a ε*L^2 := by
  let H := metricSizeBase k a ε
  let T := 1+Real.log H
  let D := 23+22*a
  let R := 4*(64*a+8*a^2)
  have hHb := metricSizeBase_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1
  have hH : 1≤H := hHb.1
  have hT : 1≤T := by dsimp [T]; linarith [Real.log_nonneg hH]
  have hkp : (0:ℝ)<k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk
  have hnp : (0:ℝ)<n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hvp : 0<v := by linarith
  have hLp : 0<L := by linarith
  have hDp : 0<D := by dsimp [D]; linarith
  have hRp : 0≤R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have hlogk : Real.log (k:ℝ) ≤ T := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log hkp hHb.2
    dsimp [T]; linarith
  have heq : 8/(1/(4*v)) = 32*v := by field_simp; ring
  have heqk : 8*(k:ℝ)/(1/(4*v)) = 32*(k:ℝ)*v := by field_simp; ring
  have hlog32 : Real.log (32:ℝ)≤32 := by linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<32)]
  have hb : Real.log (8/(1/(4*v)))≤35*L := by
    rw [heq,Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (32:ℝ)≠0) (ne_of_gt hvp)]
    linarith
  have hbk : Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/(1/(4*v)))≤36*T*L := by
    rw [heqk,Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by norm_num) hkp)) (ne_of_gt hvp),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (32:ℝ)≠0) (ne_of_gt hkp)]
    have hTL : T≤T*L := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hL
    have hLT : L≤T*L := le_mul_of_one_le_left hLp.le hT
    nlinarith only [hlog32,hlogv,hlogk,hTL,hLT,hL]
  have hnlog : Real.log (n:ℝ)≤20*T*L := by
    change Real.log (n:ℝ)≤18*T+2*L at hlogn
    have hTL : T≤T*L := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hL
    have hLT : L≤T*L := le_mul_of_one_le_left hLp.le hT
    linarith
  let S := (48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/(1/(4*v)))
  let Q := R*(Real.log (8/(1/(4*v)))+(k:ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ))
  have hS : 0≤S := by
    dsimp [S]
    apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    rw [heqk]
    nlinarith [show (1:ℝ)≤k by exact_mod_cast hk]
  have hQ : 0≤Q := by
    dsimp [Q]
    apply mul_nonneg hRp
    apply add_nonneg
    · apply Real.log_nonneg; rw [heq]; linarith
    · exact mul_nonneg hkp.le (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hn))
  have hsum : S+Q≤56*(48*(k:ℝ)+R*(1+(k:ℝ)))*T*L := by
    have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbk (by positivity : 0≤48*(k:ℝ))
    have hn' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnlog hkp.le
    have hLT : L≤T*L := le_mul_of_one_le_left hLp.le hT
    have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show
        Real.log (8/(1/(4*v)))+(k:ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ) ≤
          56*(1+(k:ℝ))*T*L by nlinarith only [hb,hn',hLT, mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0≤T) hLp.le, mul_nonneg hkp.le (mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0≤T) hLp.le)]) hRp
    dsimp [S,Q]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0≤48*(k:ℝ)) (by nlinarith : 0≤20*T*L)]
  have hz : (ε/Real.sqrt L)/D≠0 := ne_of_gt (div_pos (div_pos hε (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hLp)) hDp)
  have hc := budgetSampleCount_upper S Q ((ε/Real.sqrt L)/D) hS hQ hz
  have hidentity : H*((ε/Real.sqrt L)/D)^2*L = 1+48*(k:ℝ)+R*(1+(k:ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [H,metricSizeBase,D,R]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hLp.le]
  have hscale : (S+Q)/((ε/Real.sqrt L)/D)^2 ≤ 56*H*T*L^2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hz)).2
    calc
      S+Q ≤ 56*(48*(k:ℝ)+R*(1+(k:ℝ)))*T*L := hsum
      _ ≤ 56*(1+48*(k:ℝ)+R*(1+(k:ℝ)))*T*L := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0≤T) hLp.le]
      _ = _ := by rw [←hidentity]; ring
  have hG := (metricSizeGamma_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1).1
  change 58*H*T≤metricSizeGamma k a ε at hG
  have hG' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG (sq_nonneg L)
  have hmin : 1≤H*T*L^2 := by
    have hh : 1≤H*T := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hH hT
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hh (by nlinarith)
  change (budgetSampleCount S Q ((ε/Real.sqrt L)/D):ℝ)≤_
  nlinarith only [hc,hscale,hG',hmin]

end APC

APC.log_metricIterationCount_one.source:
theorem log_metricIterationCount_one (x B : ℝ) (hB : 1≤B) (i : ℕ) :
    Real.log (metricIterationCount 1 x B i : ℝ) ≤ 1+2*Real.log (logLevel x B i) := by
  let U := logLevel x B i
  have hU : 1≤U := hB.trans (logLevel_lower x B i)
  have hUp : 0<U := by linarith
  have hm : (0:ℝ)<metricIterationCount 1 x B i := Nat.cast_pos.mpr
    (metricIterationCount_pos 1 x B (by norm_num) (by linarith) i)
  have hu := metricIterationCount_upper 1 x B (by norm_num) i
  have hb : (metricIterationCount 1 x B i:ℝ) ≤ 2*U^2 := by
    change (metricIterationCount 1 x B i:ℝ)<1*U^2+1 at hu
    nlinarith
  have hl := Real.log_le_log hm hb
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)≠0) (ne_of_gt (sq_pos_of_pos hUp)),Real.log_pow] at hl
  norm_num at hl
  dsimp only [U] at hl
  linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

APC.scheduledFailure_log_data.source:
theorem scheduledFailure_log_data (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, 1≤v ∧ MetricIteration.scheduledFailure N i=1/(4*v) ∧
      Real.log v≤3*logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i := by
  have hN : (1:ℝ)≤N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨N,hN,by simp [MetricIteration.scheduledFailure,metricStageFailure],?_⟩
    have hb : Real.log (N:ℝ) ≤ logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 0 := le_max_left _ _
    linarith [logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 0]
  | succ i =>
    refine ⟨metricIterationCount 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 i,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · exact_mod_cast metricIterationCount_pos 1 (N:ℝ) 14400 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) i
    · simp [MetricIteration.scheduledFailure,metricStageFailure,metricCountFailure]
    · have hb := log_metricIterationCount_one (N:ℝ) 14400 (by norm_num) i
      have hl := log_logLevel_le (N:ℝ) 14400 (by norm_num) i
      have hm := logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 (i+1)
      linarith

end APC

/-- The actual recursive counts have one parameter-only envelope. The
proof uses the checked local count, without replacing the sampling law. -/

APC.MetricIteration.recursive_size_envel.doc: The actual recursive counts have one parameter-only envelope. The proof uses the checked local count, without replacing the sampling law.
APC.MetricIteration.recursive_size_envel.source:
theorem recursive_size_envelope (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hk : 0<k)
    (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (i : ℕ) :
    (size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N) (i+1):ℝ) ≤
      metricSizeGamma k a ε*(logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i)^2 := by
  have hT : 1≤1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε) := by
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg (metricSizeBase_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1).1]
  have hΓ : 0<metricSizeGamma k a ε := by
    have hb := (metricSizeGamma_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1).1
    have hH := (metricSizeBase_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1).1
    nlinarith
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hδ,hlv⟩ := scheduledFailure_log_data N 0
    have hl : Real.log (N:ℝ)≤18*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε))+
        2*logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 0 := by
      have hh : Real.log (N:ℝ)≤logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 0 := le_max_left _ _
      linarith [logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 0]
    simpa only [size,logStageError,hδ] using metricStageSampleCount_envelope k N a ε
      (logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 0) v hk (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N)) ha hε hε1
      (by linarith [logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 0]) hv hl hlv
  | succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hδ,hlv⟩ := scheduledFailure_log_data N (i+1)
    have hpos := size_pos N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N) (i+1)
    have hU : 0<logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 i := by linarith [logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 i]
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hpos) ih
    rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hΓ) (ne_of_gt (sq_pos_of_pos hU)),Real.log_pow] at hlog
    norm_num at hlog
    have hl : Real.log (size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N) (i+1):ℝ) ≤
        18*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k a ε))+2*logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 (i+1) := by
      linarith [(metricSizeGamma_bounds k a ε ha hε hε1).2,
        log_logLevel_le (N:ℝ) 14400 (by norm_num) i]
    simpa only [size,logStageError,hδ] using metricStageSampleCount_envelope k
      (size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N) (i+1)) a ε
      (logLevel (N:ℝ) 14400 (i+1)) v hk hpos ha hε hε1
      (by linarith [logLevel_lower (N:ℝ) 14400 (i+1)]) hv hl hlv

/-- Input-size-independent terminal sample count, for the actual sampler
already used by finite_metric_correctness. -/

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_size_bound.doc: Input-size-independent terminal sample count, for the actual sampler already used by finite_metric_correctness.
APC.MetricIteration.terminal_size_bound.source:
theorem terminal_size_bound (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hk : 0<k)
    (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    (size N k a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400):ℝ) ≤ metricSizeGamma k a ε*14400^2 := by
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  have hb := recursive_size_envelope N k hk a ε ha hε hε1 (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400-1)
  rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (logStop_pos (N:ℝ) 14400),
    logLevel_terminal (N:ℝ) 14400 hN (by norm_num)] at hb

end APC.MetricIteration

/-- Distinct support size is bounded by the same parameter-only envelope
as the number of draws; repeated sampled points only reduce the support. -/

APC.MetricIteration.terminal_support_bou.doc: Distinct support size is bounded by the same parameter-only envelope as the number of draws; repeated sampled points only reduce the support.
APC.MetricIteration.terminal_support_bou.source:
theorem terminal_support_bound
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X] [DecidableEq X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X) (a ε : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a
      (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N))
    (h : Adaptive.History
      (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N))
      (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)) :
    let c := cloud N a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
      initial proxy (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) h
    ((Finset.univ.image c.points).card:ℝ) ≤ metricSizeGamma (Fintype.card K) a ε*14400^2 := by
  classical
  have hc : (Finset.univ.image
      (cloud N a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
        initial proxy (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) h).points).card ≤
      size N (Fintype.card K) a (logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε) (scheduledFailure N)
        (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400) := by
    exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
  exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr hc).trans
    (terminal_size_bound N (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos a ε ha hε hε1)

/-- Size and returned-center correctness of one and the same finite-metric
construction. No preservation, sample-budget or proxy premise is supplied.
The proxy is exact finite search, so no efficient-runtime claim is made. -/

APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_size_a.doc: Size and returned-center correctness of one and the same finite-metric construction. No preservation, sample-budget or proxy premise is supplied. The proxy is exact finite search, so no efficient-runtime claim is made.
APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_size_a.source:
theorem finite_metric_size_and_correctness
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    (size N (Fintype.card K) 1 e δ t:ℝ) ≤
      metricSizeGamma (Fintype.card K) 1 ε*14400^2 ∧
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h =>
      let c := cloud N 1 e δ initial proxy t h
      ∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → X),0≤α ∧ Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) α s ∧
        ¬Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) (α*(4+ε)) (rounded c s)) ≤ 1/2 := by
  exact ⟨terminal_size_bound N (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1,
    finite_metric_correctness N initial hw ε hε hε1⟩

end APC.MetricIteration

APC.metric_step_kernel.doc: A range-based form of the checked local concentration theorem, suited to the recursively changing finite input types.
APC.metric_step_kernel.source:
theorem metric_step_kernel
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (proxy opt : K → X) (a η δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hη : 0<η) (hη1 : η≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost x w) a proxy) :
    let m := metricStageSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card I) a η δ
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i => pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i => nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun z =>
      ¬MetricStep x w (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) opt η) ≤ δ := by
  classical
  have hb := metric_sampling_stage_explicit x w hw opt proxy a η δ ha hη hη1 hδ hproxy
  let m := metricStageSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card I) a η δ
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i => pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i => nearest proxy (x i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i =>
    (sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i => sq_nonneg _) i).le
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro z hbad
  by_contra hgood
  apply hbad
  intro s hs
  have hmem : s∈pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x ∨ s=opt := by
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · choose f hf using hs
      exact Or.inl ((mem_pointWitnessFamily x s).2 ⟨f,(funext hf).symm⟩)
    · exact Or.inr hs
  exact of_not_not (fun hh => hgood ⟨s,hmem,hh⟩)

APC.metric_step_kernel_budget.source:
theorem metric_step_kernel_budget
    {I K X : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (proxy opt : K → X) (a η δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hη : 0<η) (hη1 : η≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost x w) a proxy)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m)
    (hstruct : (48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ) ≤
      (m:ℝ)*(η/(23+22*a))^2)
    (hresid : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+
      (Fintype.card K:ℝ)*Real.log (Fintype.card I)) ≤
      (m:ℝ)*(η/(23+22*a))^2) :
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i => pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i => nearest proxy (x i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun z =>
      ¬MetricStep x w (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) opt η) ≤ δ := by
  classical
  have hb := metric_sampling_stage x w hw opt proxy a η δ ha hη hη1 hδ hproxy m hm hstruct hresid
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i => pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i => nearest proxy (x i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i =>
    (sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i => sq_nonneg _) i).le
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro z hbad
  by_contra hgood
  apply hbad
  intro s hs
  have hmem : s∈pointWitnessFamily (K:=K) x ∨ s=opt := by
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · choose f hf using hs
      exact Or.inl ((mem_pointWitnessFamily x s).2 ⟨f,(funext hf).symm⟩)
    · exact Or.inr hs
  exact of_not_not (fun hh => hgood ⟨s,hmem,hh⟩)

end APC

APC.MetricIteration.subsetOutput_support.source:
theorem subsetOutput_supported {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (c : Cloud (Fin m) X)
    (hkm : Fintype.card K≤m) : ∀ j,subsetOutput c hkm j∈Set.range c.points :=
  subsetSearch_supported c (by simpa using hkm)

APC.MetricIteration.subsetOutput_le_four.source:
theorem subsetOutput_le_four {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (c : Cloud (Fin m) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i) (hkm : Fintype.card K≤m) (s : K → X) :
    cost c.points c.weights (subsetOutput c hkm)≤4*cost c.points c.weights s :=
  subsetSearch_le_four c hw (by simpa using hkm) s

end Output

section Compression
variable {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {a : ℝ} {e δ : ℕ → ℝ}

APC.MetricIteration.subset_enumeration_c.source:
theorem subset_enumeration_chain_bound (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (he : ∀ i,0≤e i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (hkm : Fintype.card K≤size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n)
    (h : Adaptive.History (outcomes N (Fintype.card K) a e δ) n)
    (hh : Adaptive.historyGood (good initial proxy opt) n h) :
    cost initial.points initial.weights (subsetOutput (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h) hkm)≤
      (4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := by
  let c := cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h
  have hc : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i := fun i=>(cloud_pos initial hw proxy n h i).le
  have hp := chain_preserves initial hw proxy opt he n (by linarith) h hh
  have hpres : ∀ u,(∀ j,u j∈Set.range c.points) ∨ u=opt →
      Preserves (cost initial.points initial.weights u) (cost c.points c.weights u) (ε/20) := by
    intro u hu
    exact preserves_mono (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) u) (by linarith) (hp u hu)
  have hs := hpres (subsetOutput c hkm) (Or.inl (subsetOutput_supported c hkm))
  have ho := hpres opt (Or.inr rfl)
  have hb := witness_transfer (cost initial.points initial.weights) (cost c.points c.weights)
    (subsetOutput c hkm) (subsetOutput c hkm) opt 4 1 (ε/20) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by linarith) (subsetOutput_le_four c hc hkm) (by simp) hs.1 ho.2
  calc
    _≤4*((1+ε/20)/(1-ε/20))*cost initial.points initial.weights opt := by simpa using hb
    _≤_ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (metric_factor ε hε hε1)
      (cost_nonneg _ _ (fun i=>(hw i).le) opt)

/-- Every history is sampled exactly as before. The returned centers now
come from the best size-k subset, and the approximation factor is unchanged. -/

APC.MetricIteration.subset_enumeration_c.doc: Every history is sampled exactly as before. The returned centers now come from the best size-k subset, and the approximation factor is unchanged.
APC.MetricIteration.subset_enumeration_c.source:
theorem subset_enumeration_compression (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (proxy : Proxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N a e δ)
    (opt : K → X) (ha : 0<a) (he : ∀ n,0<e n) (he1 : ∀ n,e n≤1)
    (hδ : ∀ n,0<δ n)
    (hproxy : ∀ n c,(∀ j,0<c.weights j)→Approximate (cost c.points c.weights) a (proxy n c))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (n : ℕ) (hbudget : errorBudget e n≤ε/40)
    (hkm : Fintype.card K≤size N (Fintype.card K) a e δ n) :
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) n) (fun h=>
      (4+ε)*cost initial.points initial.weights opt<
        cost initial.points initial.weights (subsetOutput (cloud N a e δ initial proxy n h) hkm))≤errorBudget δ n := by
  have hb := all_stages_failure initial hw proxy opt ha he he1 hδ hproxy n
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) n) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad hgood
  exact not_lt_of_ge (subset_enumeration_chain_bound initial hw proxy opt (fun i=>(he i).le)
    ε hε hε1 n hbudget hkm h hgood) hbad

end Compression

/-- Actual subset-search output, the same adaptive sampler, and the sharp
binomial candidate envelope in one statement. Exact finite-search proxies
remove premises but do not verify near-linear preprocessing runtime. -/

APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_subset.doc: Actual subset-search output, the same adaptive sampler, and the sharp binomial candidate envelope in one statement. Exact finite-search proxies remove premises but do not verify near-linear preprocessing runtime.
APC.MetricIteration.finite_metric_subset.source:
theorem finite_metric_subset_enumeration_correctness
    {K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (initial : Cloud (Fin N) X)
    (hw : ∀ i,0 < initial.weights i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    let k := Fintype.card K
    let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
    let δ := scheduledFailure N
    let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
    let t := logStop (N:ℝ) 14400
    let m := size N k 1 e δ t
    let hkm := terminal_size_ge_centers N k Fintype.card_pos 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1
    (m.choose k:ℝ)≤(Real.exp 17*1265625*14400^2*(1+Real.log (metricSizeBase k 1 ε))/ε^2)^k ∧
    eventMass (Adaptive.historyWeight (transition initial proxy) t) (fun h=>
      ¬Approximate (cost initial.points initial.weights) (4+ε)
        (subsetOutput (cloud N 1 e δ initial proxy t h) hkm))≤1/2 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let e := logStageError (N:ℝ) 14400 ε
  let δ := scheduledFailure N
  let proxy := exactProxy (K:=K) (X:=X) N e δ
  let opt := optimalProxy (K:=K) initial
  have hkm := terminal_size_ge_centers N (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos 1 ε (by norm_num) hε hε1
  have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne N))
  have hb := (subset_enumeration_compression initial hw proxy opt (by norm_num)
    (scheduledError_pos N ε hε) (scheduledError_le_one N ε hε1) (scheduledFailure_pos N)
    (fun n c _=>optimalProxy_spec c) ε hε.le hε1 (logStop (N:ℝ) 14400)
    (logStageError_rescaled_budget (N:ℝ) ε hN hε.le) hkm).trans (scheduledFailure_budget N)
  refine ⟨terminal_binomial_parameter_bound N (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_pos ε hε hε1,?_⟩
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (Adaptive.historyWeight_nonneg _ (transition_nonneg initial hw proxy) _) _ _ ?_) hb
  intro h hbad
  by_contra hn
  apply hbad
  intro u
  have ho : cost initial.points initial.weights opt≤cost initial.points initial.weights u := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using optimalProxy_spec initial u
  exact (le_of_not_gt hn).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ho (by linarith))

end APC.MetricIteration

APC.oneCenter_mass_pos.source:
theorem oneCenter_mass_pos (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) : 0<mass w := by
  classical
  let i := Classical.arbitrary I
  exact (hw i).trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _=>(hw j).le) (Finset.mem_univ i))

APC.oneCenter_zero_variance_points.source:
theorem oneCenter_zero_variance_points (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hV : oneCost x w (mean x w)=0) : ∀ i,x i=mean x w := by
  intro i
  have hh : w i*‖x i-mean x w‖^2≤oneCost x w (mean x w) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun j=>w j*‖x j-mean x w‖^2)
      (fun j _=>mul_nonneg (hw j).le (sq_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [hV] at hh
  have hs : ‖x i-mean x w‖^2≤0 := (mul_le_mul_left (hw i)).mp (by simpa using hh)
  have hz : ‖x i-mean x w‖=0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x i-mean x w)]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz)

APC.oneCenterProbability_zero_variance.source:
theorem oneCenterProbability_zero_variance (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hV : oneCost x w (mean x w)=0) :
    ∀ i,oneCenterProbability x w i=w i/mass w := by
  have hx := oneCenter_zero_variance_points x w hw hV
  have hM : (∑ i,w i)≠0 := ne_of_gt (oneCenter_mass_pos w hw)
  intro i
  simp [oneCenterProbability,sensitivityProbability,clusterLaw,localCostLaw,globalCostLaw,
    deltaLaw,activeMass,groupMass,fiberWeight,hx,hM,mass]
  ring

/-- The zero-variance branch is exact on every draw, not merely with high
probability, and still uses the same sensitivity distribution. -/

APC.oneCenter_zero_variance_exact.doc: The zero-variance branch is exact on every draw, not merely with high probability, and still uses the same sensitivity distribution.
APC.oneCenter_zero_variance_exact.source:
theorem oneCenter_zero_variance_exact (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hV : oneCost x w (mean x w)=0)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) (z : Draws I m) (c : E) :
    oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z) c=oneCost x w c := by
  have hx := oneCenter_zero_variance_points x w hw hV
  have hp := oneCenterProbability_zero_variance x w hw hV
  have hM := oneCenter_mass_pos w hw
  have hmR : (0:ℝ)<m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  have hv : ∀ j,sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z j=mass w/(m:ℝ) := by
    intro j
    unfold sampledWeights
    rw [hp]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hM,ne_of_gt (hw (drawIndex m z j))]
  have hy : ∀ j,sampledPoints x m z j=mean x w := fun j=>hx _
  calc
    _=(m:ℝ)*(mass w/(m:ℝ)*‖mean x w-c‖^2) := by simp [oneCost,hv,hy]
    _=mass w*‖mean x w-c‖^2 := by field_simp
    _=oneCost x w c := by rw [variance_identity x w (ne_of_gt hM) c,hV,zero_add]

APC.oneCenterStrongSampleCount_valid.source:
theorem oneCenterStrongSampleCount_valid (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    0<oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε ∧
      36≤(oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε:ℝ)*(ε/2)^2 := by
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (144/ε^2)
  have hb : (Nat.ceil (144/ε^2):ℝ)≤oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε := by simp [oneCenterStrongSampleCount]
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hε)).mp (hc.trans hb)
  exact ⟨Nat.zero_lt_succ _,by nlinarith only [hh]⟩

APC.oneCenterStrongSampleCount_upper.source:
theorem oneCenterStrongSampleCount_upper (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    (oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε:ℝ)<144/ε^2+2 := by
  have hh := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity : 0≤(144:ℝ)/ε^2)
  simpa only [oneCenterStrongSampleCount,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using (by linarith : (Nat.ceil (144/ε^2):ℝ)+1<144/ε^2+2)

/-- An unconditional dimension- and input-size-independent strong coreset
construction for k=1. The actual sensitivity sampler and importance weights
preserve the cost of every center simultaneously with probability ≥2/3.
This is a special case, not the cited general-k strong-coreset primitive. -/

APC.oneCenter_strong_coreset.doc: An unconditional dimension- and input-size-independent strong coreset construction for k=1. The actual sensitivity sampler and importance weights preserve the cost of every center simultaneously with probability ≥2/3. This is a special case, not the cited general-k strong-coreset primitive.
APC.oneCenter_strong_coreset.source:
theorem oneCenter_strong_coreset (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    let m := oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε
    eventMass (drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m) (fun z=>∃ c,
      ¬Preserves (oneCost x w c)
        (oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z) c) ε)≤1/3 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  have hm := oneCenterStrongSampleCount_valid ε hε
  have hM := oneCenter_mass_pos w hw
  by_cases hV : oneCost x w (mean x w)=0
  · have hz : eventMass (drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) (oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε))
        (fun z=>∃ c,¬Preserves (oneCost x w c)
          (oneCost (sampledPoints x (oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε) z)
            (sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) (oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε) z) c) ε)=0 := by
      unfold eventMass
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro z _
      rw [if_neg]
      rintro ⟨c,hc⟩
      rw [oneCenter_zero_variance_exact x w hw hV _ hm.1 z c] at hc
      have hn := oneCost_nonneg x w (fun i=>(hw i).le) c
      apply hc
      constructor <;> nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε.le hn]
    rw [hz]
    norm_num
  · have hVp : 0<oneCost x w (mean x w) := lt_of_le_of_ne
      (oneCost_nonneg x w (fun i=>(hw i).le) _) (Ne.symm hV)
    simpa only [show 2*(ε/2)=ε by ring] using
      oneCenter_strong_failure_positive_variance x w hw hM hVp (oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε)
        hm.1 (ε/2) (by positivity) hm.2

end APC

APC.unit_cost_eq_oneCost.source:
theorem unit_cost_eq_oneCost (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (s : Unit → E) :
    cost x w s=oneCost x w (s ()) := by
  unfold cost pointCost oneCost
  have h : ∀ j : Unit,j=() := fun j=>Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp only [h,dist_eq_norm]

/-- The one-center construction in the center-tuple interface used by
the two-stage Euclidean compression theorems. -/

APC.oneCenter_strong_coreset_tuples.doc: The one-center construction in the center-tuple interface used by the two-stage Euclidean compression theorems.
APC.oneCenter_strong_coreset_tuples.source:
theorem oneCenter_strong_coreset_tuples [Nonempty I]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    let m := oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε
    eventMass (drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m) (fun z=>∃ s : Unit → E,
      ¬Preserves (cost x w s)
        (cost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z) s) ε)≤1/3 := by
  have hb := oneCenter_strong_coreset x w hw ε hε
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _
    (drawWeight_nonneg _ (fun i=>(oneCenterProbability_pos x w hw i).le) _) _ _ ?_) hb
  rintro z ⟨s,hs⟩
  exact ⟨s (),by simpa only [unit_cost_eq_oneCost] using hs⟩

/-- Existence of a positively weighted supported coreset, with all-center
preservation and an explicit dimension-free cardinality bound. -/

APC.exists_oneCenter_strong_coreset.doc: Existence of a positively weighted supported coreset, with all-center preservation and an explicit dimension-free cardinality bound.
APC.exists_oneCenter_strong_coreset.source:
theorem exists_oneCenter_strong_coreset [Nonempty I]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    let m := oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε
    (m:ℝ)<144/ε^2+2 ∧ ∃ (f : Fin m → I) (v : Fin m → ℝ),
      (∀ j,0<v j) ∧ ∀ c,Preserves (oneCost x w c) (oneCost (fun j=>x (f j)) v c) ε := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨oneCenterStrongSampleCount_upper ε hε,?_⟩
  let m := oneCenterStrongSampleCount ε
  let p := oneCenterProbability x w
  have hp := oneCenterProbability_pos x w hw
  have hm := oneCenterStrongSampleCount_valid ε hε
  have hex : ∃ z : Draws I m,∀ c,Preserves (oneCost x w c)
      (oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) c) ε := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have hb := oneCenter_strong_coreset x w hw ε hε
    have he : eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun z=>∃ c,
      ¬Preserves (oneCost x w c) (oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) c) ε)=1 := by
      unfold eventMass
      simp only [if_pos (hn _)]
      exact drawWeight_sum p (oneCenterProbability_sum x w hw) m
    change eventMass (drawWeight p m) _≤1/3 at hb
    linarith
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨drawIndex m z,sampledWeights w p m z,?_,hz⟩
  intro j
  exact div_pos (hw _) (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm.1) (hp _))

end APC

APC.oneCost_reference_expansion.doc: Expansion around any reference point, without assuming it is the weighted centroid of the second cloud.
APC.oneCost_reference_expansion.source:
theorem oneCost_reference_expansion (y : J → E) (v : J → ℝ) (μ c : E) :
    oneCost y v c = oneCost y v μ + mass v*‖μ-c‖^2 +
      2*inner ℝ (∑ j,v j • (y j-μ)) (μ-c) := by
  have he : ∀ j,v j*‖y j-c‖^2 = v j*‖y j-μ‖^2+
      v j*‖μ-c‖^2+2*(v j*inner ℝ (y j-μ) (μ-c)) := by
    intro j
    rw [show y j-c=(y j-μ)+(μ-c) by abel,norm_add_sq_real]
    ring
  unfold oneCost mass
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_add_distrib,←Finset.sum_mul,←Finset.mul_sum]
  have hc : (∑ j,v j*inner ℝ (y j-μ) (μ-c)) = inner ℝ (∑ j,v j • (y j-μ)) (μ-c) := by
    simp_rw [←real_inner_smul_left]
    rw [sum_inner]
  rw [hc]

/-- Cauchy--Schwarz and a scalar square control the centered first moment
uniformly over every possible query center. -/

APC.inner_moment_bound.doc: Cauchy--Schwarz and a scalar square control the centered first moment uniformly over every possible query center.
APC.inner_moment_bound.source:
theorem inner_moment_bound (z d : E) (M V η : ℝ)
    (hM : 0≤M) (hV : 0≤V) (hη : 0≤η)
    (hz : ‖z‖^2≤η^2*M*V) :
    |2*inner ℝ z d|≤η*(V+M*‖d‖^2) := by
  have hi := abs_real_inner_le_norm z d
  have hi2 : |inner ℝ z d|^2≤‖z‖^2*‖d‖^2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hi 2
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz (sq_nonneg ‖d‖)
  have hgap : 0≤η^2*(V-M*‖d‖^2)^2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hright : 0≤η*(V+M*‖d‖^2) := by positivity
  rw [abs_mul]
  norm_num
  nlinarith only [hi2,hs,hgap,hright,abs_nonneg (inner ℝ z d)]

/-- Three normalized moment estimates suffice for a strong coreset for
one-center Euclidean clustering; the conclusion quantifies over all E. -/

APC.oneCenter_strong_of_moments.doc: Three normalized moment estimates suffice for a strong coreset for one-center Euclidean clustering; the conclusion quantifies over all E.
APC.oneCenter_strong_of_moments.source:
theorem oneCenter_strong_of_moments
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hM : 0<mass w)
    (y : J → E) (v : J → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0≤η)
    (hMass : |mass v-mass w|≤η*mass w)
    (hVariance : |oneCost y v (mean x w)-oneCost x w (mean x w)|≤η*oneCost x w (mean x w))
    (hMean : ‖∑ j,v j • (y j-mean x w)‖^2≤η^2*mass w*oneCost x w (mean x w)) :
