    ∀ c,Preserves (oneCost x w c) (oneCost y v c) (2*η) := by
  intro c
  let V := oneCost x w (mean x w)
  let d := mean x w-c
  have hV : 0≤V := oneCost_nonneg x w hw _
  have hb := inner_moment_bound (∑ j,v j • (y j-mean x w)) d (mass w) V η hM.le hV hη hMean
  have hcost := variance_identity x w (ne_of_gt hM) c
  have hy := oneCost_reference_expansion y v (mean x w) c
  have hmass := (abs_le.mp hMass)
  have hvar := (abs_le.mp hVariance)
  have hcross := abs_le.mp hb
  have hml := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass.1 (sq_nonneg ‖d‖)
  have hmu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass.2 (sq_nonneg ‖d‖)
  dsimp [V,d] at hV hb hcross hml hmu
  have hcostη := congrArg (fun z : ℝ=>η*z) hcost
  constructor <;> dsimp [Preserves] <;>
    nlinarith only [hcost,hcostη,hy,hvar.1,hvar.2,hcross.1,hcross.2,hml,hmu]

end APC

APC.oneCenterProbability.doc: The existing four-component sampler with the exact one-center proxy.
APC.oneCenterProbability.source:
def oneCenterProbability (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) : I → ℝ :=
  sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>‖x i-mean x w‖^2) (fun _=>Unit.unit)

APC.oneCenterProbability_pos.source:
theorem oneCenterProbability_pos [Nonempty I] (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) : ∀ i,0<oneCenterProbability x w i :=
  sensitivityProbability_pos _ _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _)

APC.oneCenterProbability_sum.source:
theorem oneCenterProbability_sum [Nonempty I] (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) : ∑ i,oneCenterProbability x w i=1 :=
  sensitivityProbability_sum _ _ _ hw

APC.oneCenterProbability_bounds.source:
theorem oneCenterProbability_bounds [Nonempty I] (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (i : I) :
    w i≤4*mass w*oneCenterProbability x w i ∧
    w i*‖x i-mean x w‖^2≤4*oneCost x w (mean x w)*oneCenterProbability x w i := by
  have hw' := sensitivity_weight_lower w (fun i=>‖x i-mean x w‖^2)
    (fun _=>Unit.unit) hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i
  have hv' := sensitivity_global_cost_lower w (fun i=>‖x i-mean x w‖^2)
    (fun _=>Unit.unit) hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i
  constructor
  · simpa only [Fintype.card_unique,Nat.cast_one,mul_one,groupMass,fiberWeight,ite_true,mass]
      using hw'
  · exact hv'

APC.sampled_mass_estimator.source:
theorem sampled_mass_estimator (w p : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) :
    mass (sampledWeights w p m z)=importanceEstimate p w m z := by
  simp only [mass,sampledWeights,importanceEstimate,drawSum_eq_sum,Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

APC.sampled_oneCost_estimator.source:
theorem sampled_oneCost_estimator (x : I → E) (w p : I → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) (μ : E) :
    oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w p m z) μ=
      importanceEstimate p (fun i=>w i*‖x i-μ‖^2) m z := by
  simp only [oneCost,sampledPoints,sampledWeights,importanceEstimate,drawSum_eq_sum,Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

APC.vectorDrawSum_eq_sum.source:
theorem vectorDrawSum_eq_sum (f : I → E) (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) :
    drawSum f m z=∑ j,f (drawIndex m z j) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases z with ⟨i,tail⟩
    simp [drawSum,drawIndex,Fin.sum_univ_succ,ih]

APC.sampled_centered_vector.source:
theorem sampled_centered_vector (x : I → E) (w p : I → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) (μ : E) :
    (∑ j,sampledWeights w p m z j • (sampledPoints x m z j-μ))=
      vectorImportance p (fun i=>w i • (x i-μ)) m z := by
  unfold vectorImportance
  rw [vectorDrawSum_eq_sum,Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [sampledWeights,sampledPoints,smul_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  congr 1
  ring

/-- The vector moment used by the actual sensitivity sampler is bounded
without a dimension factor. -/

APC.oneCenter_vector_mse.doc: The vector moment used by the actual sensitivity sampler is bounded without a dimension factor.
APC.oneCenter_vector_mse.source:
theorem oneCenter_vector_mse [Nonempty I] (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hM : 0<mass w) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) :
    (∑ z,drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m z*
      ‖vectorImportance (oneCenterProbability x w) (fun i=>w i • (x i-mean x w)) m z‖^2)≤
      4*mass w*oneCost x w (mean x w)/(m:ℝ) := by
  let p := oneCenterProbability x w
  have hp := oneCenterProbability_pos x w hw
  rw [vectorImportance_mse p _ hp (oneCenterProbability_sum x w hw)
    (centered_sum x w (ne_of_gt hM)) m hm]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  unfold oneCost
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [norm_smul,mul_pow,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (hp i)).2
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (oneCenterProbability_bounds x w hw i).1
    (mul_nonneg (hw i).le (sq_nonneg ‖x i-mean x w‖))
  nlinarith only [hb]

end APC

APC.oneCenterMomentEnergy.source:
def oneCenterMomentEnergy (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) : ℝ :=
  let p := oneCenterProbability x w
  let y := sampledPoints x m z
  let v := sampledWeights w p m z
  (mass v-mass w)^2/(mass w)^2+
    (oneCost y v (mean x w)-oneCost x w (mean x w))^2/(oneCost x w (mean x w))^2+
    ‖∑ j,v j • (y j-mean x w)‖^2/(mass w*oneCost x w (mean x w))

APC.oneCenterMomentEnergy_nonneg.source:
theorem oneCenterMomentEnergy_nonneg (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) : 0≤oneCenterMomentEnergy x w m z := by
  unfold oneCenterMomentEnergy
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
  · exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg
      (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _=>hw i)) (oneCost_nonneg x w hw _))

/-- Expected normalized error is O(1/m), independently of dimension. -/

APC.oneCenterMomentEnergy_expectation.doc: Expected normalized error is O(1/m), independently of dimension.
APC.oneCenterMomentEnergy_expectation.source:
theorem oneCenterMomentEnergy_expectation [Nonempty I]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (hM : 0<mass w) (hV : 0<oneCost x w (mean x w)) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) :
    (∑ z,drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m z*oneCenterMomentEnergy x w m z)≤12/(m:ℝ) := by
  let p := oneCenterProbability x w
  let M := mass w
  let V := oneCost x w (mean x w)
  have hp := oneCenterProbability_pos x w hw
  have h1 := oneCenterProbability_sum x w hw
  have hA := importance_estimator_mse_bound p w hp h1 (fun i=>(hw i).le) (4*M)
    (fun i=>(oneCenterProbability_bounds x w hw i).1) m hm
  have hB := importance_estimator_mse_bound p (fun i=>w i*‖x i-mean x w‖^2) hp h1
    (fun i=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (sq_nonneg _)) (4*V)
    (fun i=>(oneCenterProbability_bounds x w hw i).2) m hm
  have hZ := oneCenter_vector_mse x w hw hM m hm
  change (∑ z,drawWeight p m z*(importanceEstimate p w m z-M)^2)≤4*M*M/(m:ℝ) at hA
  change (∑ z,drawWeight p m z*(importanceEstimate p (fun i=>w i*‖x i-mean x w‖^2) m z-V)^2)≤4*V*V/(m:ℝ) at hB
  have hA' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hA (sq_nonneg M)
  have hB' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hB (sq_nonneg V)
  have hZ' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hZ (mul_nonneg hM.le hV.le)
  have hMA : (4*M*M/(m:ℝ))/M^2=4/(m:ℝ) := by dsimp [M];field_simp [ne_of_gt hM] <;> ring
  have hVB : (4*V*V/(m:ℝ))/V^2=4/(m:ℝ) := by dsimp [V];field_simp [ne_of_gt hV] <;> ring
  have hVZ : (4*mass w*oneCost x w (mean x w)/(m:ℝ))/(mass w*oneCost x w (mean x w))=4/(m:ℝ) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hM,ne_of_gt hV] <;> ring
  rw [hMA] at hA'
  rw [hVB] at hB'
  rw [hVZ] at hZ'
  unfold oneCenterMomentEnergy
  simp_rw [sampled_mass_estimator,sampled_oneCost_estimator,sampled_centered_vector,
    mul_add,←mul_div_assoc,Finset.sum_add_distrib,←Finset.sum_div]
  change _≤_
  convert add_le_add (add_le_add hA' hB') hZ' using 1 <;> ring

/-- A small joint moment error implies uniform strong preservation. -/

APC.oneCenterMomentEnergy_preserves.doc: A small joint moment error implies uniform strong preservation.
APC.oneCenterMomentEnergy_preserves.source:
theorem oneCenterMomentEnergy_preserves
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (hM : 0<mass w) (hV : 0<oneCost x w (mean x w))
    (m : ℕ) (z : Draws I m) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0≤η)
    (henergy : oneCenterMomentEnergy x w m z≤η^2) :
    ∀ c,Preserves (oneCost x w c)
      (oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z) c) (2*η) := by
  let y := sampledPoints x m z
  let v := sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z
  let M := mass w
  let V := oneCost x w (mean x w)
  let A := mass v-M
  let B := oneCost y v (mean x w)-V
  let Z := ∑ j,v j • (y j-mean x w)
  change A^2/M^2+B^2/V^2+‖Z‖^2/(M*V)≤η^2 at henergy
  have hA0 : 0≤A^2/M^2 := by positivity
  have hB0 : 0≤B^2/V^2 := by positivity
  have hZ0 : 0≤‖Z‖^2/(M*V) := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hM.le hV.le)
  have hA : A^2≤η^2*M^2 := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hM)).mp (by linarith)
  have hB : B^2≤η^2*V^2 := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hV)).mp (by linarith)
  have hZ : ‖Z‖^2≤η^2*M*V := by
    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hM hV)).mp (show ‖Z‖^2/(M*V)≤η^2 by linarith)
    nlinarith only [hh]
  apply oneCenter_strong_of_moments x w hw hM y v η hη
  · change |A|≤η*M
    nlinarith [sq_abs A,abs_nonneg A,mul_nonneg hη hM.le]
  · change |B|≤η*V
    nlinarith [sq_abs B,abs_nonneg B,mul_nonneg hη hV.le]
  · exact hZ

/-- Uniform concentration over the entire (possibly infinite-dimensional)
space of one-center queries. No finite query net is assumed. -/

APC.oneCenter_strong_failure_positive_va.doc: Uniform concentration over the entire (possibly infinite-dimensional) space of one-center queries. No finite query net is assumed.
APC.oneCenter_strong_failure_positive_va.source:
theorem oneCenter_strong_failure_positive_variance [Nonempty I]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (hM : 0<mass w) (hV : 0<oneCost x w (mean x w))
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η) (hbudget : 36≤(m:ℝ)*η^2) :
    eventMass (drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m) (fun z=>∃ c,
      ¬Preserves (oneCost x w c)
        (oneCost (sampledPoints x m z) (sampledWeights w (oneCenterProbability x w) m z) c) (2*η))≤1/3 := by
  have hp := drawWeight_nonneg _ (fun i=>(oneCenterProbability_pos x w hw i).le) m
  have hb := finite_markov (drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m)
    (oneCenterMomentEnergy x w m) hp (oneCenterMomentEnergy_nonneg x w (fun i=>(hw i).le) m) (η^2)
  have he := oneCenterMomentEnergy_expectation x w hw hM hV m hm
  have hmass := eventMass_nonneg _ hp (fun z=>η^2<oneCenterMomentEnergy x w m z)
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb.trans he) (Nat.cast_nonneg m : (0:ℝ)≤m)
  have hid : (m:ℝ)*(12/(m:ℝ))=12 := by field_simp
  rw [hid] at hscaled
  have hbudget' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbudget hmass
  have hprob : eventMass (drawWeight (oneCenterProbability x w) m)
      (fun z=>η^2<oneCenterMomentEnergy x w m z)≤1/3 := by nlinarith only [hscaled,hbudget']
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ hp _ _ ?_) hprob
  rintro z ⟨c,hc⟩
  by_contra hn
  exact hc (oneCenterMomentEnergy_preserves x w (fun i=>(hw i).le) hM hV m z η hη.le (le_of_not_gt hn) c)

end APC

APC.fiberWeight.source:
def fiberWeight {I K : Type*} (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (j : K) (i : I) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if a i=j then w i else 0

APC.groupMass.source:
def groupMass {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (j : K) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i,fiberWeight w a j i

APC.fiberWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem fiberWeight_nonneg {I K : Type*} (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (j : K) : ∀ i,0≤fiberWeight w a j i := by
  classical
  intro i
  simp only [fiberWeight]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

APC.groupMass_nonneg.source:
theorem groupMass_nonneg {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (j : K) : 0≤groupMass w a j :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _=>fiberWeight_nonneg w a hw j i)

APC.own_le_groupMass.source:
theorem own_le_groupMass {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (i : I) : w i≤groupMass w a (a i) := by
  classical
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _=>fiberWeight_nonneg w a hw (a i) j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  simpa only [fiberWeight,if_pos rfl] using h

APC.group_sum.source:
theorem group_sum {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype K]
    (a : I → K) (f : K → I → ℝ) :
    (∑ j,∑ i,if a i=j then f j i else 0)=∑ i,f (a i) i := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

APC.groupMass_total.source:
theorem groupMass_total {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype K]
    (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) : ∑ j,groupMass w a j=mass w := by
  classical
  exact group_sum a (fun _ i=>w i)

APC.groupMass_zero_terms.source:
theorem groupMass_zero_terms {I K : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (j : K)
    (hz : groupMass w a j=0) : ∀ i,fiberWeight w a j i=0 := by
  intro i
  have hle : fiberWeight w a j i≤groupMass w a j :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _=>fiberWeight_nonneg w a hw j l) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact le_antisymm (hz ▸ hle) (fiberWeight_nonneg w a hw j i)

APC.groupMass_mul_zero.source:
theorem groupMass_mul_zero {I K : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (j : K)
    (hz : groupMass w a j=0) : groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j=0 := by
  classical
  have ht := groupMass_zero_terms w a hw j hz
  unfold groupMass
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  have he : fiberWeight (fun i=>w i*c i) a j i=fiberWeight w a j i*c i := by
    simp [fiberWeight,ite_mul]
  rw [he,ht i,zero_mul]

APC.group_div_sum.source:
theorem group_div_sum {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype K]
    (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (d : K → ℝ) :
    (∑ i,w i/d (a i))=∑ j,groupMass w a j/d j := by
  classical
  simp only [groupMass,fiberWeight,Finset.sum_div,ite_div,zero_div]
  exact (group_sum a (fun j i=>w i/d j)).symm

APC.group_mul_sum.source:
theorem group_mul_sum {I K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype K]
    (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (d : K → ℝ) :
    (∑ i,w i*d (a i))=∑ j,groupMass w a j*d j := by
  classical
  simp only [groupMass,fiberWeight,Finset.sum_mul,ite_mul,zero_mul]
  exact (group_sum a (fun j i=>w i*d j)).symm

end APC

APC.fiber_cost_total.source:
theorem fiber_cost_total (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (s : K → X) :
    (∑ j,cost x (fiberWeight w a j) s)=cost x w s := by
  simp only [cost,fiberWeight,ite_mul,zero_mul]
  exact group_sum a (fun _ i=>w i*pointCost s (x i))

APC.fiber_proxy_cost.source:
theorem fiber_proxy_cost (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (proxy : K → X) (j : K) :
    proxyCost x (fiberWeight w (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j) (proxy j)=
      groupMass (fun i=>w i*pointCost proxy (x i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j := by
  unfold proxyCost groupMass
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [fiberWeight,pointCost]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
  · simp

APC.partition_residual_sum.source:
theorem partition_residual_sum (x : I → X) (w v : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (proxy s : K → X) (close : K → Prop) :
    (∑ i,(v i-w i)*partitionResidual x a proxy s close i)=
    ∑ j,if close j then cost x (fiberWeight v a j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w a j) s-
      (groupMass v a j-groupMass w a j)*pointCost s (proxy j) else 0 := by
  unfold partitionResidual
  rw [← group_sum a (fun j i=>(v i-w i)*(if close j then pointCost s (x i)-pointCost s (proxy j) else 0))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : close j
  · simp only [if_pos hj,cost,groupMass,fiberWeight,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_mul,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> ring
  · simp [hj]

APC.global_error_decomposition.source:
theorem global_error_decomposition (x : I → X) (w v : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (proxy s : K → X) (close : K → Prop) :
    cost x v s-cost x w s=
      (∑ i,(v i-w i)*partitionResidual x a proxy s close i)+
      (∑ j,if close j then (groupMass v a j-groupMass w a j)*pointCost s (proxy j) else 0)+
      (∑ j,if close j then 0 else cost x (fiberWeight v a j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w a j) s) := by
  rw [partition_residual_sum]
  have htotal : cost x v s-cost x w s=
      ∑ j,(cost x (fiberWeight v a j) s-cost x (fiberWeight w a j) s) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,fiber_cost_total,fiber_cost_total]
  rw [htotal,← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases h : close j <;> simp [h] <;> ring

APC.representative_group_bound.source:
theorem representative_group_bound (x : I → X) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (proxy s : K → X) :
    (∑ j,groupMass w (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) j*pointCost s (proxy j))≤
      2*(cost x w proxy+cost x w s) := by
  rw [← group_mul_sum w (fun i=>nearest proxy (x i)) (fun j=>pointCost s (proxy j))]
  exact representative_cost_bound x w hw proxy s

end APC

APC.productWeight.source:
def productWeight {K Ω : Type*} [Fintype K] (p : K → Ω → ℝ) (sample : K → Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∏ j,p j (sample j)

APC.productWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem productWeight_nonneg {K Ω : Type*} [Fintype K] (p : K → Ω → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ j ω,0≤p j ω) (sample : K → Ω) : 0≤productWeight p sample :=
  Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _=>hp j (sample j))

APC.productWeight_sum.source:
theorem productWeight_sum {K Ω : Type*} [Fintype K] [Fintype Ω]
    (p : K → Ω → ℝ) (h1 : ∀ j,∑ ω,p j ω=1) : ∑ sample,productWeight p sample=1 := by
  unfold productWeight
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum]
  simp [h1]

/-- Exact marginal of a coordinate in the joint independent-cluster law. -/

APC.productWeight_marginal.doc: Exact marginal of a coordinate in the joint independent-cluster law.
APC.productWeight_marginal.source:
theorem productWeight_marginal {K Ω : Type*} [Fintype K] [Fintype Ω]
    (p : K → Ω → ℝ) (h1 : ∀ j,∑ ω,p j ω=1) (j : K) (bad : Ω → Prop) :
    eventMass (productWeight p) (fun sample=>bad (sample j))=eventMass (p j) bad := by
  classical
  let g : K → Ω → ℝ := fun k ω=>if k=j then (if bad ω then p k ω else 0) else p k ω
  have he : ∀ sample : K → Ω,
      (if bad (sample j) then productWeight p sample else 0)=∏ k,g k (sample k) := by
    intro sample
    by_cases hb : bad (sample j)
    · rw [if_pos hb]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro k _
      by_cases hk : k=j
      · subst k
        simp [g,hb]
      · simp [g,hk]
    · rw [if_neg hb]
      symm
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (by simp [g,hb])
  unfold eventMass
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum]
  have hs : ∀ k,(∑ ω,g k ω)=if k=j then eventMass (p j) bad else 1 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k=j
    · subst k
      simp [g,eventMass]
    · simp [g,hk,h1]
  simp_rw [hs]
  simp [eventMass]

/-- A finite conditional experiment: the second draw may depend on the
first. This models randomized lifting after solving a sampled coreset. -/

APC.kernelWeight.doc: A finite conditional experiment: the second draw may depend on the first. This models randomized lifting after solving a sampled coreset.
APC.kernelWeight.source:
def kernelWeight {Ω Λ : Type*} (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → Λ → ℝ) (sample : Ω × Λ) : ℝ :=
  p sample.1*q sample.1 sample.2

APC.kernelWeight_nonneg.source:
theorem kernelWeight_nonneg {Ω Λ : Type*} (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → Λ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ ω,0≤p ω) (hq : ∀ ω z,0≤q ω z) (sample : Ω × Λ) :
    0≤kernelWeight p q sample := mul_nonneg (hp sample.1) (hq sample.1 sample.2)

APC.kernelWeight_sum.source:
theorem kernelWeight_sum {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → Λ → ℝ) (hp : ∑ ω,p ω=1) (hq : ∀ ω,∑ z,q ω z=1) :
    ∑ sample,kernelWeight p q sample=1 := by
  unfold kernelWeight
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum,hq,mul_one]
  exact hp

APC.kernel_event_bound.source:
theorem kernel_event_bound {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → Λ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ ω,0≤p ω) (hpsum : ∑ ω,p ω=1)
    (hq : ∀ ω z,0≤q ω z) (hqsum : ∀ ω,∑ z,q ω z=1)
    (good : Ω → Prop) (bad : Ω → Λ → Prop) (δ η : ℝ)
    (hη : 0≤η) (hfirst : eventMass p (fun ω=>¬good ω)≤δ)
    (hsecond : ∀ ω,good ω→eventMass (q ω) (bad ω)≤η) :
    eventMass (kernelWeight p q) (fun sample=>bad sample.1 sample.2)≤δ+η := by
  classical
  have he : eventMass (kernelWeight p q) (fun sample=>bad sample.1 sample.2)=
      ∑ ω,p ω*eventMass (q ω) (bad ω) := by
    unfold eventMass kernelWeight
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ω _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [he]
  have hle : ∀ ω,eventMass (q ω) (bad ω)≤(if good ω then η else 1) := by
    intro ω
    by_cases hg : good ω
    · simpa [hg] using hsecond ω hg
    · rw [if_neg hg]
      have hh := eventMass_mono (q ω) (hq ω) (bad ω) (fun _=>True) (fun _ _=>True.intro)
      simpa [eventMass,hqsum ω] using hh
  calc
    _≤∑ ω,p ω*(if good ω then η else 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _=>mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle ω) (hp ω))
    _≤eventMass p (fun ω=>¬good ω)+η*(∑ ω,p ω) := by
      unfold eventMass
      rw [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro ω _
      by_cases hg : good ω <;> simp [hg] <;> nlinarith only [mul_nonneg hη (hp ω)]
    _≤δ+η := by rw [hpsum,mul_one];linarith only [hfirst]

end APC

APC.LiftOutcome.source: abbrev LiftOutcome (I K : Type*) (m r : ℕ) := K → MeanTrials I m r

APC.liftingWeights.source:
def liftingWeights (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (s : K → E) (j : K) : I → ℝ :=
  clusterWeight w (fun i=>nearest s (x i)) j

APC.randomLift.source:
def randomLift (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (s : K → E) (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r]
    (sample : LiftOutcome I K m r) : K → E :=
  fun j=>bestMean x (liftingWeights x w s j) m r (sample j)

APC.liftingTrialsLaw_sum.source:
theorem liftingTrialsLaw_sum (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (s : K → E) (m r : ℕ) :
    ∑ sample,liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r sample=1 :=
  productWeight_sum _ (fun j=>meanTrialsWeight_sum (liftingWeights x w s j) m r)

APC.liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg.source:
theorem liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (s : K → E) (m r : ℕ) (sample : LiftOutcome I K m r) :
    0≤liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r sample :=
  productWeight_nonneg _ (fun j trials=>meanTrialsWeight_nonneg _
    (clusterWeight_nonneg w _ hw j) m r trials) sample

/-- Every output is in the finite m-point-mean witness family, including
outcomes with probability zero and zero-mass clusters. -/

APC.randomLift_mem_witness.doc: Every output is in the finite m-point-mean witness family, including outcomes with probability zero and zero-mass clusters.
APC.randomLift_mem_witness.source:
theorem randomLift_mem_witness (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (s : K → E)
    (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (sample : LiftOutcome I K m r) :
    randomLift x w s m r sample∈witnessFamily x m := by
  have he : randomLift x w s m r sample=
      (fun j=>tupleMean x m (drawIndex m (bestTrial x (liftingWeights x w s j) m r (sample j)))) := by
    funext j
    exact drawMean_eq_tupleMean x m _
  rw [he]
  exact mem_witnessFamily x m _

APC.randomLift_cost_of_cluster_good.source:
theorem randomLift_cost_of_cluster_good (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (s : K → E) (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε)
    (sample : LiftOutcome I K m r)
    (hgood : ∀ j,oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (randomLift x w s m r sample j)≤
      (1+ε)*oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (mean x (liftingWeights x w s j))) :
    cost x w (randomLift x w s m r sample)≤(1+ε)*cost x w s := by
  let a : I → K := fun i=>nearest s (x i)
  have hmin : ∀ j,oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (mean x (liftingWeights x w s j))≤
      oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (s j) := by
    intro j
    have hv := clusterWeight_nonneg w a hw j
    by_cases hz : mass (liftingWeights x w s j)=0
    · simp only [oneCost_zero_mass x (liftingWeights x w s j) hv hz]
      exact le_rfl
    · exact mean_minimizes x _ hv hz (s j)
  calc
    _≤∑ i,w i*dist (x i) (randomLift x w s m r sample (a i))^2 :=
      cost_le_assigned x w hw _ a
    _=∑ j,oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (randomLift x w s m r sample j) :=
      (cluster_cost_sum x w a _).symm
    _≤∑ j,(1+ε)*oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (mean x (liftingWeights x w s j)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=>hgood j)
    _≤∑ j,(1+ε)*oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (s j) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=>mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmin j) (by linarith))
    _=(1+ε)*cost x w s := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      change (1+ε)*(∑ j,oneCost x (clusterWeight w a j) (s j))=(1+ε)*cost x w s
      rw [cluster_cost_sum]
      rfl

/-- Lemma 3.4 for the joint output of Algorithm 3. Independence is encoded
by the product law, and the best sampled trial is the actual returned
center. The bound is k*(1/3)^r, before choosing r. -/

APC.randomized_lifting_failure.doc: Lemma 3.4 for the joint output of Algorithm 3. Independence is encoded by the product law, and the best sampled trial is the actual returned center. The bound is k*(1/3)^r, before choosing r.
APC.randomized_lifting_failure.source:
theorem randomized_lifting_failure (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (s : K → E) (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (hm : 0<m)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0≤ε) (hmε : 3≤(m:ℝ)*ε) :
    eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r)
      (fun sample=>(1+ε)*cost x w s<cost x w (randomLift x w s m r sample))≤
      (Fintype.card K:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^r := by
  let bad := fun j (sample : LiftOutcome I K m r)=>
    (1+ε)*oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (mean x (liftingWeights x w s j))<
      oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (randomLift x w s m r sample j)
  have hpoint : ∀ j,eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r) (bad j)≤(1/3:ℝ)^r := by
    intro j
    have he : eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r) (bad j)=
        eventMass (meanTrialsWeight (liftingWeights x w s j) m r)
          (fun trials=>(1+ε)*oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (mean x (liftingWeights x w s j))<
            oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (bestMean x (liftingWeights x w s j) m r trials)) :=
      productWeight_marginal (fun k=>meanTrialsWeight (liftingWeights x w s k) m r)
        (fun k=>meanTrialsWeight_sum (liftingWeights x w s k) m r) j
        (fun trials=>(1+ε)*oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (mean x (liftingWeights x w s j))<
          oneCost x (liftingWeights x w s j) (bestMean x (liftingWeights x w s j) m r trials))
    rw [he]
    exact bestMean_failure x _ (clusterWeight_nonneg w _ hw j) m r hm ε hmε
  have hc : ∀ sample,(1+ε)*cost x w s<cost x w (randomLift x w s m r sample)→∃ j,bad j sample := by
    intro sample hs
    by_contra hn
    have hb := randomLift_cost_of_cluster_good x w hw s m r ε hε sample
      (fun j=>le_of_not_gt (fun hj=>hn ⟨j,hj⟩))
    exact not_lt_of_ge hb hs
  have hp := liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg x w hw s m r
  calc
    _≤eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r) (fun sample=>∃ j,bad j sample) :=
      eventMass_mono _ hp _ _ hc
    _≤∑ j,eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r) (bad j) := finite_union_bound _ hp bad
    _≤∑ _j : K,(1/3:ℝ)^r := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=>hpoint j)
    _=(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^r := by simp

end APC

APC.drawMean.source:
def drawMean (x : I → E) (m : ℕ) (f : Draws I m) : E :=
  (m:ℝ)⁻¹ • drawSum x m f

APC.drawSum_centered.source:
theorem drawSum_centered (x : I → E) (μ : E) (m : ℕ) (f : Draws I m) :
    drawSum (fun i => x i - μ) m f = drawSum x m f - (m:ℝ) • μ := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases f with ⟨i, tail⟩
    simp only [drawSum, ih tail, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_smul, one_smul]
    abel

APC.drawMean_centered.source:
theorem drawMean_centered (x : I → E) (μ : E) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (f : Draws I m) :
    drawMean x m f - μ = (m:ℝ)⁻¹ • drawSum (fun i => x i - μ) m f := by
  rw [drawSum_centered, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hm), one_smul]
  rfl

/-- Exact excess-cost formula for the mean of a sample drawn with replacement. -/

APC.drawMean_cost.doc: Exact excess-cost formula for the mean of a sample drawn with replacement.
APC.drawMean_cost.source:
theorem drawMean_cost (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hmass : mass w ≠ 0)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (f : Draws I m) :
    oneCost x w (drawMean x m f) = oneCost x w (mean x w) +
      mass w * ((m:ℝ)⁻¹)^2 * ‖drawSum (fun i => x i - mean x w) m f‖^2 := by
  rw [variance_identity x w hmass, norm_sub_rev, drawMean_centered x _ m hm,
    norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  ring

/-- Weighted form of Lemma 3.3. With mε≥3, the failure probability is at
most 1/3. No uniform-weight or positive-variance assumption is required. -/

APC.random_mean_failure_le_third.doc: Weighted form of Lemma 3.3. With mε≥3, the failure probability is at most 1/3. No uniform-weight or positive-variance assumption is required.
APC.random_mean_failure_le_third.source:
theorem random_mean_failure_le_third (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hmass : 0 < mass w)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (ε : ℝ) (hmε : 3 ≤ (m:ℝ)*ε) :
    eventMass (drawWeight (fun i => w i / mass w) m)
      (fun f => (1+ε) * oneCost x w (mean x w) < oneCost x w (drawMean x m f)) ≤ 1/3 := by
  let p : I → ℝ := fun i => w i / mass w
  have hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i := fun i => div_nonneg (hw i) hmass.le
  have h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1 := by
    simp only [p, ← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self (ne_of_gt hmass)
  have hz : ∑ i, p i • (x i - mean x w) = 0 := by
    simp only [p, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm (w _) (mass w)⁻¹, mul_smul]
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum, centered_sum x w (ne_of_gt hmass), smul_zero]
  have hv : (∑ i, p i * ‖x i - mean x w‖^2) = oneCost x w (mean x w) / mass w := by
    simp [p, oneCost, div_mul_eq_mul_div, Finset.sum_div]
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  apply le_trans (eventMass_mono (drawWeight p m) (drawWeight_nonneg p hp m) _ _ ?_)
    (sample_sum_failure_le_third p (fun i => x i - mean x w) hp h1 hz m hm)
  intro f hf
  by_contra hn
  have hb : ‖drawSum (fun i => x i - mean x w) m f‖^2 ≤
      3 * (m:ℝ) * (oneCost x w (mean x w) / mass w) := by
    simpa only [hv] using le_of_not_gt hn
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb
    (mul_nonneg hmass.le (sq_nonneg ((m:ℝ)⁻¹)))
  have he : (mass w * ((m:ℝ)⁻¹)^2) *
      (3 * (m:ℝ) * (oneCost x w (mean x w) / mass w)) =
      (3/(m:ℝ)) * oneCost x w (mean x w) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hmass, ne_of_gt hmR]
  rw [he] at hscaled
  have heps : 3/(m:ℝ) ≤ ε := (div_le_iff₀ hmR).2 (by nlinarith [hmε])
  have hlast := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right heps (oneCost_nonneg x w hw (mean x w))
  rw [drawMean_cost x w (ne_of_gt hmass) m hm f] at hf
  nlinarith only [hscaled, hlast, hf]

end APC

APC.RandomStrongInput.Outcomes.doc: Second sampling and lifting outcomes for one supplied first summary.
APC.RandomStrongInput.Outcomes.source:
abbrev Outcomes (B K : Type*) [Fintype B] [Fintype K] (a ε δ : ℝ) :=
  Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) ×
    LiftOutcome (Fin (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ)) K
      (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)) (liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K))

section OneSummary
variable {B K E : Type*} [Fintype B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

/-- Conditional law of the actual compression and randomized lifting. -/

APC.RandomStrongInput.law.doc: Conditional law of the actual compression and randomized lifting.
APC.RandomStrongInput.law.source:
def law (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (proxy : K → E) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (solve : Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) → K → E) :
    Outcomes B K a ε δ → ℝ :=
  let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
  kernelWeight (drawWeight p n) (fun sample => liftingTrialsLaw (sampledPoints b n sample)
    (sampledWeights w p n sample) (solve sample) (liftingSampleCount (ε/10))
      (liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)))

APC.RandomStrongInput.output.source:
def output (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (proxy : K → E) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (solve : Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) → K → E)
    (sample : Outcomes B K a ε δ) : K → E :=
  let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
  randomLift (sampledPoints b n sample.1) (sampledWeights w p n sample.1) (solve sample.1)
    (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)) (liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)) sample.2

APC.RandomStrongInput.law_nonneg.source:
theorem law_nonneg [Nonempty B] (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (proxy : K → E) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (solve : Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) → K → E) :
    ∀ sample,0≤law b w proxy a ε δ solve sample := by
  let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i => (sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i).le
  exact kernelWeight_nonneg _ _ (drawWeight_nonneg p hp n)
    (fun sample=>liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg _ _
      (sampledWeights_nonneg w p (fun i=>(hw i).le) hp n sample) _ _ _)

APC.RandomStrongInput.law_sum.source:
theorem law_sum [Nonempty B] (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (proxy : K → E) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (solve : Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) → K → E) :
    ∑ sample,law b w proxy a ε δ solve sample=1 := by
  exact kernelWeight_sum _ _
    (drawWeight_sum _ (sensitivityProbability_sum w _ _ hw) _)
    (fun sample=>liftingTrialsLaw_sum _ _ _ _ _)

APC.RandomStrongInput.law_failure.source:
theorem law_failure [Nonempty B]
    (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ c,0≤original c)
    (opt proxy : K → E) (a α ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hstrong : ∀ c,Preserves (original c) (cost b w c) (ε/100))
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost b w) a proxy)
    (solve : Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ sample,
      let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
      let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
      Approximate (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample)) α (solve sample)) :
    eventMass (law b w proxy a ε δ solve)
      (fun sample=>α*(1+ε)*original opt<original (output b w proxy a ε δ solve sample))≤δ+1/3 :=
  randomized_euclidean_compression_explicit b w hw original hnonneg opt proxy a α ε δ
    ha hα hε hε1 hδ hstrong hproxy solve hsolve

end OneSummary

/-- A randomized first stage may have a varying summary index type and
size. Its strong-preservation/size success event is explicit. All later
sampling and lifting probabilities and the final inverse-cubic size bound
are proved, for the returned centers of the combined experiment. -/

APC.RandomStrongInput.randomized_first_s.doc: A randomized first stage may have a varying summary index type and size. Its strong-preservation/size success event is explicit. All later sampling and lifting probabilities and the final inverse-cubic size bound are proved, for the returned centers of the combined experiment.
APC.RandomStrongInput.randomized_first_s.source:
theorem randomized_first_stage_size_and_output
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] {B : Ω → Type*}
    [∀ ω,Fintype (B ω)] [∀ ω,Nonempty (B ω)]
    {K E : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ ω,0≤ρ ω) (hρsum : ∑ ω,ρ ω=1)
    (b : (ω : Ω) → B ω → E) (w : (ω : Ω) → B ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω i,0<w ω i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ c,0≤original c) (opt : K → E)
    (proxy : Ω → K → E) (a α ε δ₁ δ₂ C : ℝ) (p q : ℕ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1)
    (hδ₂ : 0<δ₂) (hδ₂1 : δ₂≤1) (hC : 1≤C)
    (hproxy : ∀ ω,Approximate (cost (b ω) (w ω)) a (proxy ω))
    (solve : (ω : Ω) → Draws (B ω)
      (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a ε δ₂) → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ ω sample,
      let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a ε δ₂
      let d := sensitivityProbability (w ω) (fun i=>pointCost (proxy ω) (b ω i))
        (fun i=>nearest (proxy ω) (b ω i))
      Approximate (cost (sampledPoints (b ω) n sample) (sampledWeights (w ω) d n sample)) α (solve ω sample))
    (hfirst : eventMass ρ (fun ω=>¬((∀ c,Preserves (original c)
      (cost (b ω) (w ω) c) (ε/100)) ∧
      (Fintype.card (B ω):ℝ)≤C*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q))≤δ₁) :
    eventMass (dependentKernelWeight ρ (fun ω=>law (b ω) (w ω) (proxy ω) a ε δ₂ (solve ω)))
      (fun sample=>
        α*(1+ε)*original opt<original
          (output (b sample.1) (w sample.1) (proxy sample.1) a ε δ₂ (solve sample.1) sample.2) ∨
        ¬(randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B sample.1)) a ε δ₂:ℝ)<
          euclideanSizeEnvelope (Fintype.card K) a 32 C p q ε δ₂) ≤ δ₁+δ₂+1/3 := by
  classical
  let good := fun ω => (∀ c,Preserves (original c) (cost (b ω) (w ω) c) (ε/100)) ∧
    (Fintype.card (B ω):ℝ)≤C*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)^p*(1/ε)^q
  have hb := dependentKernel_event_bound ρ
    (fun ω=>law (b ω) (w ω) (proxy ω) a ε δ₂ (solve ω)) hρ hρsum
    (fun ω=>law_nonneg (b ω) (w ω) (hw ω) (proxy ω) a ε δ₂ (solve ω))
    (fun ω=>law_sum (b ω) (w ω) (hw ω) (proxy ω) a ε δ₂ (solve ω)) good
    (fun ω z=>α*(1+ε)*original opt<original (output (b ω) (w ω) (proxy ω) a ε δ₂ (solve ω) z) ∨
      ¬(randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a ε δ₂:ℝ)<
        euclideanSizeEnvelope (Fintype.card K) a 32 C p q ε δ₂)
    δ₁ (δ₂+1/3) (by positivity) hfirst (by
      intro ω hg
      have hs := randomizedCompressionSampleCount_polynomial_bound
        (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card (B ω)) a C p q ε δ₂
        Fintype.card_pos Fintype.card_pos ha hC hε hε1 hδ₂ hδ₂1 hg.2
      simpa only [hs,not_true_eq_false,or_false] using law_failure (b ω) (w ω) (hw ω)
        original hnonneg opt (proxy ω) a α ε δ₂ ha hα hε hε1 hδ₂ hg.1 (hproxy ω) (solve ω) (hsolve ω))
  simpa only [add_assoc] using hb

end APC.RandomStrongInput

APC.randomized_euclidean_compression.doc: The complete finite experiment: sensitivity-sample a supplied strong input, solve the summary, then independently sample candidate cluster means and return the best means. The second law depends on the first outcome and its computed solution. This theorem bounds failure of the actual returned center tuple, not merely existence of a good tuple. It does not assert a machine/runtime cost model.
APC.randomized_euclidean_compression.source:
theorem randomized_euclidean_compression
    {B K E : Type*} [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ c,0≤original c)
    (opt proxy : K → E) (a α ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hstrong : ∀ c,Preserves (original c) (cost b w c) (ε/100))
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost b w) a proxy)
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r]
    (hm : 0<m) (hmε : 3≤(m:ℝ)*(ε/10))
    (solve : Draws B n → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ sample,
      let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
      Approximate (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample)) α (solve sample))
    (hstructSize : (48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (n:ℝ)*((ε/100)/(23+22*a))^2)
    (hresidualSize : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+
      (m*Fintype.card K:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B))≤
      (n:ℝ)*((ε/100)/(23+22*a))^2) :
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
    let liftLaw := fun sample=>liftingTrialsLaw (sampledPoints b n sample)
      (sampledWeights w p n sample) (solve sample) m r
    eventMass (kernelWeight (drawWeight p n) liftLaw)
      (fun sample=>α*(1+ε)*original opt<original
        (randomLift (sampledPoints b n sample.1) (sampledWeights w p n sample.1)
          (solve sample.1) m r sample.2))≤δ+(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^r := by
  classical
  let F : Finset (K → E) := insert opt (witnessFamily b m)
  let Query := {c : K → E // c∈F}
  have hcard : Fintype.card Query=F.card := Fintype.card_coe F
  have hN : 0<F.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨opt,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  have hcount : F.card≤Fintype.card B^(m*Fintype.card K)+1 := card_witnessFamily_with_opt b m opt
  have hlog := log_solution_count F.card (Fintype.card B) (m*Fintype.card K) hN Fintype.card_pos hcount (δ/2) (by positivity)
  have hbudget : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*Real.log (4*(Fintype.card Query:ℝ)/δ)≤
      (n:ℝ)*((ε/100)/(23+22*a))^2 := by
    rw [hcard]
    have he₁ : 2*(F.card:ℝ)/(δ/2)=4*(F.card:ℝ)/δ := by ring
    have he₂ : (4:ℝ)/(δ/2)=8/δ := by ring
    rw [he₁,he₂] at hlog
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity)).trans hresidualSize
  have hsample := finite_family_coreset b w hw proxy (fun q : Query=>q.val) a (ε/100) δ ha
    (by positivity) (by linarith) hδ (by rw [hcard];exact hN) (fun q=>hproxy q.val)
    n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)) hstructSize hbudget
  let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
  have hp : ∀ i,0≤p i := fun i=>(sensitivityProbability_pos w _ _ hw (fun i=>sq_nonneg _) i).le
  let good := fun sample : Draws B n=>¬∃ q : Query,¬Preserves (cost b w q.val)
    (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample) q.val) (ε/100)
  have hfirst : eventMass (drawWeight p n) (fun sample=>¬good sample)≤δ := by
    apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (drawWeight_nonneg p hp n) _ _ ?_) hsample
    intro sample hs
    exact of_not_not hs
  let liftLaw := fun sample : Draws B n=>liftingTrialsLaw (sampledPoints b n sample)
    (sampledWeights w p n sample) (solve sample) m r
  let bad := fun (sample : Draws B n) (trials : LiftOutcome (Fin n) K m r)=>
    α*(1+ε)*original opt<original
      (randomLift (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample) (solve sample) m r trials)
  have hwout : ∀ sample i,0≤sampledWeights w p n sample i :=
    fun sample=>sampledWeights_nonneg w p (fun i=>(hw i).le) hp n sample
  have hsecond : ∀ sample,good sample→eventMass (liftLaw sample) (bad sample)≤
      (Fintype.card K:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^r := by
    intro sample hg
    have herr : 2*(ε/100)+(ε/100)^2≤ε/10 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hε1)]
    have hc : ∀ c∈F,Preserves (original c)
        (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample) c) (ε/10) := by
      intro c hmem
      have hpres : Preserves (cost b w c)
          (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample) c) (ε/100) :=
        of_not_not (fun hn=>hg ⟨⟨c,hmem⟩,hn⟩)
      exact preserves_mono (hnonneg c) herr
        (preserves_compose (hnonneg c) (by positivity) (by linarith) (hstrong c) hpres)
    have hlocal : ∀ c∈witnessFamily (K:=K) (sampledPoints b n sample) m,Preserves (original c)
        (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample) c) (ε/10) := by
      intro c hmem
      exact hc c (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (witnessFamily_mono (sampledPoints b n sample) b
        (drawIndex n sample) (fun _=>rfl) m c hmem))
    exact randomized_apc_failure (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample)
      (hwout sample) original opt (solve sample) α ε hα hε hε1 (hnonneg opt) (hsolve sample)
      m r hm hmε hlocal (hc opt (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
  exact kernel_event_bound (drawWeight p n) liftLaw (drawWeight_nonneg p hp n)
    (drawWeight_sum p (sensitivityProbability_sum w _ _ hw) n)
    (fun sample=>liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg _ _ (hwout sample) (solve sample) m r)
    (fun sample=>liftingTrialsLaw_sum _ _ (solve sample) m r)
    good bad δ ((Fintype.card K:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^r) (by positivity) hfirst hsecond

end APC

APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount.doc: The coreset count uses the witness family of the actual randomized lifting means, whose size is ceil(30/ε)+1.
APC.randomizedCompressionSampleCount.source:
def randomizedCompressionSampleCount (k B : ℕ) (a ε δ : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  budgetSampleCount
    ((48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*k:ℕ)*Real.log B))
    ((ε/100)/(23+22*a))

instance randomizedCompressionSampleCount_neZero (k B : ℕ) (a ε δ : ℝ) :
    NeZero (randomizedCompressionSampleCount k B a ε δ) := ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero _⟩

/-- Fully specified sampling and randomized lifting from a supplied
strong coreset. The failure bound concerns the actual returned solution.
The solver may depend on the sampled coreset. -/

APC.randomized_euclidean_compression_exp.doc: Fully specified sampling and randomized lifting from a supplied strong coreset. The failure bound concerns the actual returned solution. The solver may depend on the sampled coreset.
APC.randomized_euclidean_compression_exp.source:
theorem randomized_euclidean_compression_explicit
    {B K E : Type*} [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ c,0≤original c)
    (opt proxy : K → E) (a α ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hstrong : ∀ c,Preserves (original c) (cost b w c) (ε/100))
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost b w) a proxy)
    (solve : Draws B (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ) → K → E)
    (hsolve : ∀ sample,
      let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
      let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
      Approximate (cost (sampledPoints b n sample) (sampledWeights w p n sample)) α (solve sample)) :
    let n := randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
    let m := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
    let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
    let liftLaw := fun sample=>liftingTrialsLaw (sampledPoints b n sample)
      (sampledWeights w p n sample) (solve sample) m r
    eventMass (kernelWeight (drawWeight p n) liftLaw)
      (fun sample=>α*(1+ε)*original opt<original
        (randomLift (sampledPoints b n sample.1) (sampledWeights w p n sample.1)
          (solve sample.1) m r sample.2))≤δ+1/3 := by
  have hm := liftingSampleCount_valid (ε/10) (by positivity)
  have hz : (ε/100)/(23+22*a)≠0 := ne_of_gt (div_pos (by positivity) (by linarith))
  have hn := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(liftingSampleCount (ε/10)*Fintype.card K:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B)))
    ((ε/100)/(23+22*a)) hz
  have hb := randomized_euclidean_compression b w hw original hnonneg opt proxy a α ε δ
    ha hα hε hε1 hδ hstrong hproxy
    (randomizedCompressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ)
    (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)) (liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)) hm.1 hm.2 solve hsolve hn.2.1 hn.2.2
  exact hb.trans (add_le_add_left (liftingRepetitions_bound _) δ)

end APC

APC.randomized_apc_failure.doc: Approximation preservation for the actual joint randomized output. The original objective is used only in the guarantee, not by randomLift.
APC.randomized_apc_failure.source:
theorem randomized_apc_failure
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (opt s : K → E) (α ε : ℝ)
    (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hopt_nonneg : 0≤original opt)
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s)
    (m r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (hm : 0<m) (hmε : 3≤(m:ℝ)*(ε/10))
    (hpres : ∀ c∈witnessFamily (K:=K) x m,Preserves (original c) (cost x w c) (ε/10))
    (hopt : Preserves (original opt) (cost x w opt) (ε/10)) :
    eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r)
      (fun sample=>α*(1+ε)*original opt<original (randomLift x w s m r sample))≤
      (Fintype.card K:ℝ)*(1/3:ℝ)^r := by
  have hp := liftingTrialsLaw_nonneg x w hw s m r
  have hc : ∀ sample,α*(1+ε)*original opt<original (randomLift x w s m r sample)→
      (1+ε/10)*cost x w s<cost x w (randomLift x w s m r sample) := by
    intro sample hs
    by_contra hn
    have hb := euclidean_transfer_rescaled original (cost x w) s (randomLift x w s m r sample) opt
      α ε hα hε.le hε1 hopt_nonneg happrox (le_of_not_gt hn)
      (hpres _ (randomLift_mem_witness x w s m r sample)) hopt
    exact not_lt_of_ge hb hs
  exact (eventMass_mono _ hp _ _ hc).trans
    (randomized_lifting_failure x w hw s m r hm (ε/10) (by positivity) hmε)

APC.randomized_apc_explicit.source:
theorem randomized_apc_explicit
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (opt s : K → E) (α ε : ℝ)
    (hα : 0≤α) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hopt_nonneg : 0≤original opt)
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s)
    (hpres : ∀ c∈witnessFamily (K:=K) x (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)),
      Preserves (original c) (cost x w c) (ε/10))
    (hopt : Preserves (original opt) (cost x w opt) (ε/10)) :
    let m := liftingSampleCount (ε/10)
    let r := liftingRepetitions (Fintype.card K)
    eventMass (liftingTrialsLaw x w s m r)
      (fun sample=>α*(1+ε)*original opt<original (randomLift x w s m r sample))≤1/3 := by
  have hm := liftingSampleCount_valid (ε/10) (by positivity)
  exact (randomized_apc_failure x w hw original opt s α ε hα hε hε1 hopt_nonneg happrox
    (liftingSampleCount (ε/10)) (liftingRepetitions _) hm.1 hm.2 hpres hopt).trans
      (liftingRepetitions_bound _)

end APC

APC.residual_family_concentration.doc: Claim A.7's finite-family conclusion from the explicit residual moment and range inequalities proved in ResidualSampling. The family may be chosen after fixing a first-stage sample, but before these draws.
APC.residual_family_concentration.source:
theorem residual_family_concentration {I Q : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype Q]
    (p : I → ℝ) (loss : Q → I → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (a ε δ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hQ : 0 < Fintype.card Q)
    (hrange : ∀ q i, |loss q i| ≤ (16*a/ε)*p i)
    (hsecond : ∀ q, ∑ i, (loss q i)^2/p i ≤ 32*a+8*a^2)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hsize : (4*(64*a+8*a^2))*Real.log (2*(Fintype.card Q:ℝ)/δ) ≤ (m:ℝ)*ε^2) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun sample => ∃ q, ε < |importanceEstimate p (loss q) m sample-∑ i,loss q i|) ≤ δ := by
  apply finite_family_exponential_bound (drawWeight p m) (drawWeight_nonneg p (fun i => (hp i).le) m)
    (fun q sample => ε < |importanceEstimate p (loss q) m sample-∑ i,loss q i|)
    (4*(64*a+8*a^2)) ε δ (by positivity) hδ hQ m ?_ hsize
  intro q
  have hb := importance_sampling_concentration p (loss q) hp h1 (16*a/ε)
    (32*a+8*a^2) ε (by positivity) (by positivity) hε (hrange q) (hsecond q) m hm
  have he : 32*a+8*a^2+2*(16*a/ε)*ε = 64*a+8*a^2 := by field_simp; ring
  simpa only [he] using hb

/-- Simultaneous structural preservation of a finite family of normalized
nonnegative cluster quantities, with the k log(k/δ) budget made explicit. -/

APC.structural_family_concentration.doc: Simultaneous structural preservation of a finite family of normalized nonnegative cluster quantities, with the k log(k/δ) budget made explicit.
APC.structural_family_concentration.source:
theorem structural_family_concentration {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (p : I → ℝ) (loss : J → I → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (h1 : ∑ i,p i=1)
    (hloss : ∀ j i,0≤loss j i) (hsum : ∀ j,∑ i,loss j i=1)
    (L ε δ : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hJ : 0<Fintype.card J)
    (hbound : ∀ j i,loss j i≤L*p i)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0<m)
    (hsize : (12*L)*Real.log (2*(Fintype.card J:ℝ)/δ)≤(m:ℝ)*ε^2) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun sample => ∃ j, ε< |importanceEstimate p (loss j) m sample-1|)≤δ := by
  apply finite_family_exponential_bound (drawWeight p m) (drawWeight_nonneg p (fun i=>(hp i).le) m)
    (fun j sample=>ε< |importanceEstimate p (loss j) m sample-1|)
    (12*L) ε δ (by positivity) hδ hJ m ?_ hsize
  intro j
  exact nonnegative_importance_concentration p (loss j) hp h1 (hloss j) (hsum j)
    L ε hL hε hε1 (hbound j) m hm

end APC

APC.normalizedResidual.source:
def normalizedResidual {I : Type*} (w residual : I → ℝ) (C : ℝ) : I → ℝ :=
  fun i => w i * residual i / C

/-- Claim A.10's second-moment calculation. A zero proxy-point cost causes
no division by zero: only the strictly positive sampling probabilities are
divided by. -/

APC.residual_second_moment.doc: Claim A.10's second-moment calculation. A zero proxy-point cost causes no division by zero: only the strictly positive sampling probabilities are divided by.
APC.residual_second_moment.source:
theorem residual_second_moment {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w residual s c p : I → ℝ) (C A a : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hC : 0 < C) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hsumS : ∑ i, w i * s i = C) (hsumA : ∑ i, w i * c i = A)
    (happrox : A ≤ a*C)
    (hsens : ∀ i, w i*c i ≤ 4*A*p i)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, (residual i)^2 ≤ 8*s i*c i + 2*(c i)^2) :
    (∑ i, (normalizedResidual w residual C i)^2 / p i) ≤ 32*a + 8*a^2 := by
  have hpoint : ∀ i, (normalizedResidual w residual C i)^2 / p i ≤
      (4*A/C^2) * (w i * (8*s i + 2*c i)) := by
    intro i
    have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdiff i) (sq_nonneg (w i))
    have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsens i)
      (mul_nonneg (hw i) (by linarith [hs i, hc i] : 0 ≤ 8*s i+2*c i))
    have hn : (w i)^2 * (residual i)^2 ≤
        (4*A*p i) * (w i * (8*s i+2*c i)) := by nlinarith only [h₁, h₂]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (hp i)).2
    dsimp [normalizedResidual]
    rw [div_pow]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hC)).2
    convert hn using 1 <;> field_simp <;> ring
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i * (8*s i+2*c i)) = 8*C+2*A := by
    simp_rw [mul_add]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have h₁ : (∑ i, w i*(8*s i)) = 8*∑ i, w i*s i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    have h₂ : (∑ i, w i*(2*c i)) = 2*∑ i, w i*c i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    rw [h₁, h₂, hsumS, hsumA]
  have hr : 0 ≤ A/C := div_nonneg hA hC.le
  have hrat : A/C ≤ a := (div_le_iff₀ hC).2 happrox
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, (4*A/C^2) * (w i*(8*s i+2*c i)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hpoint i)
    _ = 32*(A/C) + 8*(A/C)^2 := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]; field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrat) (add_nonneg ha hr)]

APC.residual_range.source:
theorem residual_range {I : Type*}
    (w residual c Δ p : I → ℝ) (C A a ε : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hC : 0 < C) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (happrox : A ≤ a*C)
    (hsensC : ∀ i, w i*c i ≤ 4*A*p i)
    (hsensΔ : ∀ i, w i*Δ i ≤ 4*A*p i)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hclose : ∀ i, ε*|residual i| ≤ 2*(Δ i+c i)) :
    ∀ i, |normalizedResidual w residual C i| ≤ (16*a/ε)*p i := by
  intro i
  have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hclose i) (hw i)
  have h₂ := hsensC i
  have h₃ := hsensΔ i
  have h₄ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right happrox (hp i)
  have hraw : ε * (w i*|residual i|) ≤ 16*a*C*p i := by nlinarith only [h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄]
  have he : |normalizedResidual w residual C i| = w i*|residual i|/C := by
    simp [normalizedResidual, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hw i), abs_of_pos hC]
  rw [he]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hC).2
  have h : w i*|residual i| ≤ (16*a*C*p i)/ε :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by nlinarith only [hraw])
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

/-- Close-cluster residual concentration with no k in the exponent.
The hypotheses are the explicit geometric and sensitivity inequalities
used in Appendix A; no concentration conclusion is assumed. -/

APC.close_residual_concentration.doc: Close-cluster residual concentration with no k in the exponent. The hypotheses are the explicit geometric and sensitivity inequalities used in Appendix A; no concentration conclusion is assumed.
APC.close_residual_concentration.source:
theorem close_residual_concentration {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (w residual s c Δ p : I → ℝ) (C A a ε : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hC : 0 < C) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hsumS : ∑ i, w i*s i = C) (hsumA : ∑ i, w i*c i = A)
    (happrox : A ≤ a*C)
    (hsensC : ∀ i, w i*c i ≤ 4*A*p i)
    (hsensΔ : ∀ i, w i*Δ i ≤ 4*A*p i)
    (hdiff : ∀ i, (residual i)^2 ≤ 8*s i*c i + 2*(c i)^2)
    (hclose : ∀ i, ε*|residual i| ≤ 2*(Δ i+c i))
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m)
      (fun sample => ε < |importanceEstimate p (normalizedResidual w residual C) m sample -
        ∑ i, normalizedResidual w residual C i|) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2 / (4*(64*a+8*a^2))) := by
  have hsecond := residual_second_moment w residual s c p C A a hw hs hc hp hC hA ha.le
    hsumS hsumA happrox hsensC hdiff
  have hrange := residual_range w residual c Δ p C A a ε hw hC hε happrox
    hsensC hsensΔ (fun i => (hp i).le) hclose
  have hb := importance_sampling_concentration p (normalizedResidual w residual C) hp h1
    (16*a/ε) (32*a+8*a^2) ε (by positivity) (by positivity) hε hrange hsecond m hm
  have he : 32*a+8*a^2+2*(16*a/ε)*ε = 64*a+8*a^2 := by field_simp; ring
  simpa only [he] using hb

end APC

APC.budgetSampleCount.source: def budgetSampleCount (S R z : ℝ) : ℕ := Nat.ceil (max S R/z^2)+1

APC.meanSampleCount_valid.source:
theorem meanSampleCount_valid (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    0<meanSampleCount ε ∧ ((meanSampleCount ε:ℕ):ℝ)⁻¹≤ε/10 := by
  have ht : 0<meanSampleCount ε := Nat.zero_lt_succ _
  have htR : (0:ℝ)<meanSampleCount ε := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (10/ε)
  have hmore : (Nat.ceil (10/ε):ℝ)≤meanSampleCount ε := by
    simp only [meanSampleCount,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
    linarith
  have hb : 10/ε≤meanSampleCount ε := hc.trans hmore
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hb
  refine ⟨ht,?_⟩
  rw [inv_eq_one_div]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ htR).2
  nlinarith only [hh]

APC.budgetSampleCount_valid.source:
theorem budgetSampleCount_valid (S R z : ℝ) (hz : z≠0) :
    0<budgetSampleCount S R z ∧
      S≤(budgetSampleCount S R z:ℝ)*z^2 ∧ R≤(budgetSampleCount S R z:ℝ)*z^2 := by
  have hc := Nat.le_ceil (max S R/z^2)
  have hmore : (Nat.ceil (max S R/z^2):ℝ)≤budgetSampleCount S R z := by
    simp only [budgetSampleCount,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
    linarith
  have hb := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hz)).mp (hc.trans hmore)
  exact ⟨Nat.zero_lt_succ _,(le_max_left S R).trans hb,(le_max_right S R).trans hb⟩

APC.meanSampleCount_upper.source:
theorem meanSampleCount_upper (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) :
    (meanSampleCount ε:ℝ)≤12/ε := by
  have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (by positivity : 0≤(10:ℝ)/ε)
  have he : (meanSampleCount ε:ℝ)=(Nat.ceil (10/ε):ℝ)+1 := by simp [meanSampleCount]
  calc
    (meanSampleCount ε:ℝ)≤10/ε+2 := by linarith only [hc,he]
    _≤12/ε := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).2
      rw [add_mul,div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hε)]
      nlinarith only [hε1]

APC.budgetSampleCount_upper.source:
theorem budgetSampleCount_upper (S R z : ℝ) (hS : 0≤S) (hR : 0≤R) (hz : z≠0) :
    (budgetSampleCount S R z:ℝ)<(S+R)/z^2+2 := by
  have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg (le_trans hS (le_max_left S R)) (sq_nonneg z))
  have he : (budgetSampleCount S R z:ℝ)=(Nat.ceil (max S R/z^2):ℝ)+1 := by simp [budgetSampleCount]
  rw [he]
  have hh : max S R≤S+R := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh (sq_nonneg z)
  linarith

/-- Explicit integer sample count for the second-stage Euclidean sampler. -/

APC.compressionSampleCount.doc: Explicit integer sample count for the second-stage Euclidean sampler.
APC.compressionSampleCount.source:
def compressionSampleCount (k B : ℕ) (a ε δ : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  budgetSampleCount
    ((48*(k:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(k:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(meanSampleCount ε*k:ℕ)*Real.log B))
    ((ε/100)/(23+22*a))

/-- Euclidean compression with both integer sample counts prescribed.
There are no sample-size or second-stage cost-preservation premises. -/

APC.euclidean_compression_explicit.doc: Euclidean compression with both integer sample counts prescribed. There are no sample-size or second-stage cost-preservation premises.
APC.euclidean_compression_explicit.source:
theorem euclidean_compression_explicit
    {B K E : Type*} [Fintype B] [Nonempty B] [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (b : B → E) (w : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i)
    (original : (K → E) → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ s,0≤original s)
    (opt proxy : K → E) (a ε δ : ℝ)
    (ha : 0<a) (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε≤1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hstrong : ∀ s,Preserves (original s) (cost b w s) (ε/100))
    (hproxy : Approximate (cost b w) a proxy) :
    let t := meanSampleCount ε
    let m := compressionSampleCount (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card B) a ε δ
    let p := sensitivityProbability w (fun i=>pointCost proxy (b i)) (fun i=>nearest proxy (b i))
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun sample=>∃ (α : ℝ) (s : K → E),0≤α ∧
      Approximate (cost (sampledPoints b m sample) (sampledWeights w p m sample)) α s ∧
      ¬∃ out : K → E,out∈witnessFamily b t ∧ original out≤α*(1+ε)*original opt)≤δ := by
  have ht := meanSampleCount_valid ε hε
  have hz : (ε/100)/(23+22*a)≠0 := ne_of_gt (div_pos (by positivity) (by linarith))
  have hm := budgetSampleCount_valid
    ((48*(Fintype.card K:ℝ))*Real.log (8*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)/δ))
    ((4*(64*a+8*a^2))*(Real.log (8/δ)+(meanSampleCount ε*Fintype.card K:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B)))
    ((ε/100)/(23+22*a)) hz
  exact euclidean_compression b w hw original hnonneg opt proxy a ε δ ha hε hε1 hδ hstrong hproxy
    (meanSampleCount ε) ht.1 ht.2 (compressionSampleCount _ _ a ε δ) hm.1 hm.2.1 hm.2.2

end APC

APC.drawIndex.source:
def drawIndex {I : Type*} : (m : ℕ) → Draws I m → Fin m → I
  | 0, _ => Fin.elim0
  | m+1, (i, tail) => Fin.cons i (drawIndex m tail)

APC.drawSum_eq_sum.source:
theorem drawSum_eq_sum {I : Type*} (f : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) :
    drawSum f m a = ∑ j, f (drawIndex m a j) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [drawSum]
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases a with ⟨i, tail⟩
    simp [drawSum, drawIndex, Fin.sum_univ_succ, ih]

APC.sampledPoints.source:
def sampledPoints {I X : Type*} (x : I → X) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) : Fin m → X :=
  fun j => x (drawIndex m a j)

APC.sampledWeights.source:
def sampledWeights {I : Type*} (w p : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) : Fin m → ℝ :=
  fun j => w (drawIndex m a j) / ((m:ℝ)*p (drawIndex m a j))

APC.sampledWeights_nonneg.source:
theorem sampledWeights_nonneg {I : Type*} (w p : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) :
    ∀ j, 0 ≤ sampledWeights w p m a j := by
  intro j
  exact div_nonneg (hw _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hp _))

/-- The finite random experiment is exactly inverse-probability weighted
sampling, with repeated draws represented as separate weighted entries. -/

APC.sampled_cost_eq.doc: The finite random experiment is exactly inverse-probability weighted sampling, with repeated draws represented as separate weighted entries.
APC.sampled_cost_eq.source:
theorem sampled_cost_eq {I K X : Type*} [Fintype K] [Nonempty K] [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : I → X) (w p : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) (s : K → X) :
    cost (sampledPoints x m a) (sampledWeights w p m a) s =
      importanceEstimate p (fun i => w i * pointCost s (x i)) m a := by
  unfold cost importanceEstimate
  rw [drawSum_eq_sum, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  dsimp [sampledPoints, sampledWeights]
  ring

APC.importanceEstimate_add.source:
theorem importanceEstimate_add {I : Type*} (p f g : I → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) :
    importanceEstimate p (fun i => f i+g i) m a =
      importanceEstimate p f m a + importanceEstimate p g m a := by
  unfold importanceEstimate
  simp only [drawSum_eq_sum, add_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

APC.importanceEstimate_smul.source:
theorem importanceEstimate_smul {I : Type*} (p f : I → ℝ) (z : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Draws I m) :
    importanceEstimate p (fun i => z*f i) m a = z*importanceEstimate p f m a := by
  unfold importanceEstimate
  simp only [drawSum_eq_sum]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

end APC

APC.exponential_union_budget.source:
theorem exponential_union_budget (N m : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (D ε δ : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : D * Real.log (2*(N:ℝ)/δ) ≤ (m:ℝ)*ε^2) :
    (N:ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2/D)) ≤ δ := by
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hx : 0 < 2*(N:ℝ)/δ := by positivity
  have hlog : Real.log (2*(N:ℝ)/δ) ≤ (m:ℝ)*ε^2/D :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hD).2 (by nlinarith only [hsize])
  have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hlog)
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(N:ℝ))
  simp only [Real.exp_neg] at hb
  rw [Real.exp_log hx] at hb
  have he : (2*(N:ℝ)) * (2*(N:ℝ)/δ)⁻¹ = δ := by field_simp
  rw [he] at hb
  have hearg : -(m:ℝ)*ε^2/D = -((m:ℝ)*ε^2/D) := by ring
  rw [hearg, Real.exp_neg]
  convert hb using 1 <;> ring

/-- A finite-family tail bound, with the logarithmic sample budget
derived rather than assumed as a probability statement. -/

APC.finite_family_exponential_bound.doc: A finite-family tail bound, with the logarithmic sample budget derived rather than assumed as a probability statement.
APC.finite_family_exponential_bound.source:
theorem finite_family_exponential_bound {Ω Q : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Q]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (bad : Q → Ω → Prop)
    (D ε δ : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hQ : 0 < Fintype.card Q) (m : ℕ)
    (hpoint : ∀ q, eventMass p (bad q) ≤ 2*Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2/D))
    (hsize : D*Real.log (2*(Fintype.card Q:ℝ)/δ) ≤ (m:ℝ)*ε^2) :
    eventMass p (fun ω => ∃ q, bad q ω) ≤ δ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ q, eventMass p (bad q) := finite_union_bound p hp bad
    _ ≤ ∑ _q : Q, 2*Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2/D) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q _ => hpoint q)
    _ = (Fintype.card Q:ℝ) * (2*Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2/D)) := by simp
    _ ≤ δ := exponential_union_budget _ m hQ D ε δ hD hδ hsize

/-- Structural cluster quantities are nonnegative normalized losses.
Their second moment is controlled by their range, saving a factor k
compared with applying a range-only inequality. -/

APC.nonnegative_importance_concentration.doc: Structural cluster quantities are nonnegative normalized losses. Their second moment is controlled by their range, saving a factor k compared with applying a range-only inequality.
APC.nonnegative_importance_concentration.source:
theorem nonnegative_importance_concentration {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p loss : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hloss : ∀ i, 0 ≤ loss i) (hsum : ∑ i, loss i = 1)
    (L ε : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hbound : ∀ i, loss i ≤ L*p i) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    eventMass (drawWeight p m) (fun a => ε < |importanceEstimate p loss m a - 1|) ≤
      2*Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)*ε^2/(12*L)) := by
  have hsecond : (∑ i, (loss i)^2 / p i) ≤ L := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, L*loss i := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (hp i)).2
        nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound i) (hloss i)]
      _ = L := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum, mul_one]
  have hb := importance_sampling_concentration p loss hp h1 L L ε hL.le hL hε
    (fun i => by simpa [abs_of_nonneg (hloss i)] using hbound i) hsecond m hm
  rw [hsum] at hb
  have hden : 0 < 4*(L+2*L*ε) := by positivity
  have hd : 4*(L+2*L*ε) ≤ 12*L := by nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε1 hL.le]
  have hrate : -(m:ℝ)*ε^2/(4*(L+2*L*ε)) ≤ -(m:ℝ)*ε^2/(12*L) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden (by positivity : 0 < 12*L)).2
    have hn : 0 ≤ (m:ℝ)*ε^2 := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (sq_nonneg ε)
    nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hn]
  exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hrate) (by norm_num))

end APC

APC.activeMass.source:
def activeMass (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j,if groupMass w a j=0 then 0 else 1

APC.activeMass_pos.source:
theorem activeMass_pos (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) : 0<activeMass w a := by
  classical
  let i := Classical.arbitrary I
  have hj : groupMass w a (a i)≠0 := ne_of_gt ((hw i).trans_le (own_le_groupMass w a (fun i=>(hw i).le) i))
  have hh : (if groupMass w a (a i)=0 then (0:ℝ) else 1)≤activeMass w a :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun j=>if groupMass w a j=0 then (0:ℝ) else 1)
      (fun j _=>by dsimp; split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ (a i))
  simpa [hj] using (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (by simpa [hj] using hh))

APC.activeMass_le_card.source:
theorem activeMass_le_card (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) : activeMass w a≤Fintype.card K := by
  classical
  calc
    _≤∑ _j : K,(1:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=>by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
    _=_ := by simp

APC.clusterLaw.source:
def clusterLaw (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I) : ℝ :=
  (w i/groupMass w a (a i))/activeMass w a

APC.localCostLaw.source:
def localCostLaw (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact (if groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (a i)=0 then w i/groupMass w a (a i)
    else w i*c i/groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (a i))/activeMass w a

APC.globalCostLaw.source:
def globalCostLaw (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if (∑ l,w l*c l)=0 then clusterLaw w a i else w i*c i/(∑ l,w l*c l)

APC.clusterDelta.source:
def clusterDelta (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I) : ℝ :=
  groupMass (fun l=>w l*c l) a (a i)/groupMass w a (a i)

APC.deltaLaw.source:
def deltaLaw (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if (∑ l,w l*c l)=0 then clusterLaw w a i else w i*clusterDelta w c a i/(∑ l,w l*c l)

/-- Four-component sensitivity sampler. Empty proxy clusters are ignored
by activeMass. A zero-cost component falls back to clusterLaw. -/

APC.sensitivityProbability.doc: Four-component sensitivity sampler. Empty proxy clusters are ignored by activeMass. A zero-cost component falls back to clusterLaw.
APC.sensitivityProbability.source:
def sensitivityProbability (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I) : ℝ :=
  (clusterLaw w a i+localCostLaw w c a i+globalCostLaw w c a i+deltaLaw w c a i)/4

APC.clusterLaw_sum.source:
theorem clusterLaw_sum (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) :
    ∑ i,clusterLaw w a i=1 := by
  classical
  simp only [clusterLaw,← Finset.sum_div]
  rw [group_div_sum]
  have he : (∑ j,groupMass w a j/groupMass w a j)=activeMass w a := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hz : groupMass w a j=0 <;> simp [hz]
  rw [he,div_self (ne_of_gt (activeMass_pos w a hw))]

APC.localCostLaw_sum.source:
theorem localCostLaw_sum (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) :
    ∑ i,localCostLaw w c a i=1 := by
  classical
  have he : ∀ j, (∑ i,if a i=j then
      (if groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j=0 then w i/groupMass w a j
        else w i*c i/groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j) else 0)=
      groupMass w a j/groupMass w a j := by
    intro j
    by_cases hz : groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j=0
    · simp only [if_pos hz]
      simp [groupMass,fiberWeight,Finset.sum_div,ite_div]
    · have hW : groupMass w a j≠0 := by
        intro hW
        exact hz (groupMass_mul_zero w c a (fun i=>(hw i).le) j hW)
      have hc : (∑ i,if a i=j then w i*c i/groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j else 0)=
          groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j/groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j := by
        simp [groupMass,fiberWeight,Finset.sum_div,ite_div]
      simp only [if_neg hz]
      rw [hc,div_self hz,div_self hW]
  simp only [localCostLaw,← Finset.sum_div]
  have hg := group_sum a (fun j i=>if groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j=0
    then w i/groupMass w a j else w i*c i/groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j)
  rw [← hg]
  simp_rw [he]
  have hh : (∑ j,groupMass w a j/groupMass w a j)=activeMass w a := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hz : groupMass w a j=0 <;> simp [hz]
  rw [hh,div_self (ne_of_gt (activeMass_pos w a hw))]

APC.clusterDelta_total.source:
theorem clusterDelta_total (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) :
    (∑ i,w i*clusterDelta w c a i)=∑ i,w i*c i := by
  unfold clusterDelta
  rw [group_mul_sum w a (fun j=>groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j/groupMass w a j)]
  calc
    _=∑ j,groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      by_cases hz : groupMass w a j=0
      · rw [hz,zero_mul,groupMass_mul_zero w c a hw j hz]
      · field_simp
    _=_ := groupMass_total (fun i=>w i*c i) a

APC.globalCostLaw_sum.source:
theorem globalCostLaw_sum (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) :
    ∑ i,globalCostLaw w c a i=1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hz : (∑ i,w i*c i)=0
  · simpa [globalCostLaw,hz] using clusterLaw_sum w a hw
  · simp [globalCostLaw,hz,← Finset.sum_div]

APC.deltaLaw_sum.source:
theorem deltaLaw_sum (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) :
    ∑ i,deltaLaw w c a i=1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hz : (∑ i,w i*c i)=0
  · simpa [deltaLaw,hz] using clusterLaw_sum w a hw
  · simp only [deltaLaw,if_neg hz,← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [clusterDelta_total w c a (fun i=>(hw i).le),div_self hz]

APC.sensitivityProbability_sum.source:
theorem sensitivityProbability_sum (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) :
    ∑ i,sensitivityProbability w c a i=1 := by
  simp only [sensitivityProbability,← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [clusterLaw_sum w a hw,localCostLaw_sum w c a hw,globalCostLaw_sum w c a hw,deltaLaw_sum w c a hw]
  norm_num

APC.sampling_components_nonneg.source:
theorem sampling_components_nonneg (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) :
    0<clusterLaw w a i ∧ 0≤localCostLaw w c a i ∧
      0≤globalCostLaw w c a i ∧ 0≤deltaLaw w c a i := by
  have hW : 0<groupMass w a (a i) := (hw i).trans_le (own_le_groupMass w a (fun i=>(hw i).le) i)
  have hR := activeMass_pos w a hw
  have hA : 0≤∑ i,w i*c i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i))
  have hlocal : 0≤groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (a i) :=
    groupMass_nonneg _ a (fun i=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i)) _
  have hcl : 0<clusterLaw w a i := div_pos (div_pos (hw i) hW) hR
  refine ⟨hcl,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · unfold localCostLaw
    split_ifs <;> apply div_nonneg ?_ hR.le
    · exact div_nonneg (hw i).le hW.le
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i)) hlocal
  · unfold globalCostLaw
    split_ifs
    · exact hcl.le
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i)) hA
  · unfold deltaLaw
    split_ifs
    · exact hcl.le
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw i).le (div_nonneg hlocal hW.le)) hA

APC.sensitivityProbability_pos.source:
theorem sensitivityProbability_pos (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) : 0<sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩ := sampling_components_nonneg w c a hw hc i
  unfold sensitivityProbability
  linarith

APC.sampling_component_bounds.source:
theorem sampling_component_bounds (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) :
    clusterLaw w a i≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i ∧
    localCostLaw w c a i≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i ∧
    globalCostLaw w c a i≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i ∧
    deltaLaw w c a i≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩ := sampling_components_nonneg w c a hw hc i
  unfold sensitivityProbability
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor <;> linarith

APC.divide_component_bound.source:
theorem divide_component_bound (u D R p : ℝ) (hD : 0<D) (hR : 0<R)
    (h : u/D/R≤4*p) : u≤4*R*D*p := by
  have h₁ := (div_le_iff₀ hR).mp h
  have h₂ := (div_le_iff₀ hD).mp h₁
  nlinarith only [h₂]

APC.sensitivity_weight_lower.source:
theorem sensitivity_weight_lower (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) :
    w i≤4*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*groupMass w a (a i)*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
  have hW : 0<groupMass w a (a i) := (hw i).trans_le (own_le_groupMass w a (fun i=>(hw i).le) i)
  have hR := activeMass_pos w a hw
  have hcomp := (sampling_component_bounds w c a hw hc i).1
  have hb := divide_component_bound (w i) (groupMass w a (a i)) (activeMass w a)
    (sensitivityProbability w c a i) hW hR hcomp
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (activeMass_le_card w a)
    (mul_nonneg hW.le (sensitivityProbability_pos w c a hw hc i).le)
  nlinarith only [hb,hh]

APC.sensitivity_local_cost_lower.source:
theorem sensitivity_local_cost_lower (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) :
    w i*c i≤4*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (a i)*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
  let A := groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (a i)
  have hA : 0≤A := groupMass_nonneg _ a (fun i=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i)) _
  by_cases hz : A=0
  · have hle := own_le_groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (fun i=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i)) i
    change w i*c i≤4*(Fintype.card K:ℝ)*A*sensitivityProbability w c a i
    change w i*c i≤A at hle
    rw [hz] at hle ⊢
    nlinarith only [hle]
  · have hcomp := (sampling_component_bounds w c a hw hc i).2.1
    have hprob : (w i*c i/A)/activeMass w a≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
      change (if A=0 then w i/groupMass w a (a i) else w i*c i/A)/activeMass w a≤_ at hcomp
      rw [if_neg hz] at hcomp
      exact hcomp
    have hb := divide_component_bound (w i*c i) A (activeMass w a)
      (sensitivityProbability w c a i) (lt_of_le_of_ne hA (Ne.symm hz)) (activeMass_pos w a hw) hprob
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (activeMass_le_card w a)
      (mul_nonneg hA (sensitivityProbability_pos w c a hw hc i).le)
    nlinarith only [hb,hh]

APC.sensitivity_global_cost_lower.source:
theorem sensitivity_global_cost_lower (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) :
    w i*c i≤4*(∑ j,w j*c j)*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
  let A := ∑ j,w j*c j
  have hA : 0≤A := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i))
  by_cases hz : A=0
  · have hle : w i*c i≤A := Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j _=>mul_nonneg (hw j).le (hc j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    change w i*c i≤4*A*sensitivityProbability w c a i
    rw [hz] at hle ⊢
    nlinarith only [hle]
  · have hcomp := (sampling_component_bounds w c a hw hc i).2.2.1
    have hh : w i*c i/A≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
      change (if A=0 then clusterLaw w a i else w i*c i/A)≤_ at hcomp
      rw [if_neg hz] at hcomp
      exact hcomp
    have hb := (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_le_of_ne hA (Ne.symm hz))).mp hh
    nlinarith only [hb]

APC.sensitivity_delta_lower.source:
theorem sensitivity_delta_lower (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0<w i) (hc : ∀ i,0≤c i) (i : I) :
    w i*clusterDelta w c a i≤4*(∑ j,w j*c j)*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
  let A := ∑ j,w j*c j
  have hA : 0≤A := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i))
  have hΔ : ∀ j,0≤w j*clusterDelta w c a j := by
    intro j
    exact mul_nonneg (hw j).le (div_nonneg
      (groupMass_nonneg _ a (fun i=>mul_nonneg (hw i).le (hc i)) _)
      (groupMass_nonneg w a (fun i=>(hw i).le) _))
  by_cases hz : A=0
  · have hle : w i*clusterDelta w c a i≤A := by
      change w i*clusterDelta w c a i≤∑ j,w j*c j
      rw [← clusterDelta_total w c a (fun i=>(hw i).le)]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _=>hΔ j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    change w i*clusterDelta w c a i≤4*A*sensitivityProbability w c a i
    rw [hz] at hle ⊢
    nlinarith only [hle]
  · have hcomp := (sampling_component_bounds w c a hw hc i).2.2.2
    have hh : w i*clusterDelta w c a i/A≤4*sensitivityProbability w c a i := by
