      change (if A=0 then clusterLaw w a i else w i*clusterDelta w c a i/A)≤_ at hcomp
      rw [if_neg hz] at hcomp
      exact hcomp
    have hb := (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_le_of_ne hA (Ne.symm hz))).mp hh
    nlinarith only [hb]

APC.activeMass_eq_card.source:
theorem activeMass_eq_card (w : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hW : ∀ j,groupMass w a j≠0) : activeMass w a=Fintype.card K := by
  simp [activeMass,hW]

/-- Agreement with the paper's four-term formula when no denominator is
zero. The other branches are its explicit zero-cost/empty-cluster extension. -/

APC.sensitivityProbability_formula.doc: Agreement with the paper's four-term formula when no denominator is zero. The other branches are its explicit zero-cost/empty-cluster extension.
APC.sensitivityProbability_formula.source:
theorem sensitivityProbability_formula (w c : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (i : I)
    (hW : ∀ j,groupMass w a j≠0)
    (hC : ∀ j,groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a j≠0)
    (hA : (∑ i,w i*c i)≠0) :
    sensitivityProbability w c a i=(1/4)*(
      w i/((Fintype.card K:ℝ)*groupMass w a (a i))+
      w i*c i/((Fintype.card K:ℝ)*groupMass (fun i=>w i*c i) a (a i))+
      w i*c i/(∑ i,w i*c i)+w i*clusterDelta w c a i/(∑ i,w i*c i)) := by
  simp only [sensitivityProbability,clusterLaw,localCostLaw,globalCostLaw,deltaLaw,
    if_neg (hC (a i)),if_neg hA,activeMass_eq_card w a hW]
  ring

end APC

APC.kernel_event_bound_sharp.doc: Multiplicative success composition for a conditional finite law. It requires no independence between the first sample and the later law.
APC.kernel_event_bound_sharp.source:
theorem kernel_event_bound_sharp {Ω Λ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Λ]
    (p : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → Λ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ ω,0≤p ω) (hpsum : ∑ ω,p ω=1)
    (hq : ∀ ω z,0≤q ω z) (hqsum : ∀ ω,∑ z,q ω z=1)
    (good : Ω → Prop) (bad : Ω → Λ → Prop) (δ η : ℝ)
    (hη : 0≤η) (hη1 : η≤1) (hfirst : eventMass p (fun ω=>¬good ω)≤δ)
    (hsecond : ∀ ω,good ω→eventMass (q ω) (bad ω)≤η) :
    eventMass (kernelWeight p q) (fun sample=>bad sample.1 sample.2)≤η+(1-η)*δ := by
  have he : eventMass (kernelWeight p q) (fun sample=>bad sample.1 sample.2)=
      ∑ ω,p ω*eventMass (q ω) (bad ω) := by
    unfold eventMass kernelWeight
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ω _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [he]
  have hle : ∀ ω,eventMass (q ω) (bad ω)≤(if good ω then η else 1) := by
    intro ω
    by_cases hg : good ω
    · simpa [hg] using hsecond ω hg
    · have hh := eventMass_mono (q ω) (hq ω) (bad ω) (fun _=>True) (fun _ _=>True.intro)
      simpa [eventMass,hqsum ω,hg] using hh
  calc
    _≤∑ ω,p ω*(if good ω then η else 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _=>mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle ω) (hp ω))
    _=η*(∑ ω,p ω)+(1-η)*eventMass p (fun ω=>¬good ω) := by
      unfold eventMass
      rw [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ω _
      by_cases hg : good ω <;> simp [hg] <;> ring
    _≤_ := by
      rw [hpsum,mul_one]
      exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfirst (by linarith)) η

end APC

APC.exists_le_weighted_average.source:
theorem exists_le_weighted_average {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (p f : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1) :
    ∃ i, 0 < p i ∧ f i ≤ ∑ j, p j * f j := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push_neg at hn
  have hpos : (∑ i : I, (0:ℝ)) < ∑ i, p i := by simp [h1]
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_lt_of_sum_lt hpos
  have hs := Finset.sum_lt_sum
    (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun j => p j * (∑ l, p l * f l))
    (g := fun j => p j * f j)
    (fun j _ => by
      by_cases hz : p j = 0
      · simp [hz]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt (hn j (lt_of_le_of_ne (hp j) (Ne.symm hz)))) (hp j))
    ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hn i hi) hi⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h1, one_mul] at hs
  exact (lt_irrefl _ hs)

variable {I E : Type*} [Fintype I]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

/-- Exact expectation identity for adding one independent centered draw. -/

APC.centered_step_average.doc: Exact expectation identity for adding one independent centered draw.
APC.centered_step_average.source:
theorem centered_step_average (p : I → ℝ) (v : I → E)
    (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1) (hz : ∑ i, p i • v i = 0) (z : E) :
    (∑ i, p i * ‖z + v i‖^2) = ‖z‖^2 + ∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2 := by
  have hc : ∑ i, p i * inner ℝ z (v i) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [← real_inner_smul_right]
    rw [← inner_sum, hz, inner_zero_right]
  simp_rw [norm_add_sq_real, mul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h1, one_mul]
  have ht : (∑ i, p i * (2 * inner ℝ z (v i))) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = 2 * ∑ i, p i * inner ℝ z (v i) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; ext i; ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hc, mul_zero]
  rw [ht, add_zero]

/-- Conditional expectation gives a supported m-tuple whose mean-square
error is at most variance/m. Repetitions are allowed. -/

APC.exists_small_sum.doc: Conditional expectation gives a supported m-tuple whose mean-square error is at most variance/m. Repetitions are allowed.
APC.exists_small_sum.source:
theorem exists_small_sum (p : I → ℝ) (v : I → E)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hz : ∑ i, p i • v i = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : Fin m → I, (∀ j, 0 < p (f j)) ∧
      ‖∑ j, v (f j)‖^2 ≤ (m:ℝ) * ∑ i, p i * ‖v i‖^2 := by
  classical
  induction m with
  | zero => exact ⟨Fin.elim0, by simp, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hb⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hc⟩ := exists_le_weighted_average p
      (fun i => ‖(∑ j, v (f j)) + v i‖^2) hp h1
    rw [centered_step_average p v h1 hz] at hc
    refine ⟨Fin.snoc f i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · simpa using hi
      · simpa using hf j
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
      push_cast
      nlinarith

/-- Weighted subset-mean approximation, proved without a probability or
mean-estimation oracle. The tuple has exactly m entries, with replacement. -/

APC.exists_small_mean.doc: Weighted subset-mean approximation, proved without a probability or mean-estimation oracle. The tuple has exactly m entries, with replacement.
APC.exists_small_mean.source:
theorem exists_small_mean (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hm : 0 < mass w)
    (m : ℕ) (hmpos : 0 < m) :
    ∃ f : Fin m → I, (∀ j, 0 < w (f j)) ∧
      oneCost x w ((m:ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j, x (f j)) ≤
        (1 + (m:ℝ)⁻¹) * oneCost x w (mean x w) := by
  classical
  let p : I → ℝ := fun i => w i / mass w
  have hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i := fun i => div_nonneg (hw i) hm.le
  have h1 : ∑ i, p i = 1 := by
    simp only [p, ← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self (ne_of_gt hm)
  have hz : ∑ i, p i • (x i - mean x w) = 0 := by
    simp only [p, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm (w _) (mass w)⁻¹, mul_smul]
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum, centered_sum x w (ne_of_gt hm), smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hb⟩ := exists_small_sum p (fun i => x i - mean x w) hp h1 hz m
  refine ⟨f, fun j => ((div_pos_iff.mp (hf j)).resolve_right (by rintro ⟨_, h⟩; linarith)).1, ?_⟩
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
  have hrepr : (m:ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ j, (x (f j) - mean x w)) =
      (m:ℝ)⁻¹ • (∑ j, x (f j)) - mean x w := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hmR), one_smul]
  have hv : (∑ i, p i * ‖x i - mean x w‖^2) = oneCost x w (mean x w) / mass w := by
    simp [p, oneCost, div_mul_eq_mul_div, Finset.sum_div]
  rw [hv] at hb
  have hnorm : ‖(m:ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j, x (f j) - mean x w‖^2 ≤
      oneCost x w (mean x w) / (mass w * m) := by
    rw [← hrepr, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg ((m:ℝ)⁻¹))
    convert h using 1 <;> field_simp [ne_of_gt hm, ne_of_gt hmR] <;> ring
  rw [variance_identity x w (ne_of_gt hm)]
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hnorm
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hm.le
  have he : mass w * (oneCost x w (mean x w) / (mass w * m)) =
      (m:ℝ)⁻¹ * oneCost x w (mean x w) := by field_simp
  rw [he] at h
  nlinarith

end APC

APC.normalizedGroupLoss.source:
def normalizedGroupLoss (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (j : K) (i : I) : ℝ :=
  if groupMass w a j=0 then p i else fiberWeight w a j i/groupMass w a j

APC.normalizedGroupLoss_sum.source:
theorem normalizedGroupLoss_sum (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (h1 : ∑ i,p i=1) (j : K) :
    ∑ i,normalizedGroupLoss w p a j i=1 := by
  by_cases hz : groupMass w a j=0
  · simp [normalizedGroupLoss,hz,h1]
  · simp only [normalizedGroupLoss,if_neg hz,← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hz

APC.normalizedGroupLoss_nonneg.source:
theorem normalizedGroupLoss_nonneg (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (j : K) (i : I) :
    0≤normalizedGroupLoss w p a j i := by
  unfold normalizedGroupLoss
  split_ifs
  · exact hp i
  · exact div_nonneg (fiberWeight_nonneg w a hw j i) (groupMass_nonneg w a hw j)

APC.normalizedGroupLoss_bound.source:
theorem normalizedGroupLoss_bound (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (L : ℝ) (hL : 1≤L)
    (hbound : ∀ i,w i≤L*groupMass w a (a i)*p i) (j : K) (i : I) :
    normalizedGroupLoss w p a j i≤L*p i := by
  unfold normalizedGroupLoss
  split_ifs with hz
  · nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (hp i)]
  · have hW : 0<groupMass w a j := lt_of_le_of_ne (groupMass_nonneg w a hw j) (Ne.symm hz)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hW).2
    unfold fiberWeight
    split_ifs with ha
    · have hh := hbound i
      rw [ha] at hh
      nlinarith only [hh]
    · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hp i)) hW.le

APC.zero_group_estimate.source:
theorem zero_group_estimate (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i)
    (j : K) (hz : groupMass w a j=0) (m : ℕ) (sample : Draws I m) :
    importanceEstimate p (fiberWeight w a j) m sample=0 := by
  have hzero := groupMass_zero_terms w a hw j hz
  simp [importanceEstimate,drawSum_eq_sum,hzero]

/-- Structural preservation for all clusters, including empty and
zero-cost clusters, from a normalized importance-sampling bound. -/

APC.group_mass_concentration.doc: Structural preservation for all clusters, including empty and zero-cost clusters, from a normalized importance-sampling bound.
APC.group_mass_concentration.source:
theorem group_mass_concentration (w p : I → ℝ) (a : I → K) (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hp : ∀ i,0

∃ j,ε*groupMass w a j< |importanceEstimate p (fiberWeight w a j) m sample-groupMass w a j|)≤δ := by have hb := structural_family_concentration p (normalizedGroupLoss w p a) hp h1 (normalizedGroupLoss_nonneg w p a hw (fun i=>(hp i).le)) (normalizedGroupLoss_sum w p a h1) L ε δ (by linarith) hε hε1 hδ hK (normalizedGroupLoss_bound w p a hw (fun i=>(hp i).le) L hL hbound) m hm hsize apply le_trans (eventMass_mono _ (drawWeight_nonneg p (fun i=>(hp i).le) m) _ _ ?_) hb intro sample hs obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hs refine ⟨j,?_⟩ by_cases hz : groupMass w a j=0 · rw [zero_group_estimate w p a hw j hz m sample,hz] at hj norm_num at hj · have hW : 0fiberWeight w a j i/groupMass w a j) := by funext i exact if_neg hz rw [hf,importanceEstimate_div] field_simp [hz] rw [he,abs_div,abs_of_pos hW] exact (lt_div_iff₀ hW).2 hj end APC

APC.MetricIteration.centerSubsets.source:
def centerSubsets (I : Type*) [Fintype I] (k : ℕ) : Finset (Finset I) :=
  (Finset.univ : Finset I).powersetCard k

APC.MetricIteration.centerSubsets_nonemp.source:
theorem centerSubsets_nonempty (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) :
    (centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K)).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq
    (show Fintype.card K≤(Finset.univ : Finset I).card by simpa using hkm)
  exact ⟨S,Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨hS,hcard⟩⟩

APC.MetricIteration.subsetEquiv.source:
def subsetEquiv (S : Finset I) (hS : S.card=Fintype.card K) : K ≃ S :=
  Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_coe S,hS])

/-- A total tuple representation, with arbitrary values off the search
family. Every evaluated candidate has exactly the required cardinality. -/

APC.MetricIteration.subsetTuple.doc: A total tuple representation, with arbitrary values off the search family. Every evaluated candidate has exactly the required cardinality.

APC.MetricIteration.subsetTuple_mem.source:
theorem subsetTuple_mem (S : Finset I) (hS : S.card=Fintype.card K) (j : K) :
    subsetTuple (K:=K) S j∈S := by
  simp only [subsetTuple,dif_pos hS]
  exact (subsetEquiv S hS j).property

APC.MetricIteration.subsetTuple_hits.source:
theorem subsetTuple_hits (S : Finset I) (hS : S.card=Fintype.card K) (i : I) (hi : i∈S) :
    ∃ j : K,subsetTuple (K:=K) S j=i := by
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (subsetEquiv (K:=K) S hS).surjective ⟨i,hi⟩
  refine ⟨j,?_⟩
  simp only [subsetTuple,dif_pos hS]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hj

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch.source:
def subsetSearch (c : Cloud I X) (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) : Finset I :=
  Classical.choose (Finset.exists_min_image (centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K))
    (fun S=>cost c.points c.weights (fun j : K=>c.points (subsetTuple S j)))
    (centerSubsets_nonempty hkm))

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearchCenters.source:
def subsetSearchCenters (c : Cloud I X) (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) : K → X :=
  fun j=>c.points (subsetTuple (subsetSearch (K:=K) c hkm) j)

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_spec.source:
theorem subsetSearch_spec (c : Cloud I X) (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) :
    subsetSearch (K:=K) c hkm∈centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K) ∧
      ∀ S∈centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K),
        cost c.points c.weights (subsetSearchCenters c hkm)≤
          cost c.points c.weights (fun j : K=>c.points (subsetTuple S j)) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image (centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K))
    (fun S=>cost c.points c.weights (fun j : K=>c.points (subsetTuple S j)))
    (centerSubsets_nonempty hkm))

/-- Adding available centers cannot increase nearest-center cost. -/

APC.MetricIteration.cost_le_of_centers_c.doc: Adding available centers cannot increase nearest-center cost.
APC.MetricIteration.cost_le_of_centers_c.source:
theorem cost_le_of_centers_cover (c : Cloud I X) (hw : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i)
    (s t : K → X) (hcover : ∀ j,∃ l,t l=s j) :
    cost c.points c.weights t≤cost c.points c.weights s := by
  unfold cost
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := hcover (nearest s (c.points i))
  have hb := pointCost_le t (c.points i) l
  rw [hl] at hb
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (hw i)

/-- Every possibly repeated tuple can be covered by a size-k subset.
Thus subset enumeration loses no solution quality compared with tuples. -/

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_le_tupl.doc: Every possibly repeated tuple can be covered by a size-k subset. Thus subset enumeration loses no solution quality compared with tuples.
APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_le_tupl.source:
theorem subsetSearch_le_tuple (c : Cloud I X) (hw : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i)
    (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) (f : K → I) :
    cost c.points c.weights (subsetSearchCenters c hkm)≤
      cost c.points c.weights (fun j=>c.points (f j)) := by
  let A := Finset.univ.image f
  have hA : A.card≤Fintype.card K := Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
  obtain ⟨S,hAS,hS,hcard⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq
    (Finset.subset_univ A) hA (show Fintype.card K≤(Finset.univ : Finset I).card by simpa using hkm)
  have hmem : S∈centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K) := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨hS,hcard⟩
  refine ((subsetSearch_spec c hkm).2 S hmem).trans ?_
  apply cost_le_of_centers_cover c hw
  intro j
  have hfj : f j∈S := hAS (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j,Finset.mem_univ j,rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := subsetTuple_hits S hcard (f j) hfj
  exact ⟨l,congrArg c.points hl⟩

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_le_four.source:
theorem subsetSearch_le_four (c : Cloud I X) (hw : ∀ i,0≤c.weights i)
    (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) (s : K → X) :
    cost c.points c.weights (subsetSearchCenters c hkm)≤4*cost c.points c.weights s :=
  (subsetSearch_le_tuple c hw hkm (fun j=>nearest c.points (s j))).trans
    (metric_rounding c.points c.weights hw s (rounded c s) (fun j i=>nearest_le c.points (s j) i))

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_support.source:
theorem subsetSearch_supported (c : Cloud I X) (hkm : Fintype.card K≤Fintype.card I) :
    ∀ j,subsetSearchCenters (K:=K) c hkm j∈Set.range c.points := fun j=>⟨_,rfl⟩

/-- The search has exactly binomial(m,k) candidates even when the sampled
cloud has repeated locations; using distinct locations can reduce it further. -/

APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_candida.doc: The search has exactly binomial(m,k) candidates even when the sampled cloud has repeated locations; using distinct locations can reduce it further.
APC.MetricIteration.subsetSearch_candida.source:
theorem subsetSearch_candidate_count :
    (centerSubsets I (Fintype.card K)).card=(Fintype.card I).choose (Fintype.card K) := by
  simp [centerSubsets]

end
end APC.MetricIteration

APC.Preserves.source:
def Preserves (p q : ℝ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (1 - ε) * p ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (1 + ε) * p

/-- Approximation is comparison with every feasible solution; this avoids
assuming that an optimum exists for the summary. -/

APC.Approximate.doc: Approximation is comparison with every feasible solution; this avoids assuming that an optimum exists for the summary.

APC.witness_transfer.source:
theorem witness_transfer {Solution : Type*} (p q : Solution → ℝ)
    (s out opt : Solution) (α β η : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hη : η < 1)
    (happrox : Approximate q α s)
    (hlift : q out ≤ β * q s)
    (hout : (1 - η) * p out ≤ q out)
    (hopt : q opt ≤ (1 + η) * p opt) :
    p out ≤ α * β * ((1 + η) / (1 - η)) * p opt := by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - η := by linarith
  have hchain : (1 - η) * p out ≤ β * (α * ((1 + η) * p opt)) :=
    hout.trans (hlift.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (happrox opt) hβ).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hopt hα) hβ)))
  calc
    p out ≤ (β * (α * ((1 + η) * p opt))) / (1-η) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hden).2 (by nlinarith [hchain])
    _ = _ := by ring

APC.euclidean_factor.source:
theorem euclidean_factor (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hsmall : η ≤ 1/2) :
    (1 + η)^2 / (1 - η) ≤ 1 + 10 * η := by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 - η)).2
  have : η * (1/2 - η) ≥ 0 := mul_nonneg hη (by linarith)
  nlinarith

APC.euclidean_transfer.source:
theorem euclidean_transfer {Solution : Type*} (p q : Solution → ℝ)
    (s out opt : Solution) (α η : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hsmall : η ≤ 1/2)
    (hcost : 0 ≤ p opt) (happrox : Approximate q α s)
    (hlift : q out ≤ (1 + η) * q s)
    (hout : Preserves (p out) (q out) η)
    (hopt : Preserves (p opt) (q opt) η) :
    p out ≤ α * (1 + 10 * η) * p opt := by
  have ht := witness_transfer p q s out opt α (1+η) η hα (by linarith)
    (by linarith) happrox hlift hout.1 hopt.2
  calc
    p out ≤ α * ((1+η)^2 / (1-η)) * p opt := by
      convert ht using 1 <;> ring
    _ ≤ α * (1+10*η) * p opt :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (euclidean_factor η hη hsmall) hα) hcost

APC.euclidean_transfer_rescaled.source:
theorem euclidean_transfer_rescaled {Solution : Type*} (p q : Solution → ℝ)
    (s out opt : Solution) (α ε : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hsmall : ε ≤ 1)
    (hcost : 0 ≤ p opt) (happrox : Approximate q α s)
    (hlift : q out ≤ (1 + ε/10) * q s)
    (hout : Preserves (p out) (q out) (ε/10))
    (hopt : Preserves (p opt) (q opt) (ε/10)) :
    p out ≤ α * (1 + ε) * p opt := by
  have h := euclidean_transfer p q s out opt α (ε/10) hα (by linarith)
    (by linarith) hcost happrox hlift hout hopt
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

/-- Two sampling stages have error 2η+η². This explicitly accounts for
the strong coreset stage, which cannot simply be omitted. -/

APC.preserves_compose.doc: Two sampling stages have error 2η+η². This explicitly accounts for the strong coreset stage, which cannot simply be omitted.
APC.preserves_compose.source:
theorem preserves_compose {p q r η : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hsmall : η ≤ 1)
    (h₁ : Preserves p q η) (h₂ : Preserves q r η) :
    Preserves p r (2*η + η^2) := by
  constructor
  · have h := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁.1 (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1-η)).trans h₂.1
    have : 0 ≤ η^2 * p := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg η) hp
    nlinarith
  · have h := h₂.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁.2 (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1+η))
    nlinarith

APC.preserves_mono.source:
theorem preserves_mono {p q a b : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : Preserves p q a) : Preserves p q b := by
  constructor <;> nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab) hp, h.1, h.2]

end APC

APC.euclidean_two_stage.doc: The main Euclidean reduction with the two sampling stages kept separate. Theorems 2.1 and 2.2 must supply hstrong, hsecond, and hsecond_opt. This theorem does not assert their probability or the sample-size bound.
APC.euclidean_two_stage.source:
theorem euclidean_two_stage
    {I B K E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype K] [Nonempty K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x : I → E) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (b : B → E) (embed : I → B) (he : ∀ i, b (embed i) = x i)
    (original intermediate : (K → E) → ℝ)
    (hnonneg : ∀ c, 0 ≤ original c)
    (opt s : K → E) (α ε : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (happrox : Approximate (cost x w) α s)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmε : (m:ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ ε/10)
    (hstrong : ∀ c, Preserves (original c) (intermediate c) (ε/100))
    (hsecond : ∀ c ∈ witnessFamily (K := K) b m,
      Preserves (intermediate c) (cost x w c) (ε/100))
    (hsecond_opt : Preserves (intermediate opt) (cost x w opt) (ε/100)) :
    ∃ out : K → E, out ∈ witnessFamily b m ∧
      original out ≤ α * (1 + ε) * original opt := by
  have herr : 2*(ε/100) + (ε/100)^2 ≤ ε/10 := by
    have : ε * (1-ε) ≥ 0 := mul_nonneg hε.le (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hcompose : ∀ c, Preserves (intermediate c) (cost x w c) (ε/100) →
      Preserves (original c) (cost x w c) (ε/10) := by
    intro c hc
    exact preserves_mono (hnonneg c) herr
      (preserves_compose (hnonneg c) (by linarith) (by linarith) (hstrong c) hc)
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hb⟩ := euclidean_apc_of_preservation x w hw original opt s α ε
    hα hε hε1 (hnonneg opt) happrox m hm hmε
    (fun c hc => hcompose c (hsecond c (witnessFamily_mono x b embed he m c hc)))
    (hcompose opt hsecond_opt)
  exact ⟨out, witnessFamily_mono x b embed he m out hout, hb⟩

end APC

APC.log_solution_count.source:
theorem log_solution_count (N B d : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (hB : 0<B)
    (hcount : N≤B^d+1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    Real.log (2*(N:ℝ)/δ)≤Real.log (4/δ)+(d:ℝ)*Real.log B := by
  have hNR : (0:ℝ)<N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hBR : (0:ℝ)<B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hB1 : (1:ℝ)≤B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hc : (N:ℝ)≤(B:ℝ)^d+1 := by exact_mod_cast hcount
  have hp : (1:ℝ)≤(B:ℝ)^d := one_le_pow₀ hB1
  have hratio : 2*(N:ℝ)/δ≤(4/δ)*(B:ℝ)^d := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2
    field_simp
    nlinarith only [hc,hp]
  calc
    _≤Real.log ((4/δ)*(B:ℝ)^d) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hratio
    _=_ := by rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),Real.log_pow]

/-- Concrete logarithmic budget from the m-point-mean witness count.
It exposes the k*m factor responsible for ε^-3 in Euclidean APCs. -/

APC.witness_family_budget.doc: Concrete logarithmic budget from the m-point-mean witness count. It exposes the k*m factor responsible for ε^-3 in Euclidean APCs.
APC.witness_family_budget.source:
theorem witness_family_budget
    {B K E : Type*} [Fintype B] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (b : B → E) (t : ℕ) (opt : K → E) (hB : 0<Fintype.card B)
    (D ε δ : ℝ) (hD : 0≤D) (hδ : 0<δ) (m : ℕ)
    (hsize : D*(Real.log (4/δ)+(t*Fintype.card K:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card B))≤(m:ℝ)*ε^2) :
    D*Real.log (2*((insert opt (witnessFamily (K := K) b t)).card:ℝ)/δ)≤(m:ℝ)*ε^2 := by
  have hN : 0<(insert opt (witnessFamily (K := K) b t)).card := Finset.card_pos.mpr
    ⟨opt,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  have hc := log_solution_count (insert opt (witnessFamily (K := K) b t)).card (Fintype.card B)
    (t*Fintype.card K) hN hB (card_witnessFamily_with_opt b t opt) δ hδ
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hD).trans hsize

end APC

APC.tupleMean.source:
def tupleMean (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → B) : E :=
  (m:ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j, b (f j)

APC.smallMeans.source:
def smallMeans (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) : Finset E := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.image (tupleMean b m)

APC.mem_smallMeans.source:
theorem mem_smallMeans (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → B) :
    tupleMean b m f ∈ smallMeans b m := by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

APC.card_smallMeans.source:
theorem card_smallMeans (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) :
    (smallMeans b m).card ≤ Fintype.card B ^ m := by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m → B)).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = _ := by simp [Fintype.card_fun]

variable {K : Type*} [Fintype K]

APC.witnessFamily.source:
def witnessFamily (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) : Finset (K → E) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.image (fun f : K → Fin m → B => fun j => tupleMean b m (f j))

APC.mem_witnessFamily.source:
theorem mem_witnessFamily (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) (f : K → Fin m → B) :
    (fun j => tupleMean b m (f j)) ∈ witnessFamily (K := K) b m := by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨f, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

/-- Exact exponent includes the 3 in m=ceil(3/ε). -/

APC.card_witnessFamily.doc: Exact exponent includes the 3 in m=ceil(3/ε).
APC.card_witnessFamily.source:
theorem card_witnessFamily (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) :
    (witnessFamily (K := K) b m).card ≤ Fintype.card B ^ (m * Fintype.card K) := by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (K → Fin m → B)).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = _ := by simp [Fintype.card_fun, ← pow_mul]

APC.card_witnessFamily_with_opt.source:
theorem card_witnessFamily_with_opt [DecidableEq E] (b : B → E) (m : ℕ) (opt : K → E) :
    (insert opt (witnessFamily (K := K) b m)).card ≤ Fintype.card B ^ (m * Fintype.card K) + 1 := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (card_witnessFamily b m) 1)

/-- The final summary's witnesses belong to the family defined by the first
summary. This is what makes conditioning before the second sample sound. -/

APC.witnessFamily_mono.doc: The final summary's witnesses belong to the family defined by the first summary. This is what makes conditioning before the second sample sound.
APC.witnessFamily_mono.source:
theorem witnessFamily_mono {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x : I → E) (b : B → E) (embed : I → B)
    (he : ∀ i, b (embed i) = x i) (m : ℕ) (out : K → E)
    (hout : out ∈ witnessFamily x m) : out ∈ witnessFamily b m := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, _, hf⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hout
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨fun j l => embed (f j l), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  rw [← hf]
  funext j
  simp [tupleMean, he]

end APC
